Engineering Graduate Programme (Fullstack)  

**Programme start date: September 2027**


**Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make** one application


Do you have a passion for technology? Do you want to make a difference, delivering software used by some of the biggest companies in the world? Do you love working with others in a dynamic agile environment?


Our Engineering Graduate Programme provides the ideal springboard for an exciting and significant career in global financial markets technology.


To be eligible you must be a final year undergraduate or Masters student in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Engineering, Information Technology or related discipline and have completed all the requirements of your course before August/September 2027 or a fresh graduate in class of 2026\.


While we offer a wide range of technology roles, for these positions, we are looking for candidates who are interested **Full\-Stack Development** and familiar with one of the programming languages **C\#, JavaScript, Node JS, .NET skills or Python.** Additionally for roles in the Network Product Services team interest in Network Assets, API based services and automation and orchestration tools such as Ansible **.**


We seek to match your interests, skills and background to the developer roles available.


We will also support you in discovering more about the different areas of LSEG that interest you most by connecting you with various departments so that you can learn more about them.


Our Technology Graduate Programme is a 12\-month development opportunity for the Tech Savvy. Fast\-track your technical journey, learn and work with our technology gurus, and develop your career in a leading fintech company.


**Highlights of the Graduate Programme**


* Progress through a 12\-month development journey aiming to build foundational skills that are key for your future success
* Build your foundational knowledge of LSEG, Financial Markets and the business during your global induction
* 'Engineering Bootcamp' week to immerse you in the business and Engineering principles
* Participate in group projects which are aligned to LSEG goals
* Meet in person with your cohort at ‘Ignite’, the programme mid\-point skills offsite. Explore key knowledge areas and skills
* Access opportunities to earn industry recognized qualifications, including 5 study days during programme
* Connect with global early careers community and opportunities and contribute to wider society via CSR initiatives and volunteering opportunities

Our graduates join us on a permanent basis, and from day one you will be aligned to a division, which will allow you to develop within a secure framework. During the recruitment process we will get to know your skills and interest and how they align to the needs of the business, to allow us to place you in the right division.


**What we are looking for:**


We are passionate about recruiting people who have a genuine curiosity about Technology and strive to pursue a Technology career path, as evidenced by their studies, extracurriculars or work experience. It’s important to us that you can also understand the breadth of our organisation, how it functions and the vital role that technology plays in supporting LSEG and our clients.

For instance, you may have secured an internship in a technology role or focused on technology as part of a university project. You may have learnt how to code or how to use a particular technology.

We are considering candidates beyond the core software degrees (e.g. computer science, software engineering, Mathematics and Informatics) and candidate with physics, engineering, electronic degree who can demonstrate an interest in Technology as evidenced by extracurriculars or work experience, or personal projects can apply.  

  



**Application close:** **20th October** , however we recommend an early application because we consider candidates on a rolling basis. Due to the volume of applications, we might close the applications earlier, so we recommend an early application.

  

**Recruitment Process:**

The third stage of the application process is an Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG The fourth stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength\-based\-interview style The final stage is a half day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite.

jobs.title: Head of Analysis & Design - Investment Platform
jobs.description:
**Who we’re looking for**

We are seeking a high\-calibre, hands\-on Head of Analysis \& Design to lead our team of senior Analysts and support the evolution of our business architecture across our Public Markets Investment Platform.


This role is pivotal in ensuring that enterprise strategy, operating models, and cross\-domain business capabilities are clearly defined, aligned, and translated into scalable platform outcomes.


You will operate at the intersection of business strategy, investment domain expertise, product management, solution design and technology delivery, ensuring business priorities are translated into scalable platform outcomes across Public Markets while remaining aligned to wider Asset Management Platform standards and objectives.


As a senior leader, you will lead and develop the Public Markets Analysis \& Design capability, embedding strong business analysis, solution design and product thinking disciplines that drive measurable business value, effective delivery and continuous improvement.


The role acts as the primary bridge between Public Markets business stakeholders, product management, architecture and engineering teams. Whilst engineering teams may operate under separate reporting structures, the Head of Analysis \& Design remains accountable for ensuring analysis, solution design and technology delivery remain closely aligned through active participation in technology governance, planning and design forums.  



**About Us**

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.


Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.  



**The team**

The Asset Management Platform (AMP) is a global technology change and delivery organisation responsible for the platforms that underpin Schroders’ investment, client and operational capabilities across public and private markets


AMP brings together a set of business\-aligned technology platforms—including Client, Investment, Group Operations, Data and Finance—into a single, integrated asset management capability, enabling consistent, scalable and value\-driven outcomes across the firm.


Operating within a platform\-centric model, teams are aligned to business outcomes while leveraging shared enterprise capabilities across architecture, data, engineering and delivery to drive standardisation, reuse, and speed of execution.  



**Asset Management Platform – Analysis \& Design**

The Analysis \& Design function is a core enterprise level capability within the Asset Management Platform, accountable for shaping the future direction of the firm's technology and business capabilities.


Operating across all business aligned domains, the team provides leadership in business analysis, architecture, operating model design, strategic analysis and product management, ensuring investment is aligned to business priorities and enterprise outcomes.


Through the definition of common standards, reusable design patterns and platform\-wide governance, the function drives consistency, simplification and scalability, enabling the organisation to accelerate change, optimise cost, and realise the full potential of data, AI and platform\-based operating models.


**Analysis \& Design plays a central role in achieving this by:**

* Defining enterprise\-wide capability models and value streams
* Ensuring alignment across platforms and business domains
* Driving standardisation, simplification, and convergence
* Enabling data \- and AI\-driven transformation at scale

The Head of Analysis will provide the structural backbone linking strategy to execution, ensuring that business intent is consistently realised across the platform ecosystem.  



**What you’ll do**

* Lead the Analysis \& Design strategy for Public Markets, ensuring Public Markets products, platforms and technology investments align with Asset Management Platform standards, enterprise architecture principles and strategic objectives.
* Ensure Public Markets products, platforms and investments remain aligned with Asset Management Platform strategy, standards and architecture.
* Lead, develop and grow the Public Markets Analysis \& Design team, establishing high standards, clear career pathways and a culture of continuous improvement.
* Partner with business stakeholders across research, portfolio management, trading and investment operations to shape strategic priorities and transformation initiatives.
* Define and evolve business capabilities, operating models and business processes across Public Markets, ensuring clear alignment between strategy, execution and technology outcomes.
* Translate business strategy into clear requirements, high level designs and delivery outcomes that create measurable business value.
* Partner with Product Leads, Engineering Leads and Architects to shape backlogs, govern solution design and ensure Public Markets technology outcomes align with business priorities, architectural standards and Asset Management Platform objectives.
* Maintain strong engagement with engineering leadership and participate in technology planning, governance and architecture forums to ensure business analysis and solution design remain closely integrated with technology delivery.
* Act as the bridge between business, product, architecture and engineering teams, driving alignment and effective decision\-making across complex initiatives.
* Drive simplification, standardisation and continuous improvement across investment processes and ways of working.
* Establish and continuously improve business analysis and solution design standards, methodologies and governance across Public Markets.
* Identify capability gaps, inefficiencies and transformation opportunities across the investment lifecycle.
* Embed data, analytics and AI considerations into business processes and solution design, identifying opportunities to improve investment outcomes, operational efficiency and user experience.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Investments, Technology and Change to influence decisions and drive strategic outcomes.
* Contribute to the wider Analysis \& Design, Architecture and Asset Management Platform communities, promoting consistency, collaboration and best practice.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise strategies and standards

**The knowledge, experience and qualifications you need**

* Proven experience leading Business Analysis, Analysis \& Design or related functions within a complex, global organisation.
* Strong understanding of Public Markets and asset management business processes, including research, portfolio management, trading and investment operations.
* Experience building, developing and leading high\-performing teams of Business Analysts and Analysis \& Design professionals.
* Strong understanding of business architecture, operating model design, business capability modelling and end\-to\-end process improvement.
* Experience operating within platform\-led, product\-based or agile delivery organisations.
* Proven ability to translate business strategy into clear outcomes, roadmaps and deliverable change initiatives.
* Experience partnering with Product, Engineering and Architecture teams to shape and deliver technology\-enabled business transformation.
* Strong understanding of modern technology concepts, including platform architectures, data ecosystems, integration patterns and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Experience ensuring business outcomes, product direction and technology delivery remain aligned with enterprise strategy, architecture and platform standards
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and build strong relationships across business and technology functions.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and articulate a clear strategic direction.
* Experience leading large\-scale business, data and AI\-enabled transformation initiatives that deliver measurable business value.

**What you’ll be like**

The successful candidate will be a strategic and outcome‑driven senior Analyst, able to connect business priorities with clear, scalable technology direction. They will combine strong vision with pragmatism—defining long‑term platform strategy while making practical decisions that enable delivery at pace. With deep analytical credibility, they will engage confidently across analysis, architecture, engineering and delivery teams, shaping solutions that are robust, aligned to enterprise standards and focused on delivering tangible business value.  



They will operate as a collaborative and influential leader within a complex, global environment, driving alignment across business and technology stakeholders. A strong advocate of simplification, standardisation and reuse, they will actively reduce complexity and drive convergence across the platform. Clear in their communication and accountable in their approach, they will take ownership for the platform’s evolution, contribute to the wider analysis and design community, and continuously apply emerging technologies—particularly data and AI—to enhance investment capabilities and outcomes.  



An experienced people leader who develops high\-performing analytical teams through coaching, mentoring and continuous improvement.


A collaborative leader who brings together business, product, engineering and architecture stakeholders to achieve shared outcomes.


Comfortable operating strategically while remaining hands\-on where required to resolve ambiguity, shape complex initiatives and support delivery teams.  



**We Recognise Potential, Whoever You Are**

Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio\-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.  



We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

**Support the frontline work that keeps our customers safe and our network running**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  


As our **Support Engineer**, you'll play a key role in supporting frontline repair activities across our gas network. This isn't just about responding to gas escapes – it's about helping deliver safe, efficient and reliable services for the millions of customers who depend on us every day.

  



Based in and around theNorwich/Suffolk area, you'll work closely with a Team Leader and wider operational teams to support emergency response, repairs and network maintenance activities. You'll gain valuable hands\-on experience while helping to protect our infrastructure, support customers and maintain high standards of safety and compliance.

  



This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys practical work, thrives in a team environment and is looking to build a long\-term career within a vital industry.

  


**As this role requires the use of respiratory protective equipment, you'll need to be clean shaven each day in line with health and safety requirements. The role also includes participation in a 1\-in\-6 standby rota and associated call\-out responsibilities.**

**Why you'll love this role:**
------------------------------


* **Frontline Network Support** – Attend gas escapes and support repair activities that help keep customers and communities safe.
* **Varied Operational Work** – Assist with groundwork, excavations, reinstatements and a range of network maintenance activities.
* **Safety First** – Promote safe working practices, using appropriate signing, lighting, guarding and cable avoidance techniques.
* **Team Collaboration** – Work closely with Team Leaders and operational colleagues to deliver high\-quality services.

jobs.title: Developer and Support Analyst
jobs.description:
We are seeking a skilled and motivated **Developer and Support Analyst** to join the Information Services team. This role is responsible for the development, support and enhancement of the University's applications, databases and integrations, helping to deliver reliable, secure and effective digital services.


Working closely with stakeholders across the University, you will analyse requirements, develop technical solutions, support business\-critical systems, and contribute to projects that improve business processes and user experience. **Key responsibilities include:**

* Developing, maintaining and supporting applications, databases and system integrations.
* Designing and implementing solutions using technologies such as MS SQL, C\#, PHP, Entity Framework, Oracle and web technologies.
* Working with stakeholders to identify requirements and deliver system improvements.
* Testing, deploying and supporting software developments and enhancements.
* Providing technical support, troubleshooting and problem resolution.
* Supporting database administration, security, resilience and data integrity.
* Maintaining technical documentation and contributing to digital transformation projects.

**Essential criteria:**

* Experience developing, supporting and maintaining applications, databases and integrations.
* Strong technical skills in relevant development technologies, including MS SQL, C\#, PHP and web technologies.
* Experience translating business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience delivering system developments, enhancements and support services.
* Ability to manage workloads effectively and work collaboratively with stakeholders.
* Commitment to delivering secure, reliable and high\-quality digital services.

**Welsh language skills:** Desirable


We particularly welcome applications from individuals who enjoy working collaboratively across technical and non\-technical teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that support teaching, learning and business operations.

jobs.title: Contract .NET Engineer
jobs.description:
**Day rate:** £550–£600/day (Inside IR35\)


**Duration:** 6 months (likely extension)


**Location:** Manchester, 1\-2 days/week in office


**Start:** October


Codurance is a software craftsmanship consultancy. We work with clients on the engineering problems that actually matter to their business, and we do it properly \- clean code, sound architecture, and engineering practices that hold up under pressure, not just in a demo. We're not a body\-shop; our consultants are expected to bring technical judgement and push back on bad decisions, not just fill a seat.


We're hiring contract .NET Engineers to join a project team working on a large\-scale modernisation programme for a client in the regulated financial services space \- replacing a legacy platform that's been patched together for years with a modern, cloud\-native architecture running on Kubernetes. It's meaty, high\-stakes engineering with real constraints around compliance, data integrity, and scale, and you'll be doing it alongside a team that cares about doing the work well.


You'll be embedded with the client's engineering teams as part of a Codurance delivery squad, working on:

* Re\-architecting parts of a legacy system onto modern, cloud\-native foundations
* Building and evolving services on Kubernetes across AWS and Azure
* Working in a regulated environment where quality, testing, and traceability aren't optional
* Applying proper software craftsmanship practices \- TDD, pairing, clean architecture \- as standard.

  

**Requirements**  

* Strong commercial experience with .NET / C\# in a production environment
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and containerised/Kubernetes environments
* Comfortable working in a regulated or compliance\-heavy environment (financial services experience is a plus, not a requirement)
* Experience modernising or re\-platforming legacy systems
* A genuine interest in doing things well \- testing, clean code, good engineering habits
* Able to work in Manchester 1\-2 days a week

  

**Benefits** *Everyone should have the right to bring their whole self to work and be celebrated for who they are. Our people are hired purely on their commitment to these values and their ambition to deliver outstanding results for our clients. Codurance is proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.*

jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About The Role**


RAC are on the lookout for a Senior Backend .Net Software Engineer to lead within our Breakdown team, which is the squad behind the digital tools that help customers receive the right breakdown support when they need it most. This high\-traffic, mission\-critical suite of tools is used by hundreds of thousands of members each year and is central to how we deliver a best\-in\-class breakdown experience.



You’ll play a pivotal role in delivering our technical vision and elevating engineering standards across the RAC. As one of the most senior engineering voices in our Digital \& Technology teams, you’ll drive best practice, influence architecture and design decisions, and help shape our future technology landscape.



If you’re passionate about high quality engineering, modern platforms, scalable systems and mentoring others, while still staying hands on, this is the role for you.



Based in our **Bristol** office working hybrid with flexible working patterns.


**What you’ll do**


* Act as a key technical leader in your product team, driving engineering best practice, problem\-solving, and practical technical decision\-making.
* Design and deliver robust backend architecture and high\-quality software using **.NET Core, C\#, SQL**, and cloud\-native services in **Azure**.
* Contribute to technical design, future\-state architecture and long\-term technology strategy across the wider RAC Digital ecosystem.
* Lead engineering initiatives, improve delivery lifecycle processes, and champion automation, quality and continuous improvement.
* Drive adoption of modern engineering practices including CI/CD, Kubernetes, DevOps tooling and scalable cloud patterns.
* Provide coaching and technical mentoring across squads—supporting engineers of all levels to elevate capability and standards.
* Collaborate with Product and other technical functions to shape requirements, clarify complex problems and deliver practical, customer\-focused solutions.
* Own and manage technical debt, ensuring intelligent prioritisation and long\-term maintainability.
* Support recruitment, onboarding and the development of engineering talent across the team.
* Bring curiosity and innovation—staying ahead of emerging technologies and identifying new opportunities to enhance our digital estate.


**What you’ll bring**


* Deep experience building high quality backend systems using **.NET Core, C\#, APIs, SQL**, and cloud technologies (preferably **Azure**).
* Strong understanding of event\-driven architectures, microservices, containerisation (Kubernetes) and modern engineering patterns.
* Proven ability to lead technical workstreams, influence decisions and mentor others—without needing formal line management.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to make sense of complex or incomplete business requirements.
* Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and best\-practice software engineering.
* Self\-motivated, analytical and results\-driven, with the ability to work in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.

  



As a **Software Engineer** – Acquisition at RAC, you’ll get benefits that go the extra mile


* Earnings That Motivate – enjoy a competitive salary plus automatic enrolment in our Owning It Together Colleague Share Scheme, giving you a unique opportunity to share in RAC’s future success.
* Tools to Drive Your Future – get started with a free RAC Ultimate Complete Breakdown Service from day one, plus access to a car salary sacrifice scheme (including electric vehicle options) after 12 months, delivering serious tax savings.
* Time Off That Matters – enjoy 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays. We also support work–life balance with paid family leave, flexible schedules and practical resources to help navigate personal commitments.
* Financial Security \& Perks – benefit from a pension scheme with up to 6\.5% matched contributions alongside life assurance cover of 4× salary (10× optional with flex benefits), designed to support you long term.
* Wellbeing That Works for You – our 24/7 confidential support service is available to you and household members aged 16\+, offering reassurance whenever you need it.
* Extras That Make a Difference – access Orange Savings, our exclusive discount portal with deals across top retailers, holidays, tools, tech and more. After passing probation, you’ll automatically join our Colleague Share Scheme, giving you a stake in our collective success.

**Why RAC?**



For more than 128 years, we’ve been keeping drivers moving, and today we’re trusted by over 15 million members. We’re also trusted by our people, with a 4\.5\-star Glassdoor rating showing that RAC is a place where support, ambition, and opportunity go hand in hand.



We welcome people from every background, value every voice, and back your growth every step of the way. At the RAC, you can bring your full self to work and we’ll be with you every step of the way to help you grow and develop your career.

jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Quality Assurance and Testing is an important part of the delivery of digital systems within the HRA. We have a team of skilled test professionals who make sure quality is delivered in the most effective way. We are looking to add automation engineering skills to our existing team as we value automating as much of the test effort as possible allowing our team of specialists to undertake better evaluations of the overall product set.
  
  

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will create and drive the automated test engineering approach within the RSP working closely with the Head of Test and others in the Agile development team. You will determine and implement automation approaches using Playwright(typescript) to assure, measure and build quality into every phase of the software life cycle. This involves developing or enhancing automation frameworks that help deliver scalable tests which are faster, frequent, and continuous. Job also involves performing manual testing where automation is not suitable.
  
  

The interview will contain a mandatory technical test for playwright/NFT coding skills where you will be expected to write and share code in the interview. You should demonstrate your knowledge of this on your CV.
  
  

PLEASE READ
  
  

Applicants should submit an anonymised CV for this role, removing any personal and identifiable information before uploading (name, email etc.).
  
  

We kindly ask that only those who have not previously applied to this post in the last 6 months submit their application.
  
  

Identify new and implement existing test automation frameworks
  
  

Work on both functional and non\-functional areas of complex system(s) built with multiple technologies (Microsoft, PEGA etc)
  
  

Identify and raise awareness of defects, issues, risks arising from the automation test results
  
  

Be proficient in a range of coding languages (C\#, .Net, Java, JavaScript, Node, React, typescript etc)
  
  

Work closely with members of Agile team
  
  

Collaborate with senior test analysts, business to make sure the required business scenarios are covered in the test scripts
  
  

Carry out system, integration and user acceptance testing using manual and automated techniques
  
  

Lead on change impact assessment of all changes ensuring that test coverage mitigates any impact to external stakeholders
  
  

Work with the HRA’s User Acceptance Team representatives and external users to perform acceptance testing of HRA software system changes
  
  

Manage own work within the timelines agreed
  
  

Duties above are not an exhaustive list. The applicant will be expected to perform their duties as per ISTQB best practices (automation \& manual)
  
  

At the HRA, we are committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive working environment where we actively invest in the development and empowerment of our staff, enabling them to perform at their best. We strive to promote a healthy workplace culture where wellbeing, collaboration, and professional growth are valued and encouraged.
  
  

Working at the HRA, our approach to flexible working is designed to support us all, recognising that for many people, home based or hybrid working provides us with the most productive environment to work well. We will try to offer a working pattern that suits you where possible.
  
  

The HRA offers home based contracts for all locations. Newcastle based staff can be office based. For staff based in Manchester or Nottingham, hybrid working arrangements may be possible. We encourage you to speak with us to explore how this could be accommodated.
  
  

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We know from experience that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger, more creative workplace that helps us to deliver the best services. We welcome applications which represent the rich diversity of our community: age, disability, gender identity and expression, ethnicity, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation and other diverse characteristics, and we have policies in place to ensure that all applicants are treated fairly and consistently at every stage of the recruitment process.
  
  

Job responsibilities
  
  

Please refer to the attached job description and person specification documents for full details about this role.
  
  

When completing your application, ensure you clearly demonstrate how your experience and skills align with the criteria outlined for this position.
  
  

We recognise that generative AI tools can be helpful in supporting applicants during the recruitment process, particularly for tasks such as proofreading, structuring, or refining written responses. However, we encourage candidates to use AI responsibly and sparingly. Applications should reflect your authentic voice, personal experiences, and genuine qualifications. Over reliance on AI\-generated content can result in generic or inaccurate submissions that fail to meet the criteria or convey your individuality. Misrepresentation of skills, knowledge, or experience, including through AI\-generated content, may lead to the rejection of your application, withdrawal of your offer, or your dismissal if you do start with us. If you choose to use AI, please ensure it enhances rather than replaces your own input, and be transparent about its use where appropriate. False and insincere examples go against our values of integrity and transparency.
  
  

Important information
  
  

We are unable to offer employment under any sponsorship arrangement as we do not hold a sponsorship licence. Applications requiring sponsorship will not be considered.
  
  

Applications that do not clearly demonstrate how the essential criteria outlined in the person specification are met will not be shortlisted.
  
  

We do not accept applications via recruitment agencies or other third parties.
  
  

The HRA reserves the right to close this vacancy early should it receive a sufficient number of applications.
  
  

Our fixed term positions are also open to applicants who wish to apply for the role on a secondment basis. Applicants who fit this category are advised to speak with their Line Manager before applying and visit their organisations Secondments Policy.
  
  

Organisational structure and directorate overview
  
  

**The HRA is made up of five directorates:** Approvals, Chief Executive, Digital, Policy and Partnerships and Resources.
  
  

This role sits within HRA Digital. The digital directorate is responsible for developing, delivering and supporting complex solutions within the HRA’s portfolio of UK\-wide information systems for health and care research. This includes a major programme to build new systems, and to achieve the successful migration and eventual closure of current systems. The directorate owns, develops, and delivers the HRA’s digital strategy in line with government digital and functional standards.
  
  

The HRA Digital team is a collaborative, supportive team consisting of HRA employees, secondees, contractors and vendors.

Electrical Engineering
UKIMEA Region

BRI0001XE Requisition \#  

**Joining Arup**


Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.


Around the globe, Arup’s electrical engineers bring specialist expertise to solutions for buildings, transport infrastructure and energy, water and waste utilities. Our comprehensive services include energy audits, demand assessment, supply and system resilience, utilities consultancy and sustainable electrical engineering design.


Whether in commercial property, retail, sport, mission\-critical facilities, the arts or any market, we meet the creative and commercial demands of designers and developers. We are trusted to bring inventive solutions to complex technical challenges for clients in the Midlands including: NHS, University of Warwick, University of Nottingham, Defra (Department for Environment Food and Rural Affairs) Rolls\-Royce Motor Cars and Rolls\-Royce PLC.


Whatever the role or specialism, our people are passionate about what they do, they believe in our values and are happy to come to work every day. And this is why people choose to work here and stay.

  

**The Opportunity**


As a Senior / Principal Electrical Building Services Engineer, you will be a key part of the Building Services Engineering team, working on multidisciplinary projects providing guidance to other engineers and working alongside building physicists, sustainability consultants, energy and carbon consultants and BIM modellers. This team forms part of the wider region which includes civil, structural, fire, acoustics, specialist lighting, and other engineering disciplines. We are open to talking to candidates who are Chartered or who could work towards Chartership within 12 months.  

  



Your engineering insight will help shape projects that move us closer to a net zero carbon future. You’ll contribute to the development of innovative, sustainable solutions that balance technical excellence with environmental responsibility.


Collaboration is key at Arup. You’ll work closely with both internal and external teams, using clear and effective communication to ensure successful project outcomes. This includes liaising directly with clients and leading meetings to understand their needs and deliver value.


You’ll be encouraged to take a holistic view of design challenges—considering the broader context and long\-term impact of your decisions to benefit the overall project.


Working in an interdisciplinary environment, you’ll help design buildings that maximise value for clients while minimising environmental impact. Your leadership will guide MEP teams across local, national, and international projects, ensuring technical quality and consistency throughout.


Project management will be a core part of your role. You’ll be responsible for the financial performance of your projects, including fee negotiations and commercial discussions with clients. You’ll also oversee project delivery, managing teams and delegating effectively to ensure timely and high\-quality outcomes, reporting to the Project Director.


Supporting and developing others is central to our culture. You’ll help nurture a team of engineers, maintaining oversight of design quality, resource planning, and mentoring less experienced colleagues to help them grow.


Finally, you’ll contribute to Arup’s digital transformation—exploring new ways to improve efficiency through automation and enhancing our service offering through integrated digital design approaches.


At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.


You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.

  

**Is this role right for you?**


**We are looking for people who:**


Is degree qualified in Electrical, Building Services or Architectural Engineering.


Holds Chartered Engineer status via an appropriate professional institution such as IET or CIBSE, however we will also consider candidates close to Chartership.


Has experience of winning and delivering a range of projects.


Has the ability to provide technical leadership of multi\-disciplinary design teams including external sub\-consultants.


Has strong awareness of appropriate sector\-specific legislation, regulatory requirements and design guidance and future trends.


Has knowledge and interest in sustainable building design in terms of both energy and carbon and satisfying associated regulatory requirements.

  

  

Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact Rebecca Davies on rebecca.davies@arup.com \- please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.  



  

**What we offer you**


At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.


Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.


We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.


Arup offer a hybrid working model and flexible working arrangements to support work\-life balance. We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

  

**Different people, shared values**


Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.


Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup.


We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact Rebecca Davies to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

  

**Our Application Process**


To understand what to expect next, please visit https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment\-process/
  

  

Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.  

  



Recruitment Agencies \- We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

  

  

We will close the role once we have offered the position, so please ensure you apply now.

The role family is Software Engineering which means designing, coding, testing, and improving applications and services that help customers, colleagues, and partners get work done reliably and securely.


  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience through coursework, projects, research, or extracurricular activities using one or more programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, Python, C\#, Go, Kotlin, or similar technologies.
* Foundational understanding of computer science concepts including data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented programming, debugging, and problem\-solving.
* Interest in building software applications across web, mobile, backend, cloud, API, or full\-stack environments.
* Familiarity with modern software development practices such as version control, testing, code reviews, Agile methodologies, and collaborative development workflows.
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, intelligent automation, and AI\-powered developer tools.
* Strong communication, teamwork, and collaboration skills with the ability to learn quickly, seek feedback, and work effectively in a diverse and inclusive environment.

* Understanding and experience leveraging AI powered development tools, generative AI, intelligent automation, responsible AI, and machine learning fundamentals.

* Strong communication skills, including the ability to share progress, ask effective questions, and explain technical work to technical and non\-technical partners.

* Someone who communicates clearly, welcomes feedback, and brings an inclusive, customer first mindset to team environments.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. * Career development and training opportunities

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Graduate
jobs.description:
About the Role  

Ready to launch your engineering career while shaping the future of energy? At EDF power solutions, you'll gain hands\-on experience, learn from experts, and help deliver renewable energy projects that support the electrification of homes, businesses and communities across the UK.

**The Opportunity**


As an Electrical Engineering Graduate, you'll earn a salary of £37,500 per annum and begin your career at EDF power solutions in early September 2027\. You'll develop technical and professional skills while building a strong foundation for a long\-term engineering career.


Over this 16\-month programme, you'll rotate across Engineering teams and work on wind, solar PV and private wire projects. You'll gain experience from development through to commissioning while contributing to projects that support our ambition of powering an Electric UK and Ireland.

**What You’ll Experience**


As an Engineering Graduate at EDF power solutions, you'll gain exposure to a range of renewable energy technologies while supporting projects that help transform how energy is generated, stored and supplied across the UK.


You'll support engineering activities across solar PV, battery storage and private wire projects. From feasibility studies and design development to technical assessments and problem\-solving, you'll learn how projects are delivered safely, effectively and compliantly.


You'll also review technical documentation, collaborate with project teams and build practical industry knowledge. We'll support your development as you begin your journey towards chartership with the Institution of Engineering and Technology or another relevant professional body.

**Location**


You'll be based at one of our key sites in \#Edinburgh, \#London or \#Durham. During the programme, you'll have opportunities to complete placements across different locations, giving you valuable exposure to a range of teams, technologies and operational environments.


Most roles require between three and five days per week on site. Depending on your placement rotations, travel and relocation may be required during the programme. We'll provide practical and financial support to help make these transitions as smooth as possible.

**Why EDF power solutions?**


We're united by a shared ambition: to tackle climate change, shaping an Electric UK and Ireland. Our diverse team is growing fast, driven by innovation and a commitment to clean, green energy for all.


With technologies spanning onshore and offshore wind, solar, battery storage and green hydrogen, we're one of the UK's and Ireland's most diverse renewable energy generators. By 2035, we aim to deliver 10GW of low\-carbon energy capacity, and we'd love you to help us get there.

**Where This Programme Could Take You**


Ben completed EDF power solutions' Science and Engineering Graduate Programme, where he worked on a variety of projects that developed both his technical engineering expertise and broader professional skills. The programme gave him meaningful responsibility and exposure to different engineering environments.

jobs.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Cellular Origins**


Cell therapies are changing how we treat some of the most devastating diseases, by using a patient’s own cells as the treatment. To bring these therapies to many more people, manufacturing must change too, becoming far more scalable, reliable and efficient. At Cellular Origins you’ll help build the firmware that drives our robotic manufacturing technology, so more patients can access life\-changing treatments sooner.


As a Senior Firmware Engineer, you’ll sit at the intersection of software, electronics and automation. You’ll take technical ownership of turning motion, sensing and control ideas into reliable, production\-ready firmware that keeps our systems running smoothly in a bioprocess environment. You’ll regularly see your code make motors move, sensors respond and complex systems run reliably.

 **Job Description**  

You’ll join a multidisciplinary team of engineers and scientists working on our core automation platform, from first prototypes through to production systems. You’ll design, implement and test firmware that runs on ARM microcontrollers, work directly with hardware on the bench, and help shape technical decisions across firmware, electronics and the wider system.


This is not a role confined to the firmware team: you may spend as much time working with electronics, mechanical, automation and systems engineers, and with biologists, as you do with other firmware or software engineers. You’ll need to enjoy crossing disciplinary boundaries and learning enough about the wider system to help make it work as one coherent whole.


In this role, you’ll:

* Own firmware development for key parts of our core technology, from requirements and architecture through implementation, verification and support in production.
* Write and review high\-quality C for ARM microcontrollers (primarily STM32\), focusing on robust, maintainable and testable code.
* Design and maintain automated tests for embedded firmware, including unit, integration and hardware\-in\-the\-loop, and integrate them into continuous integration workflows.
* Turn system needs into clear firmware requirements and interfaces, working directly with electronics, mechanical, automation and software engineers, plus biologists.
* Make and communicate technical decisions within your area, balancing engineering rigour, maintainability and delivery speed, and support other engineers through design discussions and code reviews.
* Debug complex embedded\-system issues using tools such as debug probes, oscilloscopes, multimeters and logic analysers, getting to the root cause of tricky problems.
* Use Linux\-based tools and development environments as part of your day\-to\-day work.
* Support and occasionally develop custom test equipment for internal use, helping the wider team move faster.
* Use higher\-level languages such as Python, C\# or Java to build supporting tools and simple GUIs for debugging, testing or internal users.


Depending on your experience, you may also:

* Turn your hand to electronics design and prototype modification when needed, working with electronics engineers to shape interfaces and resolve cross\-discipline issues.
* Develop and optimise hard real\-time algorithms for motion control, sensing or safety\-critical functions.
* Use Docker and containers to create reliable, repeatable development and test environments.
* Contribute to embedded Linux software and the interfaces between it and our microcontroller firmware.

  

**Qualifications** **About you**


You enjoy seeing firmware come to life in real hardware, and you like being close to the bench, motors and sensors rather than hidden away from the physical system. You are comfortable owning firmware end to end, from first requirements and architecture through to code that ships, and you get energy from solving problems with people from different technical backgrounds.


We’re looking for:

* A strong track record of designing and delivering embedded systems, with the judgement to take ownership and make pragmatic technical decisions independently.
* Extensive professional experience developing firmware in C and/or C\+\+ on ARM microcontrollers, ideally STM32\.
* Strong experience developing and maintaining automated tests for embedded systems, including using them within continuous integration workflows.
* Confidence working directly with hardware and independently debugging complex systems at both code and signal level.
* Strong skills in interpreting component datasheets and electronics schematics, and using them to inform design and debugging.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial approach, with the ability to explain technical trade\-offs, support other engineers and solve problems with people from very different disciplines.

  

**Additional Information**  

Cellular Origins is currently based on the TTP Campus, within purpose\-built sustainable offices, labs and green surroundings, 10 miles south of Cambridge. Our working culture encourages entrepreneurship, shared ideas and collaboration, while providing you the freedom to do your best work.


Our employee benefits include:

* Annual bonus
* 25 days holiday
* Employer pension contribution of 10% of salary
* Private medical insurance for employees and dependants
* Enhanced family friendly leave
* Life insurance worth 6x salary
* Electric car leasing scheme
* Cycle to work scheme
* Season ticket loan

jobs.title: Asset Engineer
jobs.description:
Team
**Engineering**
Business Unit
**National Grid Ventures**
Requisition No.
**5404**
City
**Ashford, GB, TN25 6AF**
Date posted
**13 September 2026**  

**Asset Engineer**
==================


### **About the role**


National Grid Ventures Interconnectors is playing a critical role in connecting the UK's energy system with neighbouring countries, helping to deliver a more secure, resilient and low\-carbon energy future. Through our portfolio of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) interconnectors, we enable the import and export of electricity, supporting the UK's transition to net zero while developing the infrastructure needed to meet future energy demands.


We're looking for an **Asset Engineer** to join our Asset \& Engineering team. In this role, you'll be responsible for the effective management, performance and maintenance of critical interconnector assets, helping to ensure exceptional levels of reliability, availability and operational resilience across our portfolio.


Working closely with site\-based and central teams, you'll use your technical expertise to develop asset strategies, drive maintenance excellence, improve asset health and support continuous improvement initiatives. You'll play a key role in ensuring our assets perform safely, efficiently and in line with all regulatory and operational requirements.


This position is based at our IFA1 site in Sellindge so candidates would be ideally be based within a hours commute.


### **What you'll do**


As an Asset Engineer, you will:


* Deliver asset health assessments and asset management activities in line with National Grid policies and standards.
* Develop and implement asset maintenance strategies to maximise asset performance, reliability and lifespan.
* Translate OEM technical guidance and engineering standards into practical maintenance plans, work instructions and Maximo task lists.
* Produce and manage maintenance plans and outage scopes to ensure maintenance activities are completed safely and effectively.
* Support the management of asset defects, equipment failures and technical investigations, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions.
* Analyse asset performance data and provide recommendations to improve reliability and operational efficiency.
* Work collaboratively with site operations teams, engineering specialists and external partners to drive best practice across the interconnector portfolio.
* Coordinate with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) on warranty, performance and asset integrity matters.
* Maintain accurate asset records and support continual improvement of asset data within Maximo.
* Promote a strong culture of safety, compliance and continuous improvement across all engineering activities.
### **What you'll need**


* Experience in engineering and asset management, ideally within the utilities, energy, infrastructure or industrial sectors.
* Strong understanding of asset management principles and maintenance strategies.
* Knowledge of high\-voltage electrical systems or other critical infrastructure assets.
* Ability to interpret technical documentation, engineering drawings and OEM manuals.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to make informed technical decisions.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience using asset management systems such as Maximo or similar platforms.
* Understanding of risk management processes and regulatory compliance requirements.
* A proactive approach to continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* HNC in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent).
* Full UK Driving Licence.
### **What you'll get**


A competitive salary between **£47,442\.00 \- £56,173\.50 per annum**– dependent on capability.

  

  

As well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus based on personal and company performance and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few.

  

This role closes on **28th September at 23:59**, however we encourage candidates to submit their application as early as possible and not wait until the published closing date as this can vary.


We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates – we make appointments purely on merit, assessed against objective selection criteria. We support flexible working and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process should you have any physical or mental impairment which may affect your ability to participate in the process.


Please note that in most cases, National Grid is unable to offer sponsorship for employment under the UK points\-based immigration system. As such, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship now or in the future under the UK points\-based immigration system. However, in exceptional circumstances where there is a clear and demonstrable need for specialist skills that cannot be sourced from the local labour market, National Grid may consider offering sponsorship. All applications are welcome from candidates who meet these requirements, regardless of race, nationality, or ethnic origin.

jobs.description:
**Date Posted:**


2026\-07\-27**Country:**


United Kingdom
**Location:**


Glenrothes, Fife
**Position Role Type:**


Onsite
At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defence company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.


Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defence.

**Raytheon UK have a full time, permanent opportunity for a Senior Test Development Engineer to join our team in our Glenrothes(Scotland) and Livingston (Scotland).**


Our Senior Test Development Engineer role is a fantastic opportunity for your career growth; firstly, your technical knowledge will continue to develop due to our focus on R\&D and secondly, you will have opportunities to step up in seniority as we expect this team to have strong growth in the near future.


As Senior Test Development Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, manufacture, verification, validation, and lifecycle support of test equipment at board, sub\-system, and system level. You’ll work on technologies that support Control Actuation Systems, Guidance Electronics, and cutting\-edge GPS Anti\-Jamming systems across land, sea, air—and space.

**We are excited to offer, as well as, our competitive package and great career development \- a Welcome Bonus of £7\.5k!**

**Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop functional test equipment for electronic systems
* Lead and support hardware/software integration and troubleshooting
* Provide lifecycle and production support, including issue resolution and obsolescence management
* Collaborate across engineering disciplines to develop robust, scalable test solutions
* Lead design reviews and documentation to the highest standards
* Act as a mentor and technical leader for junior engineers

 **Required Experience:**

* Design of product Test Development Hardware
* Wiring Schedules
* System Interface design
* Appreciation of NI LabView/Teststand
* Ability to write comprehensive technical design documentation.
* Proven experience in handover and management of designs in production.
* Excellent hardware troubleshooting skills.
* Able to support/debug system integration
* Must be eligible Security Clearance to a minimum of BPSS

**Desirable Experience:**

* Significant test development experience in industry.
* Understanding of common test architectures PXI/LXI
* Measurement Uncertainty and its application in test equipment design and validation
* Software detailed knowledge of: NI LabView, CVI \& TestStand, C\#

 **What We Offer \& Work Culture:**

* Competitive salary
* Welcome / Joining Bonus of £7\.5k \*
* Relocation support \*
* 37hr working week, with an early finish Friday or compressed hours, start your weekend early!
* 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, opportunity to buy / sell / roll over up to 5 days, and up to 5 days volunteering annually.
* Contributory Pension Scheme (up to 10\.5% company contribution)
* Company bonus scheme (discretionary).
* 6 times salary ‘Life Assurance’ with pension.
* Flexible Benefits scheme with extensive salary sacrifice schemes, including Health Cashplan, Dental, and Cycle to Work amongst others.
* Enhanced sick pay.
* Enhanced family friendly policies including enhanced maternity, paternity \& shared parental leave.

 **Why join Raytheon?**


Raytheon UK is a powerhouse in defence and aerospace, where innovation meets impact. As a key partner to the UK government and global customers, we tackle the toughest challenges across land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace. Beyond cutting\-edge defence solutions, we lead the way in digital training transformation for both military and commercial clients.


At Raytheon UK, you will work with pioneering technology, collaborate with top industry experts, and be part of a dynamic team that fuels your growth. Whether you're looking to push boundaries, develop your skills, or make a real\-world impact, your future starts here.


The manufacture of Control Actuation Systems, Guidance Electronic Units and Power Products. The UK’s only Global Factory for UK \& US missile programmes. The provision of GPS Anti\-Jamming systems across domains. Raytheon UK’s long heritage of AJ GPS Technology can be found on land, air and maritime platforms.


Dedicated high volume Space Grade manufacturing facility with CCA lines qualified for Space, all supported by a highly skilled experienced workforce.


RTX


Raytheon UK is a landed company and part of the wider RTX organisation. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, USA, but with over 180,000 employees globally across every continent, RTX provides advanced systems and services for commercial, military and government customers worldwide and comprises three industry\-leading businesses – Collins Aerospace Systems, Pratt \& Whitney, and Raytheon.


Supporting over 35,000 jobs across 13 UK sites, RTX is helping to drive prosperity. Each year our work contributes over £2\.7bn to the UK economy and offers a wealth of opportunities to 4,000 suppliers across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. We’re investing in all corners of the country, supporting 29,040 jobs in England, 3,040 in Northern Ireland, 1,900 in Scotland and 1,600 in Wales.

All qualified applications will be given careful consideration without regard to ethnicity, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation or identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

2026\-07\-27**Country:**


United Kingdom
**Location:**


Glenrothes, Fife
**Position Role Type:**


Onsite
At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defence company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.


Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defence.

**Primary Purpose of this position:**

Responsible for the design, manufacture, verification and validation, along with through life technical support of board level, sub\-system and system level test equipment.

**Main Duties:**

* Design of functional test equipment
* Support the design and overall quality of the test equipment and provide leadership and guidance for junior engineers.
* Documentation of design specifications and implementation details. Take part in design reviews. Upholding of design standards and methodologies.
* Realisation of complex system requirements to provide robust and reliable test hardware solutions.
* Supporting responsibility for the complete implementation of detailed technical items and an understanding/appreciation of system level items.
* Collaboration with other team members (including both hardware and software engineers) to agree system designs, interfaces and protocols etc.
* Development of appropriate test hardware, test software and procedures, both informal and formal, to prove the correct operation of hardware.
* Provide support to manufacturing answering product queries \& resolving technical issues.
* Provide support for the test hardware and manage obsolescence throughout its lifecycle.
* Monitoring and reporting of progress of test development to immediate supervisor and development team.
* Proactively support company compliance to Health and Safety legislation through adherence to company polices, processes and practices.
* Ensure that all business activity is conducted in line with company values, policies and ethics codes of conduct.
* Undertake any other activity as reasonably requested by management
* Application of IPDS Processes
* Contributor for engineering specific risks and opportunities.
* Contributor at Gate/Design reviews
* Understanding of Test Development processes and tools.
* Support section/business area resource planning with a working understanding of Microsoft Project tools.
* Test Engineering Lead for a small scale test engineering program
* Ability to identify and engage the appropriate SME's to support the Test Development Engineering activities.
* Contributor for standard/tailored test development process including IPDS gates and content
* Interface to external customers/suppliers.

**Knowledge \& Experience Required**

**Essential:**

* Degree qualified in Electronic Engineering/related subject (preferably at 2\.1 Hons or higher).
* Test software design experience.
* Excellent knowledge of analogue and digital electronic circuit design.
* Ability to write comprehensive technical design documentation.
* Proven experience in handover and management of designs in production
* Excellent hardware troubleshooting skills
* Able to support/debug system integration
* Good knowledge of MS Office products
* Good communicator

**Highly Desirable:**

* Test development experience in industry.
* Use of Mentor Graphics schematic entry and PCB layout tools.
* Understanding of common test architectures PXI/d LXI
* Measurement Uncertainty and its application in test equipment design and validation
* Software Certification or detailed knowledge of:
* NI LabView, NI CVI, NI TestStand, C\#
* Design of mix signal circuits
* High speed serial networks
* An appreciation of RF electronics
* Knowledge of power supply design

**Behaviours:**

* Ability to work individually and in a team.
* Innovative thinker and problem solver.
* Ability to effectively research and solve complex technical issues.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively with customer representatives from a variety of backgrounds, ranging from junior to the most senior levels whilst displaying a confident, polite and professional demeanour at all times.
* Good attention to detail.
* Flexible and adaptable

**What We Offer \& Work Culture:**

* Competitive salary
* Welcome / Joining Bonus of £7\.5k \*
* Relocation support \*
* 37hr working week, with an early finish Friday or compressed hours, start your weekend early!
* 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, opportunity to buy / sell / roll over up to 5 days, and up to 5 days volunteering annually.
* Contributory Pension Scheme (up to 10\.5% company contribution)
* Company bonus scheme (discretionary).
* 6 times salary ‘Life Assurance’ with pension.
* Flexible Benefits scheme with extensive salary sacrifice schemes, including Health Cashplan, Dental, and Cycle to Work amongst others.
* Enhanced sick pay.
* Enhanced family friendly policies including enhanced maternity, paternity \& shared parental leave.

 **Why join Raytheon?**


Raytheon UK is a powerhouse in defence and aerospace, where innovation meets impact. As a key partner to the UK government and global customers, we tackle the toughest challenges across land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace. Beyond cutting\-edge defence solutions, we lead the way in digital training transformation for both military and commercial clients.


At Raytheon UK, you will work with pioneering technology, collaborate with top industry experts, and be part of a dynamic team that fuels your growth. Whether you're looking to push boundaries, develop your skills, or make a real\-world impact, your future starts here.


The manufacture of Control Actuation Systems, Guidance Electronic Units and Power Products. The UK’s only Global Factory for UK \& US missile programmes. The provision of GPS Anti\-Jamming systems across domains. Raytheon UK’s long heritage of AJ GPS Technology can be found on land, air and maritime platforms.
