jobs.title: Software Developer | Energy Trading Operations
jobs.description:
**About Marex**

Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world's major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 3,000 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas.


For more information visit https://www.marex.com/


Vacancy Number: VN3065 \& VN3127


**Department description**

Marex has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology\-led service provides access to all major exchanges, order\-flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award\-winning data, insights, and analytics.


This role sits within the Technology department reporting to the Global IT Service Manager. Technology is central to the success of our organisation. The 290\+ strong global Technology Department and delivers differentiation, scalability and security for the business. Technology provides digital tools, software services and infrastructure globally to all business groups. Software development and application support teams work in agile ‘streams' aligned to specific business areas. Our other teams work enterprise\-wide to provide critical services including our global service desk, network and system infrastructure, IT operations, design, enterprise architecture and information security.


The Software Development function creates and maintains applications, frameworks and other software components to deliver to business requirements. Developers conceive, specify, design, engineer, document, test, and deliver bug fixes as needed to provide high quality software solutions. Each Development team is aligned to one of Marex's business divisions and works for that division under Head of Technology and corresponding Application Support team.


**Role Summary**


As a Software Developer specializing in C\# .NET or React, you will be a pivotal member of our Software Development team, contributing to the creation and enhancement of secure, responsive web applications tailored for front\-to\-back trading technology. Your expertise in C\# .NET or React and your strong emphasis on testing will be instrumental in delivering robust and reliable applications. In this role, you will use your architectural experience to help mature our existing software and efficiently migrate legacy platforms to the cloud, working closely with the platform engineering team to ensure seamless integration and deployment.


**Responsibilities**


***Role specific:***


* Design, code and test all components of modern web applications.
* Contribute to the overall architecture and design of the technology created/maintained by the development delivery team.
* Develop solutions to a high standard that is maintainable, testable and meets the requirement's acceptance criteria.
* Adhere to development best practices and processes.
* Communicate with team members, introduce ideas and keep abreast of the latest technologies.
* Liaise with business users to gather application requirements.
* Ensure delivered systems are of production quality. Ensure software is adequately documented for handover to the business.
* Follow coding standards and defined development process.
* Resolve third line support issues in a professional and timely manner.
* Be pragmatic \& delivery focused.
* Ensure solutions are not over engineered, always lean towards simplicity over unnecessary complexity


***All staff:***


* Ensuring compliance with the company's regulatory requirements under the FCA, NFA, AMF, AFM, MAS.
* Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
* Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
* At all times complying with the FCA's Code of Conduct
* To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility
* To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required
* To escalate risk events immediately
* To provide input to risk management processes, as required.

***Competencies, Skills, Experience \& Qualifications:***


**Skills and Experience:**

**Essential:**


* Experience in C\# .NET, React/Angular, JavaScript, Typescript
* Experience of NoSQL or RDMS databases
* Infrastructure as Code, Terraform or equivalent
* Modern CI/CD and DevOps practices
* Cloud technology, ideally AWS (Amazon Web Services)
* Knowledge of BDD/TDD
* Agile and scrum development methodologies
* Methodical approach to software architecture and design, and employing the right design choices for a given project
* Enforcing engineering standards using SOLID, GoF patterns
* Applying best practices for security, scalability, resiliency and performance
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills


**Desirable:**

* Docker, Kubernetes, Messaging frameworks
* Event\-driven or streaming architectures
* Observability
* Working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the financial markets
* Understanding of commodities trading concepts


**Competencies:**


* A collaborative team player, approachable, self\-efficient and influences a positive work environment
* Demonstrates curiosity
* Resilient in a challenging, fast\-paced environment
* Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing others
* Strategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness


**Conduct Rules****,** You must:


* Act with integrity
* Act with due skill, care and diligence
* Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators
* Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly
* Observe proper standard of market conduct
* Act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers


**Company Values**

**Be collaborative** \- by working together across the organisation, we foster teamwork, can better respond to challenges and successfully deliver for our clients


**Act with integrity** \- we pride ourselves on our honesty and high ethical standards. We apply these values when working with all our clients, colleagues and other stakeholders


**Be adaptable and entrepreneurial** \- we embrace change as markets evolve to constantly increase our efficiency and create innovative solutions for our clients. We are interested in the world around us and inquisitive about understanding the challenges and opportunities our clients face.


**Be respectful** – how we treat each other, and our clients says everything about who we are. We always act respectfully and treat people fairly in everything we do.


**Nurture talent** – we aim to grow our own talent and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking and talented people choose to build their career. This means giving and taking stretch opportunities, taking risks, and committing to career development and support – for ourselves, and our teams.


Marex is fully committed to being an inclusive employer and providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all. We will provide reasonable adjustments to remove any disadvantage to you being considered for this role. We value the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company. We welcome applications from candidates returning to the workforce. Also, Marex is committed to avoiding circumstances in which the appearance or possibility of conflicts of interest may exist within the hiring process.


If you would like to receive any information in a different way or would like us to do anything differently to help you, please include it in your application.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

To create revolutionary, story\-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind\-the\-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members!

 **Job Description**  

Join CD PROJEKT RED and help shape the future of QA Engineering across our projects and Shared Development Services initiatives. We’re looking for a **Senior QA Engineer** to help build and scale technical quality solutions, automation frameworks and testing infrastructure used across multiple Unreal Engine projects.


You will be part of the QA Engineering team within Shared Development Services (SDS) \- a shared technical group focused on improving quality, testability and development workflows through automation, reusable tooling and standardized testing platforms.


While the priority for this role will initially be supporting the development of Witcher 4 this is not a project\-dedicated position. Your work will contribute to long\-term cross\-project QA Engineering solutions and shared technical capabilities used across the studio.


This is an opportunity to join at the early stages of a highly innovative game and play a key role in shaping scalable QA engineering practices from the ground up. You will work closely with development teams to build and maintain automated testing solutions, testing environments and shared technical tooling supporting multiple teams and gameplay systems.

**Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with Engineering, Tech Art, Art, QA, DevOps, and central development services teams to support integration and deployment of automated testing solutions, shared tooling, and testing environments across projects.
* Design, develop, maintain, and extend automated test frameworks and testing infrastructure for Unreal Engine systems and reusable gameplay modules.
* Support migration, integration, and validation of shared automation solutions between different projects and development environments.
* Investigate, debug, and resolve technical issues related to automation, integrations, testing environments, CI/CD pipelines, and build infrastructure.
* Participate in the code review process and contribute to maintaining high engineering standards across QA automation codebases.
* Work closely with development teams to improve testability, reliability, scalability, and long\-term maintainability of shared systems.
* Proactively monitor and maintain CI/CD pipelines, ensuring rapid identification and resolution of build and test failures.

 **Qualifications*** 4\+ years of experience in QA Engineering, test automation, or software testing, preferably within the gaming industry.
* C\+\+ experience, especially within Unreal Engine environments.
* Knowledge of working with automated testing, tooling, and testing infrastructure in Unreal Engine environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated test frameworks and testing solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, debug, and troubleshoot complex technical issues across systems, integrations, and development environments.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple disciplines and teams.
* Comfortable owning tasks and asking for input when needed with a strong sense of curiosity toward solving technical challenges.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience shipping an Unreal Engine\-based game for Xbox or PlayStation consoles.
* Prior experience with Unreal Engine, or a very strong understanding of Unreal from the development side, not limited to automated test work.
* Experience with containerization and cloud technologies (e.g., Docker, AWS, GCP).
* Experience with programming and scripting skills using languages such as Python, TypeScript or C\#.
* Experience with performance profiling, debugging or validation tooling within Unreal Engine environments.
* Experience with asset processing and validation pipelines, digital content authoring tools, or other proprietary game engine tools.
* Experience supporting shared tooling, reusable systems, or cross\-project technical initiatives.
* Experience working with CI/CD systems and automation pipelines.

 **Additional Information** **Working mode**


In\-office in a hybrid or full\-time capacity in Warsaw, Poland.

**Health \& Well\-Being**

* Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives.
* Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones.
* Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company.
* Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well\-being initiatives.
* Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city.
* Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain.
* RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family\-friendly events.
* RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company.

**Perks \& Professional Growth**

* A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team.
* Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge\-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e\-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn!
* REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement.

Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag!  
* 

**Social Activities \& Life in the Office**

* Dog\-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio.
* Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together.
* Healthy selections — canteens.
* Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world.
* Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog.
* A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them.
* An onsite, well\-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes.
* No dress\-code — we like to keep it casual.

 **Estimated pay range for this position:** 17 800 – 27 800 PLN gross monthly.  

Final offers are dependent on job\-related factors like experience and qualifications.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Are you an experienced backend developer with a curious mindset?** Do you have a passion for building intuitive, cutting\-edge solutions with state\-of\-the\-art technology?


At LeoVegas, we’re on a mission to deliver the greatest iGaming experience to our customers and technology is at the heart of making that happen.


As part of our Retention domain, you’ll play a key role in developing the platforms and features that keep players engaged and coming back for more.


This is a great opportunity to join a fast\-moving, flat\-structured team as a Senior Backend Engineer, where your work will directly shape value\-generating features across our products.


The Retention team powers the organisation with communication capabilities, ranging from indirect and direct communication with the players to a custom\-built toolbox that enriches the player journey with bonuses, loyalty programs, and seamless cross\-channel experiences. As one of the most crucial parts of the player lifecycle, the Retention domain ensures our players return for new, exciting, and rewarding experiences.


We’re driven by excellence and fuelled by innovation now we’re looking for someone who wants to be part of that journey.

 **YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:**

* Building scalable, robust and efficient solutions in our full\-stack team and ensure the continuous delivery in our microservice architecture.
* Being involved in technical discussions to challenge, propose, evaluate, and take a guiding and supportive approach to business needs.
* Working closely with our operational units and stakeholders.
* Driving your own initiatives with a high\-quality mindset.
* Working within the full chain of development, having end\-to\-end responsibilities.
* Collaborative work across the organisation with other domains.
* Making sure our IT ecology is scalable and ready for upcoming expansions.

 **OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:**


ESSENTIAL SKILLS

* Minimum of 6\+ years of experience working as a back\-end developer with Java and/or Kotlin
* Experience with messaging tools (i.e. Kafka)
* Experience with microservice architecture
* You have experience with common Java frameworks such as Spring and JPA
* MySQL relational databases are not something new for you
* Experience with AI tools like Claude

  

NICE TO HAVES

* Experience with OpenAPI
* Experience with BigQuery
* Experience with Kubernetes

 **WHO WE ARE**


At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the iGaming industry. We’re a team of almost 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast\-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.

 **BENEFITS**

* Hybrid work policy (3 days a week from the office)
* 4 weeks of Workation (T\&C apply)
* Benefits package \- 800 PLN net (B2B)/gross (UOP) monthly with access to the cafeteria platform (private medical care, insurances, sports card)
* Training budget
* ICAS assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments.
* Our office provides complimentary snacks and drinks; on Mondays, we serve complimentary breakfast.
* Team and office social events throughout the year
* Free parking for bicycles and motorcycles
* Free gym in the building
* Equipment: MacBook Pro \+ smartphone (iPhone 16/17 or Samsung Galaxy S25\)

 **JOIN US!**


In our pride, we like to empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait around for things to happen. We pounce and make it happen!


Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride \- give us a roar!

jobs.title: .NET Backend Developer — 6-Month Project (NXJ-204)
jobs.description:
**The Role**
------------

As a Backend Engineer at our client, you will contribute directly to the core index layer, processing video indexing based on signals from the algorithm team. Your work will power the auto\-tagging engine—the system that splits sports games into distinct events and accurately assigns start and end times to each action. You will balance deep feature development with critical problem\-solving in a highly collaborative, AI\-integrated environment.


**About the Product**
---------------------


The product is an AI\-powered sports media platform used by major sports organizations to transform live broadcasts into personalized digital content at scale. Every live stream is continuously ingested, analyzed, and enriched with AI\-generated metadata, enabling automatic detection of key moments, intelligent video indexing, and near real\-time content creation.


Behind the scenes, the platform processes massive volumes of live and archived video 24/7, powering personalized fan experiences across web, mobile, social, and broadcast channels. The backend infrastructure is built for extreme throughput, low\-latency processing, and elastic scaling, combining distributed microservices with production\-grade ML inference pipelines to deliver reliable performance under unpredictable traffic peaks.


**Team Structure \& Collaboration:**

You will join a focused backend squad consisting of four developers, one QA, and one PM, led by the engineering manager. This squad sits within a larger group of two backend teams and two algorithm teams. Because the index layer relies heavily on algorithm signals, you will work in close daily collaboration with the AI and algorithm teams.  



**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* **Video Indexing \& Auto\-Tagging:** Build and maintain the C\#/.NET backend infrastructure that interprets algorithm signals to index videos and auto\-tag live sports events
* **Technical Leadership:** Elevate the team by actively participating in design discussions, driving code review standards, and mentoring fellow developers
* **On\-Call Rotation:** Participate in a shared on\-call pool (approximately one week every five weeks). While critical nighttime or weekend outages are rare, you must remain reachable and have access to a laptop to respond to operations team escalations
* **Proactivity:** Execute tasks independently, demonstrate strong problem\-solving skills, and maintain prompt, proactive communication via Slack with the Israel\-based team

**What We Expect**
------------------


* Strong proficiency in C\# and .NET, with **5\+ years** **of commercial .NET experience**
* Hands\-on experience developing within **Azure** cloud environments
* Familiarity with and daily use of **AI\-assisted engineering tools** (e.g., Claude, Cursor)
* Excellent interpersonal skills with a proven ability to mentor peers and lead design discussions
* **High autonomy**, independent task execution, and proactive communication habits for effective distributed collaboration
* Familiarity with event\-driven messaging services such as **Azure Service Bus** or **Kafka**
* Working knowledge of **SQL databases** (general proficiency; specific engines do not matter)
* Basic familiarity with **DevOps terminology** and **Kubernetes** (operational expertise is not required)
* Willingness to work in a hybrid mode, **3 days from the office in Warsaw**

**Why This Role Is Worth Your Time**
------------------------------------


* Direct ownership of pure backend compute at scale—no full\-stack dilution, focusing entirely on high\-load microservices, indexing engines, and real\-time processing
* High\-autonomy environment with modern workflows where AI tools (Claude, Cursor) are embraced to eliminate boilerplate and keep focus on architecture

  
### **Category**


.Net · Backend · SaaS


### **Type**


### **Location**


hybrid · Poland · Warsaw

jobs.title: System Architect
jobs.description:
**Location:** EU remote

#### **About the Role:**


As a member of Auditdata's Architecture Group, you will join a highly skilled engineering organization building enterprise\-grade solutions for audiology clinic chains worldwide. You will shape integrations, domain boundaries, system design, and platform evolution across our SaaS product portfolio.

**Our tech stack** includes .NET, React ecosystem, Azure Servises (AKS, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure SQL Database).


#### **What You Will Do:**

**Integration \& API Architecture:**

* Define and maintain Manage’s integration strategy (REST, Events, APIs, Data Feeds).
* Design standard integration patterns — real\-time (Event Hubs), on\-demand (REST), hybrid workflows.
* Lead technical workshops with customers and partners to gather requirements and define integration approaches.
* Align integrations with domain boundaries, data contracts, and platform security standards.
* Govern message contracts, event schemas, versioning strategy, and error\-handling models.
* Enforce security best practices (OAuth2, mTLS, Azure AD, Key Vault).
* Oversee monitoring, observability, and integration reliability (tracking, retries, DLQs).

**Domain \& System Architecture:**

* Serve as the technical consultant for assigned domains, ensuring architectural integrity and consistent domain boundaries.
* Shape domain models and identify bounded contexts, aggregates, and integration points.
* Define APIs and event contracts across microservices and cross\-domain workflows.
* Evaluate epics and initiatives for architectural feasibility and appropriate service ownership.
* Support teams with high\-level design, technology selection, and patterns.
* Participate in architecture reviews and platform governance.
* Coach teams on DDD, Clean Architecture, and best engineering practices.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, specifications, interface documentation, and ADRs.

**Platform \& Multi\-Tenancy:**

* Design and own the architecture of a secure, performant, and cost\-efficient multi\-tenancy model.
* Contribute to the long\-term architecture vision and support the evolution of the platform strategy.

**Customer \& Pre\-Sales Engagement:**

* Participate in pre\-sales work, technical scoping, and early\-stage solution shaping.
* Support troubleshooting and performance improvements for complex integrations or distributed system issues.

#### **What You Will Bring:**


Technical Skills \& Experience:

* Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate architectural decisions to both leadership and engineering teams.
* Experience with integration architectures (Azure Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure Functions, REST APIs, Webhooks).
* Practical knowledge of **microservices** and **event\-driven architectures.**
* Solid understanding of **Domain\-Driven Design** and **Clean Architecture.**
* Proven ability to produce high\-quality technical documentation and diagrams (Miro, Lucid, C4, Event Catalog).
* Comfortable in customer\-facing technical discussions.
* Strong background in Azure Cloud services.
* Ability to enforce architectural standards through ADRs, reviews, and quality gates.
* Familiarity with governance, audit logging, and proactive system health monitoring.
* Ability to collaborate with Product and Delivery teams to align architecture with the roadmap and business vision.
* Fluent English.


Preferred:

* 10\+ years in software engineering, including 5\+ years in architecture roles within enterprise SaaS.
* Proven experience modernizing or commercializing legacy platforms into scalable, multi\-tenant products.
* Demonstrated success designing enterprise\-grade integrations.
* Degree in Computer Science or a similar field.


Nice\-to\-Haves:

* Experience with MassTransit.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/ML, LLMs, or agent\-based architectures (semantic search, intelligent document processing, workflow automation).
* Azure Cloud certifications.
* Strong understanding of security and compliance for medical or regulated data (HIPAA, GDPR).
* .NET and React familiarity.


Key Traits:

* Strong leadership, ownership, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to solve complex technical challenges and provide clear direction.
* A consistent focus on continuous learning — both personal and team\-wide.
* A mindset that promotes cross\-team alignment, technical excellence, and architectural consistency.

#### **What’s in It for You:**

* Long\-term engagement in a stable, growing SaaS company.
* High engineering and product standards.
* Flexible environment with a flat organizational structure.
* Professional development opportunities, including certification support.
* A global, diverse, and highly skilled team across Denmark, Ukraine, UK, Poland, Canada, Australia, USA, and more.
* A culture that values personal growth as much as business outcomes.


You don’t match the description 100%? Please don’t hold back! We would love to hear from you.


We’re looking for someone who finds the role challenging and exciting and wants to grow in this role.


We look forward to your application! *(****please submit your CV in English****)*

 *Auditdata is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to create diverse work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills.*

jobs.title: Full-stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
AirHelp is a global travel tech company on a mission to make every journey smoother. We built our name helping millions of travellers claim the flight compensation they're owed \- and that's now the foundation of a broader platform of travel protection and convenience products spanning the entire journey.


We are looking for a product\-minded Full\-stack Software Engineer to join our Claiming Experience team, responsible for the journey that helps travellers start, complete, and submit their claims with confidence.


It's one of the highest\-leverage surfaces in the company. What happens here moves submission rates, traveller trust, and the cost and speed of everything that happens downstream \- legal, documents, operations, comms. Small wins compound.


The claiming journey is a real product problem that happens to span frontend, backend, experimentation, document and signature flows, legal requirements, partner integrations, and production reliability. You'll own meaningful parts of it end to end, working day to day with engineers, PMs, designers, data analysts, and QA.


This is a hybrid role based in Kraków or Gdańsk.


Salary:

* If you join us as a full\-time employee: 14\.000 \- 20\.000 PLN gross/month
* If you join us as a contractor (for specific projects): 15\.000 \- 25\.000 PLN net \+ VAT on a B2B contract


What you can expect from us* Opportunity to build high\-leverage features and tooling for the core business domains that directly impact the travel experience for millions of users.
* Culture that promotes good engineering practices, high\-quality code, and continuous improvement.
* Daily deployments to production, ensuring fast impact and iterative development.
* Access to a modern tech stack and a variety of functional areas, including:
* + Backend: : Node.js and Ruby on Rails
	+ Frontend: TypeScript\-first React ecosystem (Vite, Turborepo, TanStack Query/Table, Zod)
	+ Databases: PostgreSQL
	+ Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform.
	+ Monitoring: ELK/Grafana, Sentry, GitHub Actions CI/CD
	+ Testing: Bruno (API), Playwright (E2E), k6 (performance)


What you'll achieve:* Build and evolve the core claiming flows, across frontend and backend, all the way to production.
* Work with Product, Design, and Data to spot friction, frame the problem, and ship measurable improvements.
* Design and run experiments that lift submission rates and reduce confusion and make it easier and safer for the whole team to do the same.
* Integrate the claiming flow with the systems around it: documents, comms, claim processing, partner APIs, internal tooling.
* Modernise the legacy parts of the journey so the team can move faster with less risk.
* Raise the bar on reliability and observability for these flows, so we catch and fix issues before they cost a traveller their claim.
* Hold the line on engineering quality through reviews, testing, and pragmatic technical decisions.
* Use AI\-assisted workflows where they genuinely speed you up or improve the work.

  

A year in, you'll have measurably improved how many eligible travellers complete their claims, made experimentation faster and safer, and simplified enough of the codebase that the team ships with more confidence than it does today.

 **Requirements**  

  

What sets you apart:* 4\+ years building and owning client\-facing production apps where reliability, performance, and conversion actually matter.
* Strong in at least one of our core technologies: TypeScript/React, Ruby/Rails, Node.js and willing to work across the stack.
* A product instinct: you care whether the code solved the right problem, not just whether it shipped.
* Comfortable across the full lifecycle: framing, building, testing, deploying, monitoring, iterating with the testing discipline to back it.
* Solid with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL.
* An ownership mindset: you go looking for the important problems instead of waiting for a perfect ticket.
* Clear communicator in English, written and spoken.

  

**Benefits**  

  

Why AirHelp* Fast Impact: We deploy daily \- your code reaches millions quickly.
* Autonomy: High trust, zero politics. We hire builders, not order takers.
* Growth: Learning days, personal development plans, workshops, mentorship, and language classes.
* Perks: Private healthcare, non\-service days, wellness budget, travel stipend, gym/transport subsidy, free access to AirHelp services, and more.


At AirHelp, we're on a mission to make the world of travel better. Since our foundation in 2013, we've assisted over 2\.7 million passengers in receiving their rightful compensation, and we've protected over 9 million travelers through our membership program, AirHelp\+. With a global team of 400 AirHelpers speaking 19 languages, we aim to provide a stress\-free travel experience for all. Our commitment extends to standing up to airlines in court and advocating fair air passenger rights through APRA.


And there’s more! AirHelp isn’t just a great company, but a truly lovable place to work. That's why we're so proud to have been named a , also for LGBTQ\+, women and young professionals.


Our offices are fully accessible, and we customize interviews to accommodate special needs, including those of neurodiverse candidates. Refugees and displaced individuals are encouraged to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Junior Software Developer who wants to grow in modern software development and help build digital solutions for restaurants and foodtech.
  
This role is for you if you have a solid foundation in programming and want hands\-on experience building, testing, and maintaining software with experienced developers and other team members.
  
You’ll work across multiple product areas and contribute to solutions used in everyday restaurant operations—such as POS, online ordering, kitchen screens, self\-service kiosks, payments, and integrations.
  
About the role
  
As a Junior Software Developer, you’ll be part of our development team—developing, improving, and maintaining our digital products.
  
You’ll participate in the full development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and planning solutions to writing code, testing, troubleshooting, and following up on deliveries.
  
You’ll work closely with senior developers, product owners, QA, and other team members to deliver solutions with high quality, great user experience, and stable operations.
  
What you’ll do
  
Develop and maintain features in our web and backend solutions.
  
Write clean, structured, and testable code.
  
Participate in planning, estimation, and technical discussions.
  
Troubleshoot and analyze bugs in development and production.
  
Write and update unit and integration tests.
  
Contribute to building AI solutions.
  
Work with APIs, databases, and system integrations.
  
Review code with colleagues and give/receive feedback constructively.
  
Continuously improve development practices, code quality, and documentation.
  
  

What we’re looking for
  
Post\-secondary education in software development, computer science, or equivalent knowledge.
  
Basic programming experience (e.g., JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C\#, Python, or similar).
  
Understanding of object\-oriented programming, data structures, and core software architecture.
  
Basic knowledge of databases, REST APIs, and Git version control.
  
Understanding of testing, debugging, and agile development methods.
  
Ability to communicate in English, both written and spoken.
  
A drive to learn, take ownership, and grow with the team.
  
  

Nice to have
  
Experience with React, Node.js, Java, TypeScript, or other modern frameworks.
  
Experience with cloud services, CI/CD, or containers.
  
Experience with SQL, relational databases, or message\-based integrations.
  
Personal projects, open\-source contributions, or relevant internship/work experience.
  
Experience building web applications, SaaS solutions, payments, POS systems, or e\-commerce platforms.
  
Interest in AI tools and how they can be used for development, testing, and product innovation.
  
  

Who you are
  
You’re curious and solution\-oriented—you like understanding how things work. You take initiative, ask questions when something is unclear, and use feedback to improve.
  
You work in a structured way and care about code quality, testing, and documentation, while also enjoying collaboration and sharing knowledge.
  
You don’t need to know everything from day one. The key is a strong technical foundation, genuine interest in software development, and the desire to grow in the role.
  
About us
  
We build digital systems used every day by restaurants and foodtech companies—POS, online ordering, self\-service kiosks, payments, integrations, and customer\-facing tools.
  
Our products operate in environments where stability, performance, and usability are critical. That’s why we work closely with customers and product teams to create solutions that make restaurant operations easier and more efficient.
  
Here, you’ll develop as a developer, work on real products, and be part of a team building the future of the digital restaurant experience.

* Passionate about engineering excellence and emerging technologies.

**Feel rewarded**

And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. We're actively recruiting a Senior Backend Engineer to help scale M\-KOPA Mobility, our fast\-growing e\-mobility business.** **This is an initial 12\-month Fixed Term Contract, with the potential to extend or transition into a permanent role. Build the event\-driven microservices that power clean, affordable transport for riders and entrepreneurs across Africa.**

**The Impact** – Africa's transport sector is massive, underserved, and at an inflection point, and the transition to electric is accelerating, led by East Africa. Your code will directly power the technology behind Kenya's leading e\-mobility financing platform. We've already financed over 11,000 electric motorbikes, helping riders save more than $3 a day and cutting air pollution by 90%. It's your chance to build tech for a business that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent


**The Opportunity**


**Mission\-driven engineering:** Every service you build helps put clean transport within reach of riders who'd otherwise be locked out of ownership


**Global recognition:** Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest\-growing companies for 5 consecutive years running (2022–2026\)


**Scale challenges:** Build backend systems for a business growing at 3x year\-on\-year, with over 11,000 e\-motorbikes financed and demand climbing


**Real climate impact:** Electric is simply better for drivers, cities, and the planet — our e\-motorbikes cut air pollution by 90% versus petrol equivalents

At M\-KOPA, you'll build sophisticated event\-driven microservices with real\-world impact. Our engineering teams own their solutions end\-to\-end – from architecture decisions to production monitoring. Join us in combining cutting\-edge .NET development with purpose\-driven engineering that makes digital and financial inclusion possible across Africa.

* **Languages \& frameworks:** C\#/.NET
* **Cloud:** We work in Azure, and welcome experience across AWS or GCP
* **Architecture:** Event\-driven systems and microservice development – we use Service Bus, and welcome experience with similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ

* **Observability:** Prometheus, Grafana

* **AI tooling:** We use AI coding tools including Claude Code as part of our engineering workflow

As an engineer, you will work as a collaborator. More senior members will coach and contribute, placing an emphasis on:

* High quality output
* Observability and monitoring
* Automated testing in all environments, including production
* Infrastructure as code and DevOps practices

**What You Need**


We expect you to be comfortable working as part of a team which owns the entire software stack, including supporting infrastructure, throughout the entire software lifecycle, from inception through production to decommissioning under a DevOps culture. You'll value the constraints that continuous delivery places upon engineering processes and embrace testing and observability as first\-order concerns in development.


Required Experience:

* Strong grasp of C\# .NET development
* Experience with event\-driven systems – Service Bus or similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
* Microservices architecture experience
* Experience with Azure, or other major cloud providers such as AWS or GCP
* Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration tools (Kubernetes, Docker)
* Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
* Testing and deployment expertise
* DevOps culture mindset
* Experience working with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code or similar

**Location \& Benefits**

* Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa
* Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
* Family\-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
* Well\-being support and career growth opportunities

**Our Mission** We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer\-centric financing model, with M\-KOPA Mobility extending that same model to clean transport. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low\-income communities.

**Our Impact**

* **Connected :** 6 million smartphone customers, 2\.5 million first\-time smartphone users
* **Prosperous :** 70% of customers use their M\-KOPA product for income generation, with 35,000\+ livelihoods created for agents
* **Green :** 11,000\+ e\-motorbikes financed, growing 3x year\-on\-year, cutting air pollution by 90% and helping riders save more than $3 a day

**At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritise well\-being, and embrace flexibility.**

At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritize well\-being, and embrace flexibility.


Join us in shaping the future of M\-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at **m\-kopa.com**.

jobs.title: Systems Development Engineer II, Amazon Robotics Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Amazon Robotics Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Systems Development Engineer to join our team. We build and operate the network and services that enable Amazon Fulfillment Centers, Middle and Last Mile facilities, including Air hubs, and PrimeNow to deliver packages to Amazon retail customers. From two million square foot automated robotics fulfillment centers to small last\-mile delivery stations in emerging markets, these networks are the backbone of Amazon Operations. Hundreds of thousands of associates rely upon these networks at thousands of locations, and are critical to the delivery of shipments to Amazon retail customers.  

  

Our mission is to design, deploy, and enable networks that sets the global standard for performance, availability, security and cost, enabling Fulfillment and Logistic operations to deliver on time, every customer order. We are looking for a Systems Development Engineer to create next\-generation network products. The team is focused on creating in\-house networks from leveraging open source tools and projects. We partner closely with IT support teams to ensure that simplicity in our product designs translate to operational readiness in the field. Information security rigor is at the core of everything we do. You will tackle complex, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. It is expected that you will be technically pioneering, while at the same time being balanced and pragmatic in your approach. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot and make a positive impact on millions of people.  

  

The right candidate will have demonstrated experience leading large projects and have an expert level technical background in current networking technologies. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or multiple priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high\-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done. As a Systems Development Engineer, you will anticipate bottlenecks, influence external vendors and internal team roadmaps, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Systems Development Engineer you will be expected to:  

* Write code for our most demanding, cross\-functional networking projects.
* Functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straight\-forward solutions.
* Fully and completely comprehend system inter\-connections and limitations.
* Effectively research and benchmark Amazon technology against other systems in the industry.
* Contribute intellectual property through patents.
* Assist in the career development of others, actively mentoring individuals and the community on advanced technical issues and helping managers guide the career growth of their team members.

  

A day in the life  

You will partner with Network, Software and Systems development Engineers to deliver automation for building and decommissioning the network infrastructure. Additionally create new tools or improve existing ones for network operators.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large\-scale infrastructure
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C\+\+, C\#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience with networking fundamentals including hands\-on experience with load balancers, switches, routers, etc.
* Experience working in an Agile environment

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Om jobben**
-------------

Vis flere detaljer

  

Søk senest søndag 4\. oktober

  

**Vil du utvikle løsninger som bidrar til å varsle flom, skred og andre naturfarer?** I Norges vassdrags\- og energidirektorat (NVE) får du bruke teknologien din til å løse samfunnsoppgaver som betyr noe for folk.


Vi styrker utviklermiljøet vårt og søker to backend\-utviklere til team naturfag i utviklingsseksjonen. Teamet utvikler fagsystemer og varslingstjenester basert på data om blant annet flom, skred, snø, målinger og prognoser. Løsningene våre er viktige verktøy for NVEs arbeid med naturfare og bidrar til økt trygghet og beredskap i samfunnet. Seksjonen består av rundt 30 utviklere og designere fordelt på to fagområder – energi og naturfag.


Team naturfag leverer fagsystemer for håndtering av naturfaglige data som flom, skred, snø, måle\- og prognosedata og flomsikring. Vi står også bak varslingstjenester som mange er avhengige av. Dataene og løsningene våre er grunnlag for beregninger som gjør at NVE kan varsle naturfare og bidra til at folk kan ferdes trygt i naturen.


Du vil først og fremst jobbe med backend\-utvikling, men også bidra på frontend. Sammen med teamet utvikler du sikre, stabile og brukervennlige løsninger som forvalter og tilgjengeliggjør viktige data for samfunnet.

  

  

#### **Arbeidsoppgaver**


**Du vil jobbe med:**
* utvikling av backend\-applikasjoner i .NET
* utvikling av frontend\-applikasjoner i Javascript (Vue)
* utvikling av SQL\- og databaseløsninger
* integrasjon mot NVEs GIS\-plattform (ArcGIS, ESRI)

**Sammen med teamet vil du bidra til:**
* kompetansedeling på tvers av team og fagområder
* dokumentasjon av prosesser og rutiner
* å utvikle sikre, stabile og brukervennlige løsninger med høy kvalitet

Aller viktigst er det at du er nysgjerrig og liker å sette deg inn i nye problemstillinger. Vi er i gang med å modernisere flere av løsningene våre, og du får være med på denne reisen. Hvis du ønsker det, kan du også bli med ut i felt for å se hvordan dataene samles inn og brukes i praksis.


#### **Kvalifikasjoner**


* utdanning på bachelor\- eller masternivå innen IT, teknologi eller tilsvarende. Relevant arbeidserfaring kan kompensere for manglende formell utdanning
* god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
* sikkerhetsmessig skikkethet for stillingen

Det er nødvendig med autorisering eller sikkerhetsklarering fordi stillingen innebærer å håndtere og behandle sikkerhetsgradert informasjon. For å klareres må du fylle ut en personopplysningsblankett og samtykke til personkontroll.


Prosessen med sikkerhetsklarering eller autorisering starter ikke før du eventuelt er ansatt hos oss. Du kan lese mer om hva autorisering og sikkerhetsklarering innebærer på nsm.no./ Du kan lese mer om hva som inngår i personopplysningsblanketten på lovdata.no.  

  



**Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med følgende områder:**  

  



* kartbiblioteker (ArcGIS, Leaflet eller lignende)
* SQL\- og databaseløsninger, Microsoft SQL Server
* Linux
* infrastruktur som kode (IaC)
* Docker
* kunnskap om UX og universell utforming
* erfaring med smidig utviklingsmetodikk og teamarbeid
* kunnskap om sikkerhet og sikker utvikling

#### **Personlige egenskaper**


* tar ansvar for egne leveranser og er opptatt av kvalitet og robuste løsninger
* er nysgjerrig, strukturert og liker å sette deg inn i nye problemstillinger
* samarbeider godt med andre og bidrar til kunnskapsdeling

Personlig egnethet tillegges stor vekt.
#### **Vi tilbyr**


Som medarbeider i NVE blir du del av et sterkt fagmiljø med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag. Vi er opptatt av at alle i NVE skal oppleve personlig og faglig utvikling, trives på jobb over tid og ha det godt på jobb i alle livsfaser. Vi ønsker oss medarbeidere med ulike erfaringer og perspektiver sånn at vi kan løse oppgavene våre på best mulig måte.


**Hos oss får du:**
* meningsfulle oppgaver med innflytelse på viktige samfunnsområder, i en sterk og tverrfaglig kunnskapsorganisasjon
* en hverdag der læring står på planen – tid til å lære nye teknikker, metoder og teknologier sammen med dyktige og hyggelige kolleger
* moderne, nyoppussede lokaler sentralt på Majorstuen i Oslo
* fleksible arbeidstidsordninger (fleksitid, sommertid, betalt overtid) og mulighet for hjemmekontor etter avtale
* eget treningsrom, trening i arbeidstiden og et aktivt bedriftsidrettslag
* gode pensjons\-, forsikrings\- og låneordninger i Statens pensjonskasse
* ansettelse i stillingskode avdelings\-/over\-/senioringeniør (1085/1087/1181\) og en årslønn mellom kr 600 000 og 1000 000\. For spesielt kvalifiserte kan høyere lønn vurderes. Fra lønnen trekkes pensjonsinnskudd etter gjeldende regler.
* vi er en gjeng med stor variasjon i alder, arbeidserfaring og kjønn, og har et aktivt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø. Vi har lønningstreff en gang i måneden, og mange møtes til fritidsaktiviteter som klatring, løping, brettspill og kor.

**Viktig informasjon om søkeprosessen**
  

  

Legg ved vitnemål og attester elektronisk til søknaden som dokumentasjon på kompetansen og erfaringen din. Vi sender ikke slike dokumenter tilbake, så sørg for at du har en kopi. Det kan bli behov for en utvidet referansesjekk av søkere som får jobben. Det innebærer en dokument\- og kildekontroll for å bekrefte at dokumentasjonen du har sendt inn, er gyldig.
  

  

I jobbsøkerportalen kan du krysse av hvis du har en funksjonsnedsettelse, hull i CV\-en eller innvandrerbakgrunn. Alle som krysser av på gyldig grunnlag kvalifiserer til positiv særbehandling. Minst en søker fra hvert avkrysningsalternativ blir kalt inn til intervju. Vi anbefaler derfor at du krysser av om du kvalifiserer til det.
  

  

Avkrysningen danner også grunnlag for anonymisert statistikk som alle statlige virksomheter har med i årsrapportene sine. Du kan lese mer om avkrysningen og positiv særbehandling i Arbeidsgiverportalen.
  

  

Søkerlister til statlige stillinger er offentlige. De inneholder navn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bosteds\- eller arbeidskommune for hver søker. Hvis du ikke vil stå på denne listen, må du begrunne det. Vi gir deg beskjed hvis vi likevel ikke kan la være å føre deg opp på listen, og du får mulighet til å trekke søknaden din før den blir offentlig.

----------------


Vi forvalter Norges vann\- og energiressurser til samfunnets beste. Det er vårt ansvar å sørge for at strømmen blir levert, holde tilsyn med kraftbransjen, utvikle regelverk og behandle søknader om konsesjon til fornybar energiproduksjon.


Vi overvåker og varsler om naturfare for å hjelpe samfunnet med å håndtere flom og skredrisiko. Vi er den nasjonale faginstitusjonen for hydrologi og driver med forskning.

Kystverket har et nasjonalt ansvar for trygg og effektiv ferdsel langs hele norskekysten. Skipstrafikken er kompleks, og hver dag skal hundrevis av fartøy navigere sikkert gjennom trange farvann – uten ulykker, forsinkelser eller akutt forurensing. For å bidra til dette utvikler vi digitale tjenester som støtter sjøsikkerhet, fremkommelighet og effektiv sjøtransport.


Nå søker vi en erfaren fullstackutvikler som trives i skjæringspunktet mellom teknologi og tverrfaglige problemstillinger, og som ønsker et meningsfullt samfunnsoppdrag. Hos oss får du jobbe i team sammen med produkteiere, designere, utviklere og domeneeksperter – tett på fagmiljøene. Stillingen er en del av staben for digitalisering og innovasjon og du vil rapportere til direktøren plassert på kontorlokasjon i Ålesund. Staben består i dag av 15 ansatte. Hos oss får du jobbe i et tverrfaglig og inspirerende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kollegaer som samarbeider tett med andre etater, innovasjonsmiljøer og næringslivet.  

  



Vi tilbyr en stabil jobb med gode rammer, rom for faglig utvikling og et arbeidsmiljø med høy takhøyde og engasjerte kolleger. Vi liker teknologi, vi deler kompetanse, og vi heier på hverandre. Kystverket har et voksende teknologimiljø med stort handlingsrom, og vi tilrettelegger for at du kan bygge kompetanse i takt med både egne interesser og Kystverkets behov.

  

  

#### **Arbeidsoppgaver**


* Utvikle og forvalte digitale løsninger som støtter Kystverkets strategiske mål
* Bidrag i tverrfaglige produktteam med ansvar for løsninger i produksjon
* Utvikling av funksjonalitet på tvers av backend, frontend og integrasjoner der det er relevant
* Arbeid med skybaserte løsninger i Azure
* Faglig retningsstyring og veiledning av andre utviklere
* Andre oppgaver kan tillegges

Noe reisevirksomhet må påregnes


#### **Kvalifikasjoner**


* Relevant høyere utdanning på masternivå. Særlig lang og omfattende relevant erfaring kan kompensere for utdanningskravet
* Solid kompetanse innen systemutvikling dokumentert gjennom faglige resultater i relevante stillinger/prosjekter. Av teknologier bruker vi i C\# / .NET 10, React og Terraform. Vi pakker applikasjonene våre i Docker\-containere og kjører de i Azure Container Apps med PostgreSQL som underliggende database. Teamene anvender Github Actions for kvalitetssjekk, bygging og utrullinger. Vi bruker LGTM\-stacken for observabilitet og bruker Grafana aktivt for overvåkning og innsikt.
* God skriftlig og muntlig formuleringsevne på norsk

Du må ha erfaring med


* Utvikling på tvers av applikasjonslag og integrasjoner
* Skybasert utvikling, fortrinnsvis i Azure
* Erfaring med, eller interesse for å ta i bruk AI i utviklingsarbeidet
* Forståelse for kjøretidsmiljø, herunder applikasjonsdrift og containere

  

*Den som blir ansatt må kunne sikkerhetsklareres på nivå hemmelig. Vi opplyser om at klareringsmyndigheten har en streng praksis ved vurdering av nødvendig tilknytning til Norge ifm klarering.*  

  



#### **Personlige egenskaper**


* Innovativ tilnærming, med evne til å se muligheter i ny teknologi og anvende denne
* Nysgjerrig og lærevillig, med ønske om å holde deg oppdatert og utvikle egen kompetanse
* Trygg og selvstendig
* Fleksibel og løsningsorientert
* Gode samarbeids\- og kommunikasjonsferdigheter, og evner å jobbe effektivt på tvers av fagmiljøer

Personlige egenskaper vil bli vektlagt


*Sammen med oss må du kunne identifisere deg med Kystverkets verdier som er fremtidsrettet, engasjert og pålitelig.*
#### **Vi tilbyr**


* Stillingen er plassert i stillingskode 1181 senioringeniør med lønn fra kr 750 000 til kr 870 000 avhengig av kvalifikasjoner. Ev. pålagt overtid kompenseres. For spesielt kvalifiserte kandidater kan høyere lønn vurderes
* Bedriftshelsetjeneste

* Konkurransedyktige vilkår
* God pensjonsordning i Statens pensjonskasse
* Feriehjemsordning ved flere av fyrene til Kystverket
* Kontorsted i våre flotte lokaler i Ålesund. Lokal tilknytning, men nasjonalt ansvar.
* Gode muligheter for egenutvikling / kompetanseutvikling.

  

Dersom du er aktuell kandidat, tilbyr vi omvendt referansesjekk \- du får mulighet til å snakke direkte med folk i teamet før du tar beslutningen. Ta gjerne kontakt om du ønsker mer informasjon om hvordan det er å jobbe som utvikler hos oss.


Vi er opptatt av at våre kollegaer representerer hele befolkningen, og oppfordrer derfor personer med innvandrerbakgrunn, nedsatt funksjonsevne eller hull i CV\-en til å søke.

jobs.title: DevEx Engineer
jobs.description:
**Join AutoProff – Help Shape the Future of Automotive Tech!**

We’re looking for a **DevEx Engineer** to join our **Empower platform squad “Taycan”**. The squad is split between our HQ in Vejle and our Copenhagen office, so the role can be based in either location.



The Taycan squad helps engineers spend more time delivering product value and less time solving the same technical problems. We build shared capabilities that make the preferred engineering path easier to use.



As our new **DevEx Engineer**, you’ll work on the shared tooling, libraries and development patterns used by engineering squads across AutoProff. From scaffolding and shared libraries to patterns such as Outbox, Sagas and messaging, you’ll help make software development simpler and more consistent – so our product squads can spend less time solving the same technical problems and more time building great products.



You’ll work closely with platform engineers, service owners and engineers across our product squads, building solutions that are used across the engineering organisation rather than within just one product area.



Help build shared capabilities and DevEx foundations that enable teams to work effectively with agentic AI.



Use agentic AI in your own DevEx work and share practical learning with engineering teams.



We foster a developer\-friendly culture with room to explore new technologies and ways of working. You’ll have access to modern AI\-powered tools, join hackathons and take part in internal developer forums where we share ideas and discuss architecture, technology and engineering challenges.


**Let's dive into your key responsibilities, you will**


* Build and evolve shared libraries, scaffolding templates, and CI/CD tooling that remove recurring friction for product squads.
* Build paved paths for messaging patterns like Outbox and Sagas, observability, and rehydration/recovery tooling.
* Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, and AWS infrastructure.
* Work with engineers across product squads to understand recurring friction and turn it into DevEx priorities.
* Help squads adopt platform practices that make service ownership, operation, and reuse easier.
* Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, AWS infrastructure, and secure, reliable defaults


**The need\-to\-have**

* Strong engineering experience in .NET / C\#.
* Proficiency in AWS services (e.g., ECS, Lambda, SQS, S3\) and infrastructure\-as\-code (CDK/Terraform).
* Familiarity with microservices, event\-driven architecture, and distributed\-systems patterns such as Outbox, Sagas, and CDC.
* Hands\-on experience building shared libraries, observability tooling, and reusable APIs.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, able to support squads, gather feedback, and drive adoption.


**The nice\-to\-have skills**


* Experience in platform engineering or developer enablement roles.
* Familiarity with internal documentation practices, onboarding tooling, and automated scaffolding.
* Hands\-on work with service event rehydration, incident recovery tooling, or metadata standards.
* Practical experience using LLMs, generative AI, or agentic AI in software development.


We’re eager to hear from you! If this sounds like a great match and sparks your interest, don’t wait, apply today!


**About AutoProff**



AutoProff was founded in 2013 by the experienced car dealer Jesper Ratza in Denmark. The aim was to digitalize B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.



in August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialized pan\-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B\-B2B\-B2C dealing solution for used cars.



At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used\-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.



We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.


With a focus on effective solutions, digitization and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (C#/.NET, Azure)
jobs.description:
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

SimCorp is developing a new game changing Software\-as\-a\-Service solution for Performance Measurement and Attribution, which will allow Investment Managers to interact with, and analyze their investments in a modern web application. It is connected to a high\-performance computing calculation engine in the back\-end, thus combining more than 50 years of industry\-leading experience of SimCorp with a modern user experience and cloud computing, enabling users to do in minutes what used to take hours.  



We welcome applications from both early‑career and mid‑career software engineers.  



**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

* Build solutions: collaborate closely with your team, Product Managers, Architects, peers and end\-users to deliver high\-quality, secure and valuable solutions in the Performance Product Area.
* Contribute across the entire development lifecycle \- from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.
* Coordinate and execute on development and maintenance of the investment performance solution in collaboration with product owners and other teams.
* Think beyond the code: Understand our strategy, goals and customer needs to enhance SimCorp’s impact.

You will work closely with experienced engineers who support your development. Over time, you will grow into taking ownership of larger components and may mentor more junior colleagues as your experience grows.  

* 

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Solid knowledge of C\#, .NET Core/Framework, and object\-oriented design principles.
* Experience with APIs.
* Familiarity with modern engineering practices, including CI/CD pipelines and trunk\-based development. We use Git (Azure DevOps).
* Interest in cloud engineering. We use Microsoft Azure.
* You understand the importance of automated testing of business‑critical functionality and quality assurance practices.
* Willingness to dive into a complex domain, working with finance, investment performance \& attribution and investment\-related instruments.
* You are able to solve complex problems in a structured manner.
* You are enthusiastic about building state\-of\-the\-art software, and have the mindset needed to make others understand your ideas.
* Curiosity and adaptability to learn in\-house tools and frameworks \- including the APL programming language (no prior experience in APL required, we provide extensive training).
* You are good at coordinating with both programmers and non\-programmers, to ensure a full understanding of tasks.
* You have a Master’s degree or higher within Computer Sciences, Engineering, Finance, Physics, Mathematics, Economics or similar experience.

If you have knowledge of a financial domain it is plus, otherwise we will bring you up to speed using technical discussions, training and a comprehensive onboarding program.  

* 

**WHAT IS IT LIKE TO WORK HERE**

SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3\-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.  



* **Global hybrid work policy** \- We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* **Growth and** **innovation** \- Every 6 th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
* **Self\- Direction** \- High degree of self\-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture
* Pension and health benefits and bonus
* **Work\-life balance** – We strongly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self’s, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace
* **Empowerment** – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes
**NEXT STEPS**

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp , we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.


If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.


We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.


**WHO WE ARE**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations , professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.


SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.


SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Energy Billing
jobs.description:
#### **About Reel**

  

We are rethinking electricity to accelerate the transition to a carbon\-free energy system.


Electricity is one of the biggest sources of carbon emissions globally, yet most green power sold on the market today fails move the needle toward decarbonizing electricity production.


Reel empowers companies to move beyond climate commitments and achieve real\-world carbon reductions, by bridging the gap between renewable energy producers and consumers.


Join our mission\-driven, cross\-disciplinary team of developers, builders, and climate experts working to accelerate the transition to a net\-zero economy.

#### **How you can contribute**

  

We’re working with some of the most exciting technologies within energy, delivering renewable power to corporates and balancing production from asset owners. We’re optimizing solar parks, wind farms, and grid\-scale batteries, trading across different markets and providing ancillary services to help stabilize the grid.


At the end of each month, we’re condensing all of this activity into a few numbers on an invoice for each of our customers. That’s only possible with a strong, purpose\-built energy billing platform.


As our new Software Engineer for billing, you’ll own and grow our next\-generation energy billing platform. You’ll work closely with Christian, our CTO, the rest of the engineering team, and our electricity operations team.

#### **What your role will look like**


These are some (not all) of the things you will be working on:

* **Own our energy billing tech:** Lead the work on continually improving and expanding our billing platform to serve new products, collaborating closely with engineering colleagues.
* **Expand into new markets:** Every market has its own rules, data, and (more often than not) quirks we need to adapt to. You’ll build the integrations that allow us to serve new markets, building on top of the platform we have today.
* **Energy analytics**: Structure and expand our financial data for accurate and up\-to\-date customer analytics and reporting.
* **Build the tools our team runs on**: Our electricity operations team settles all of our customers every month. Build the tooling that gives them the full picture, catches anything that looks off, and makes their workflow as automated as possible.
* **Raise the bar and help set the direction:** Perform code reviews, share feedback with colleagues, contribute to key technical decisions, and be a core member of the team shaping how our tech evolves.

#### **We think you will thrive in this role if**


You have shipped production software and know how to get things done. You take real ownership of your work and have a bias for shipping. You don't need to know anything about energy today or have years of experience with energy billing \- what matters most is that you're eager to learn and ready to put in the work.


You might also recognise yourself in some of these:

* You have solid experience building and maintaining backend systems in production.
* You have worked with billing, payments, settlement or other financial systems.
* You are comfortable being the person who cares whether a number is right.
* You care deeply about building reliable, scalable systems, while shipping frequently.
* You default to simple, pragmatic solutions.
* You work well independently, make decisions with confidence, and know when to bring others in.
* You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others level up.
* You are curious about how AI tools can help us ship better software as a team.


We work in Elixir and Python. We're hosted on GCP, use Kubernetes, data in Postgres w. TimescaleDB and BigQuery, and observability using Loki, Prometheus, and Grafana. We strive to keep our infrastructure as code with tools like Terraform and ArgoCD. Experience in this specific stack is by no means a requirement.


Please note that we are located in Copenhagen, Denmark and this is an in\-office role with flexibility for occasional hybrid work.

#### **Working at Reel**


At Reel, we care deeply about our people. We offer a workplace that values initiative, ownership and kindness, with ample room for personal and professional growth. We believe great teams are built by welcoming people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences.


You will join a tight\-knit team on an ambitious journey, where the impact of your role will be visible and recognisable on a daily basis. Every colleague \- from founders to student assistants \- are in this together. We cherish focus and autonomy just as much as team work and setting time aside for having fun together \- at our monthly socials, bi\-annual offsites and daily coffee chats in our bright and spacious office in central Copenhagen, 2 minutes from the metro.


Read more about working at Reel at our Careers page.

#### **What we offer you**


At Reel, we offer you an organisation that cares as much for its people as for the climate. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where your personal growth and well\-being is imperative.

* **Compensation:** A healthy base salary \+ warrant programme
* **Vacation:** 30 days (5 weeks \+ 1\) of paid holidays to recharge
* **Pension:** Employer\-supported pension scheme, including health insurance
* **Parental leave:** A generous parental leave policy
* **Equipment:** Choose your preferred IT setup (Mac, Windows, etc.) with a budget of 25,000 DKK
* **Office:** A vibrant office\-first culture in central Copenhagen with a flexible remote work policy
* **Lunch:** A delicious lunch at the office every day — and your daily caffeine fix from our espresso machine
* **Socials:** Monthly social events and bi\-annual offsites where we have fun, unwind, and nurture our team spirit
* **Visa:** We try to support non\-EU residents by sponsoring visas whenever we can, but our ability to do so depends on the role

#### **Interested?**


We are very excited hearing from you. You can find more information about the interview process here.

*You don't feel like you fulfill all the criteria?*


We know that 'perfect' candidates do not exist. The only thing you need to ensure is that the problem we are solving at Reel is one you cannot wait to get out of bed for on Monday morning.

***We encourage all candidates, regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, etc. to apply.***
