jobs.title: Digital Technology Student Workers - Software Engineering
jobs.description:
This autumn semester , we are excited to welcome **four** new student workers to join our teams in Billund. These roles span across front\-end and full\-stack software engineering, offering great opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.


**Student Worker,** **Brick** **L** **ink** **Technology (role 1\)**

As our Student Worker – Frontend Development, you'll build real frontend features on BrickLink.com alongside engineers who are rebuilding the platform on a modern stack. You'll join a product team with engineering, product, and design partners, and your work will reach a live global audience. You'll experience both a long\-running production system and a greenfield modern architecture while contributing to member\-facing experiences across home pages, accounts, sessions, and community touchpoints within the LEGO® ecosystem.


**Required Qualifications**

* JavaScript or TypeScript fundamentals
* Experience with/exposure to React (or a comparable component framework)
* Experience with/exposure to HTML and CSS \- semantic markup, responsive layout
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with/exposure to Next.js or a modern SSR framework
* Basic experience with backend/APIs or testing
**What** **you'll** **build**

* Frontend features that improve the experience for BrickLink members.
* Pages aligned with LEGO design and component systems.
* Solutions that help legacy and modern platforms work together during replatforming .
* Experiences that meet quality, performance, and accessibility expectations at scale.
* Visible improvements that reach members while helping the team modernise the platform.
**Student Worker, Brick Technology (role 2\)**

As our Student Worker \- Frontend Engineer, you'll work in the Digital Element Design area, helping migrate web applications to the LEGO® design system. You'll refactor and replace user interface components, apply design tokens and styles, and help ensure the applications remain responsive and accessible. Working in a TypeScript and React monorepo , you'll contribute to modernising the design ecosystem one component at a time while collaborating closely with designers and engineers.


**Required Qualifications**

* Studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Exposure to or experience with React, TypeScript, and CSS through university, personal, or other projects
* Fluent English
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Applied basic unit testing practices and validated changes using existing test suites
* Explored web accessibility and responsive design principles through projects or coursework
**What** **you'll** **build**

* Migrate web applications to the LEGO design system
* Refactor and replace existing user interface components
* Apply design tokens and styling standards across applications
* Help ensure a responsive and accessible user experience
* Contribute to the modernisation of a shared frontend ecosystem used across the team
**Student Worker, Cybersecurity Platforms (role 3\)**

As our Student Worker, Software Engineer, Cybersecurity, you'll work across a wide range of cybersecurity platforms, applications, and engineering challenges. You'll help implement software features, build infrastructure through code, and support large\-scale security logging solutions. Some of the tools and platforms you'll work with are bought and maintained , while others are built from scratch by the team. You won't be expected to know everything from day one. Instead, you'll learn alongside experienced engineers while contributing to meaningful work from week one.


**Required Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing studies in computer science or a related field
* Exposure to software development through university projects, hobby projects, internships, or similar practical experience
* Fluent English
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with C\# or Next.js
**What** **you'll** **build**

* Implement new features across cybersecurity platforms and applications
* Help build and maintain infrastructure through code
* Support the operation of large security logging solutions
* Contribute to both internally developed and vendor\-supported security technologies
* Learn new technologies and engineering approaches while supporting the team
**Student Worker, Manufacturing Technology (role 4\)**

As our Student Worker, you'll join the Warehousing and Site Logistics product team within Manufacturing Technology. You'll help build and support software solutions used in warehouses, logistics operations, and material handling across manufacturing sites. You'll contribute as a regular member of the team while learning both technical and business\-domain topics. The role offers the chance to work on systems with real operational impact, where reliable software helps keep production moving every day.


**Required Qualifications**

* Exposure to or experience working with Typescript, React, and Go
* Fluent English
* Studying computer science, software engineering, or related subject
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to or experience with Python
**What** **you'll** **build**

* Support software solutions used in warehousing, logistics , and material\-handling operations
* Contribute to development activities that support factories and warehouses globally
* Work alongside experienced engineers on technology decisions and software delivery
* Help improve systems that support continuous movement of products through the supply chain
* Contribute to initiatives connected to factory expansion and new\-site implementation projects
**We're** **looking for students who**

* Are currently enrolled in Denmark in a **Bachelor’s, Master’s, or** **Erhvervsakademi** (professional academy) program in fields related to data.
* Preferably graduating summer 2028 or beyond, having at least 1\.5\-2 years left of studies
* Are curious and willing to learn, with a **positive, team\-player attitude** .
* Can be present 15–20 hours per week, ideally with 1–2 days at our **LEGO** **office** **in Billund** .
* Are passionate about digital technology and eager to contribute to real projects.
If you're interested in joining us, please prepare your CV and cover letter in English. We also ask that you in your CV or cover letter indicate which role you’re most interested in.


The application portal will remain open from 14 th September to 12 th October 2026, but it may be taken down earlier so we urge you to apply as soon as possible. If you are shortlisted, you will be invited to attend our Assessment Day on 4 th November 2026 at our Kornmarken Campus in Billund. Following the Assessment Day, there will be one final interview round. The expected start date for successful candidates is either 1 st December 2026 or 1 st January 2027\.


\#LI\-MF2


Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.


**What’s in it for you?**

Here is what you can expect:


**Family Care Leave** \- We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.


**Insurances** – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.


**Wellbeing** \- We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.


**Colleague Discount** – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.


**Bonus** \- We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.


**Workplace** \- When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.


Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.


The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.


The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.


Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.


Just imagine building your dream career.


Then make it real.


**Join the LEGO® team today.**

jobs.title: Erfaren AI Harness Engineer – vær med til at forme agentic udvikling hos Danske Spil
jobs.description:
Som Senior AI Harness Engineer bliver du en del af teamet, der bygger fundamentet for Danske Spils AI\-first udviklingspraksis. Du træder ikke ind i et færdigt setup – du er med til at definere det.


Du får en hands\-on og teknisk rolle med stort mandat. Sammen med teamet designer du, hvordan vi evaluerer agenter, måler kvalitet og sikkerhed, bygger integrationer og afgør, hvornår teams og opgaver er klar til agentic udvikling.

**Velkommen til AI Harness\-teamet**


Teamet ligger i IT Udvikling og refererer til Chef for Platform \& Core Services. Vi arbejder tæt sammen med IT\-ledelsen og udviklingsteams på tværs af organisationen. Vores mål er at skabe et fælles harness, som gør agentic udvikling anvendelig, målbar og holdbar i praksis.


Vi arbejder spec\-drevet ud fra et enkelt princip: Agenter har autonomi mellem gates – aldrig hen over dem. Mennesker godkender specs og pull requests, og du er med til at bygge de gates, der gør modellen robust. Teamet er nysgerrigt, teknisk stærkt, pragmatisk, vidensdelende og retningssættende.

**Din rolle**


Du bygger selv, men din effekt stopper ikke ved den kode, du leverer. Du udfordrer tekniske valg, etablerer standarder og gør løsningerne brugbare for de teams, der skal arbejde med dem. Det sker gennem kode og værktøjer – og gennem håndbog, workshops og løbende sparring.

**Dine vigtigste ansvarsområder**

* **Evals og agent quality:** Designe og bygge evals, der gør kvalitet, robusthed og sikkerhed målbar på tværs af agenter, skills, tools og modeller.
* **Observability og forståelse:** Bygge telemetri og dashboards for brug, performance, fejlmønstre, omkostninger og kvalitetsmetrikker – blandt andet opdelt på kode\-proveniens – samt udvikle gode reviewmønstre for agent\-skrevet kode.
* **Readiness og quality gates:** Definere, hvornår teams, kodebaser og opgaver er klar til agentic udvikling, herunder om en agent kan bygge, køre tests og få deterministisk feedback.
* **Tools, agents og skills:** Designe og udvikle CLI’er, MCP\-integrationer, custom agents og agent skills, der fungerer i udviklernes reelle arbejdsgange.
* **Onboarding og teknisk retning:** Rulle det fælles harness ud på tværs af .NET\-, Java\- og appteams og omsætte nye modeller, tools og patterns til løsninger, der skaber værdi i praksis.

 **Vores tekniske landskab**


Vi arbejder blandt andet med GitHub Copilot, GitHub, Atlassian, Datadog, Grafana, Kubernetes og ArgoCD. Udviklingsteams bruger blandt andet .NET, Java, Go, TypeScript/React samt Kotlin, Swift og React Native på mobil. Harness, evals og dashboards bygger vi selv.


Du behøver ikke kende hele vores stack fra dag ét. Det afgørende er din tekniske tyngde, din kritiske sans og din nysgerrighed på, hvor agentic udvikling stadig kan gå galt.

**Vi forestiller os, at du**

* **Har stærk software\- og platform engineering\-erfaring:** Du har eksempelvis arbejdet som Senior Software Engineer, Platform Engineer eller AI Engineer og kan omsætte komplekse behov til robuste løsninger.
* **Har praktisk erfaring med AI\-agenter:** Du har arbejdet hands\-on med MCP, agentic workflows, evals, prompts, context engineering eller beslægtede discipliner.
* **Tænker test, kvalitet og sikkerhed ind fra begyndelsen:** Du kan skelne evidens fra hype, læser gerne både changelogs og forskning og forholder dig kritisk til resultater og risici.
* **Bygger gode værktøjer og arbejdsgange for udviklere:** Du har blik for developer experience og for, hvordan standarder og gates bliver en hjælp i hverdagen.
* **Kommunikerer stærkt og deler din viden:** Du trives i tæt samarbejde med teams og kan gøre tekniske valg forståelige og anvendelige i kode, dokumentation, workshops og samtaler.

**Hvorfor Danske Spil?**


Fordi du får mulighed for at bygge noget, der endnu ikke er færdigdefineret – og få reel indflydelse på, hvordan AI\-agenter bliver en del af softwareudviklingen på tværs af en stor organisation. Du får både lov til at gå dybt teknisk og skabe effekt langt ud over dit eget team.

**Vil du være med til at underholde danskerne?**


Vi læser ansøgninger igennem løbende, men deadline for at søge er den 4\. oktober 2026\. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Lars Ottesen på lao@danskespil.dk. Hvis du har spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Business Partner, Mette Overgaard Holm på MEHO@danskespil.dk.

jobs.title: Cloud Developer - CID
jobs.description:
**Experienced Cloud Developer**


Brænder du for cloud\-arkitektur, integrationer og moderne udviklingsprincipper – og motiveres du af at bygge robuste, skalerbare løsninger tæt på forretningen?
  

Så har vi en spændende mulighed i Kvik A/S, hvor du bliver en central, spiller i vores Cloud Integration \& Development (CID) team.


Måske arbejder du i dag som udvikler og er klar til at tage næste skridt i din karriere?
  

Som Cloud Developer i Kvik A/S, tilbyder vi netop denne mulighed.


**Om teamet (CID)**


CID\-teamet driver en moderne Microsoft cloud platform i Kvik og er med til at sikre stabile og løbende forbedrede digitale services til vores butikker og interne teams.
  

Vi arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem forretning og teknologi og bygger integrationer og API\-services, der binder vores forretningssystemer sammen.


Vi arbejder tæt sammen med bl.a. BizApps (Power Platform/Dynamics 365\), ERP (D365 Business Central), Data (MS DWH/Fabric) og Digital Marketing – og vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, samarbejde og en kultur med højt til loftet.
  

Det er derfor vigtigt at du ikke kun bringer stærke tekniske kompetencer ind i rollen, men også meget gerne en solid forretningsforståelse, og helt sikkert en vilje til at lære.


**Om stillingen**


Som Cloud Developer får du et bredt ansvar, hvor du både sætter teknisk retning, skaber overblik og omsætter arkitektur til virkelighed. Du bliver en nøgleperson i arbejdet med at udvikle og vedligeholde vores cloud‑principper, patterns\- og standarder – og du hjælper teams og stakeholders med at træffe de rigtige tekniske valg.


Samtidig er du hands\-on udvikler og deltager aktivt i design og implementering af C\#/.NET baserede løsninger i Azure, herunder API’er, integrations\-flows og eventdrevne komponenter baseret på messaging og asynkrone mønstre.
  

  

Du arbejder især med de forretningskritiske og komplekse dele af platformen, hvor robusthed, skalerbarhed og driftssikkerhed er afgørende.
  

**Dine primære ansvarsområder**


* **Cloud‑strategi og arkitektur:** Udvikle og vedligeholde skalerbare cloud‑arkitekturprincipper og standarder (primært Microsoft\-teknologi).
* **Thought leadership:** Være et fagligt fyrtårn og bidrage til retning, kompetencesikring og best practices i CID’s virke.
* **Governance \& compliance:** Sikre overholdelse af sikkerhed, lovgivning og interne retningslinjer i cloud‑miljøer.
* **Innovation og optimering:** Identificere nye teknologier og metoder, der skaber forretningsværdi og reducerer omkostninger.
* **Samarbejde og rådgivning:** Arbejde tæt sammen med udviklingsteams, arkitekter og stakeholders for at sikre helhedsorienterede løsninger – og proaktivt drive integrations‑ (og evt. AI\-) initiativer.
* **Automatisering og drift:** Drive automatisering, DevOps\-principper og Infrastructure as Code.
* **CI/CD og platform:** Vedligeholde og videreudvikle CI/CD\-processer og tekniske processer på tværs af vores services.
* **AI, udvikling og anvendelse**  

Det forventes at du har erfaring med AI i tooling, anvendelse og kvalitetssikring.
  

Det vil være en fordel med erfaring fra AI udviklingsprojekter, men ikke et krav.

**Teknologier og værktøjer**


Vores stack er Microsoft \- centreret og inkluderer typisk:


* Azure (Cloud development, Functions, integrationer, Service Bus, API Management, Redis Cache)
* Cloud Architecture / platform design
* Azure DevOps / CI/CD
* .NET / C\# og API design
* Power Platform / Dynamics 365 (tæt samarbejde og integrationsflader)
* Github Enterprise

**Din profil**


Vi forestiller os, at du:


* Har solid erfaring med Azure og cloud arkitektur i praksis (gerne integrations\-/platformfokus)
* Har solid erfaring med C\# / .NET
* Har erfaring med API’er, integrationer og event‑baserede patterns
* Har stærk forståelse for DevOps, CI/CD, automatisering og IaC
* Kan kombinere arkitektur og rådgivning med evnen til at få ting til at ske i praksis
* Trives i et tværgående setup med mange stakeholders og kan kommunikere klart – også på engelsk
* Taler flydende dansk og kommunikerer ubesværet på engelsk i skrift og tale
* Tager end\-to‑\-end ansvar for løsninger ud fra et “you build it, you own it”‑ princip, fra ‑C\#kode‑ og arkitekturvalg til drift, overvågning og løbende forbedringer

**Du tilbydes**


* Mulighed for at arbejde i hjertet af et forretningskritisk applikations\- og integrationslandskab
* Indflydelse og ansvar i et selvstyrende team med fokus på samarbejde og trivsel
* En international virksomhed i vækst med spændende digitaliseringsinitiativer
* Tæt sparring med erfarne kolleger og mulighed for at præge Kvik’s cloud og integrationsrejse

jobs.description:
KONE moves two billion people every day. As a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, we employ over 60,000 driven professionals in more than 60 countries worldwide joined together by a shared purpose, to shape the future of cities. In 2025, we had annual net sales of EUR 11\.2 billion.


KONE has consistently been featured on Forbes list of World's Best Innovative Companies, World's Best Employers \& World's Largest Public Companies. At KONE, we believe in teamwork and a work culture where everyone can be who they are. This is exactly what makes us strong and successful.


**Why this role?**

The Service Sales Hunter spends most of the time building new relationships and selling maintenance contracts and related digital services outside current customer base.


**What will you be doing?**

Customer relationship management


* Proactively develops and creates customer relationships in his/her area of responsibility
* Is accountable for developing KONE position in his/her customer base or market area
* Creates and communicates leads and sales opportunities for entire KONE sales team (e.g.
* cross\-selling)
* Ensures customer satisfaction and solves complaints with the rest of KONE team
* Documents the customer and contact information, maintains customer data

Sell


* Proactively generates opportunities from outside current customer base
* Handles RFQs
* Is accountable for leads, opportunities, orders and contracts to meet the sales budget and pricing targets
* Is accountable for finding customer needs and that KONE’s solution matches with the needs
* Is responsible for pricing using the approved tendering tools, and for optimizing prices and discounts within his/her authority
* Validates that the contents of the contract are in line with the negotiation process outcome
* Maintains full information of opportunities, tasks and visits (sales funnel management)
* Responsible for timely and accurate reporting in CRM
* Responsible for gathering relevant information about market and competitors from the field
* Supports the finance function in money collection.
* Drives execution of her/his individual sales plan

**Are you the one?**

* Bachelor or Master’s degree in economics, engineering or other relevant field
* Experience from/ familiar with solution selling methodology
* Experience from / familiar with KONE customers’ industries is a plus
* Sales and/ or customer service experience
* Masters the sales process
* Numbers and facts drive actions
* Is able to bring across customer needs, add value to customers’ businesses by offering solutions that meet their needs and is able to use value based pricing to guarantee healthy margins
* Comfortable and excited about the opportunities that digital solutions bring.

  

**What’s On Offer**

* Career progression in opportunities within a global organization
* Total reward elements that engage and motivate our employees and help us make KONE a great place to work
* Comprehensive learning and development programs covering a wide range of professional skills
* You are surrounded by fun colleagues and a lively working environment. The best part is all leaders are great and open\-minded

  

**To Be Considered**  

  

Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our Talent and Culture team will review your application and will be in contact with additional information accordingly.
  

  

In the meantime, feel free to browse our website for additional information on our company, brands and culture – KONE Corporation.  

  

  



\#LI\-YL1


*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co\-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*

Read more on *https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html*

jobs.title: Digital Solutions Engineer – Platform Services
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


Build the enterprise platforms that power intelligent operations.  

  

Join Agilent's Global OT \& AI Engineering organization and help develop the cloud\-native platforms that connect enterprise systems, manufacturing operations, and intelligent digital solutions across Agilent's global operations.  

  

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Platform Services, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, enterprise APIs, integration platforms, and cloud\-native applications that enable secure, reliable, and real\-time information exchange across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Quality, Engineering, and Operational Excellence.  

  

Working closely with Application Experience Engineers, Data Engineers, AI \& Data Scientists, Smart Factory Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will develop the enterprise services that power digital products, operational analytics, AI applications, and connected manufacturing systems.  

  

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience, expertise, and demonstrated capabilities.

**About Global OT \& AI Engineering**

  

Global OT \& AI Engineering develops the digital platforms that power intelligent operations across Agilent's global manufacturing network.


Our organization combines software engineering, enterprise data platforms, Artificial Intelligence, industrial automation, cloud technologies, and Smart Factory solutions to build scalable digital capabilities that improve operational visibility, accelerate decision\-making, and enable continuous improvement across global operations.


Our mission is to build the digital operating system for intelligent manufacturing.


Our portfolio includes:

* Global Operations Control Tower
* Enterprise Data Platform (GOLake)
* AI \& Decision Intelligence Platform
* Smart Factory Applications
* Manufacturing Knowledge Platform
* Enterprise KPI Platform
* Digital Twin Solutions
* Manufacturing Data Exchange Platform
* AI\-powered Digital Coworkers

**About the Role**

  

Modern enterprise software depends on reliable, scalable, and secure platform services that connect business applications, operational technologies, enterprise systems, and cloud services into a unified digital ecosystem.


As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Platform Services, you will build the backend capabilities that power Agilent's digital products. From enterprise APIs and integration services to cloud\-native microservices and event\-driven architectures, your work will provide the foundation that enables seamless communication between applications, data platforms, AI services, and manufacturing systems.


You will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to develop reusable platform capabilities that accelerate software delivery, improve system reliability, and support Agilent's long\-term digital transformation strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**

 **Platform Services Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services that support enterprise digital products.
* Build reusable APIs, microservices, and shared platform capabilities that accelerate software development across multiple applications.
* Develop secure and maintainable services that enable reliable communication between enterprise systems and operational platforms.
* Ensure platform services are scalable, resilient, and designed for long\-term maintainability.

**Enterprise Integration**

* Develop integration services connecting ERP, MES, PLM, Quality Systems, AI platforms, enterprise applications, and cloud services.
* Design API\-first solutions that promote reuse and simplify system integration.
* Implement event\-driven and asynchronous communication patterns to improve scalability and responsiveness.
* Enable secure and efficient information exchange across enterprise and manufacturing environments.

**Cloud\-Native Engineering**

* Develop cloud\-native applications and services using modern architectural patterns.
* Support containerized deployments, automated testing, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD).
* Optimize platform performance, reliability, scalability, and operational resilience.
* Implement monitoring, logging, and observability capabilities that improve platform health and operational support.

**Security \& Reliability**

* Apply secure software development practices throughout the application lifecycle.
* Implement authentication, authorization, and API security standards.
* Support disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and high\-availability strategies.
* Continuously improve platform performance through proactive monitoring and optimization.

**Cross\-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Application Experience Engineers to deliver end\-to\-end enterprise applications.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers to expose trusted enterprise data through secure services.
* Work with AI \& Data Scientists to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms.
* Support Smart Factory Engineers by enabling secure integration between operational technologies and enterprise applications.
* Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and Agile delivery activities.

**Technology Environment**

  

You will have opportunities to work with modern enterprise technologies including:

**Backend Development**

* .NET
* Python
* Node.js (preferred)

 **API \& Integration**

* REST APIs
* GraphQL (preferred)
* gRPC (preferred)
* OAuth 2\.0 / OpenID Connect

 **Cloud Platforms**

* Microsoft Azure
* AWS

 **Containers \& DevOps**

* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Azure DevOps
* GitHub Actions

 **Messaging \& Event Streaming**

* Apache Kafka
* Azure Event Hub
* RabbitMQ (preferred)

 **Databases**

* SQL Server
* PostgreSQL
* MongoDB
* Redis (preferred)

 **Monitoring \& Observability**

* Azure Monitor
* Application Insights
* Grafana
* Prometheus (preferred)

**Qualifications**
------------------


We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience and demonstrated capability.


You should have:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Experience developing backend applications, APIs, or enterprise software platforms.
* Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as C\#, Python, or Java.
* Understanding of API development, system integration, and relational databases.
* Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and distributed application architecture.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Passion for building scalable software platforms that enable enterprise digital transformation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

Experience in one or more of the following areas is advantageous:

* Cloud\-native application development (Azure or AWS)
* Microservices architecture
* Event\-driven architecture
* Container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Enterprise Integration Patterns
* CI/CD and DevOps practices
* Identity and Access Management (IAM)
* Manufacturing or industrial software platforms

**Leadership Competencies**

  

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

* Strong software engineering and systems design fundamentals.
* Passion for building reliable, scalable, and maintainable software platforms.
* Customer\-focused problem solving with a commitment to delivering business value.
* Excellent collaboration across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Curiosity to explore emerging technologies and modern engineering practices.
* Ability to balance technical excellence with pragmatic business outcomes.

**Additional Details**


This job has a full time weekly schedule.
Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations
Agilent Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description:
* Singapore, Singapore, Singapore
* Business Development
* Experienced Professionals
* 20674


  
**What's the role?**
--------------------


The RBD (Regional Business Development) is leadership role part of the regional Hilti team. As an RBD you will be focusing on a portfolio of Regional Accounts (OEM’s or Consultants) important for the Hilti Data Center business. You will create a strategy and lead its execution to increase adoption of Hilti Data Center solutions. You will also coordinate with the worldwide community associated with these account(s).  

  



**What You'll do**
------------------


* Accountable for the Development of regional Data Center OEM accounts/Consultants operating in the Data Center business through account standardization, project specification, sales development (direct or indirect) and multi\-level relationship management with a view of increasing Hilti share of wallet.
* Accountable for the development of the strategy of the assigned accounts, leading its implementation globally through Hilti counterparts regionally and globally.
* Ownership of the accounts regional project pipeline and proactive build\-up with segment teams of Hilti capture teams to drive the aligned focus projects and increase share of wallet.
* Responsible for bringing market intelligence inputs to the regional and global teams to confirm and/or update corporate segment strategies.
* Focus on project pipeline irrespective of project and sales location.
* Maintains effective communication throughout the team and company and acts as single owner of assigned accounts.
* Responsibilities includes travelling abroad when needed.

  

Performance Indicators:  

  

  

* Achieve Standard and Specifications on assigned Account(s) by driving complex sales throughout all project phases.
* Develop Account strategies to maximize Hilti solution penetration and partnership level.
* Drives and/or supports project capture teams
* Achieve Net Sales Plan (if applicable)

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------


'\- 5\-12 years of experience in Business Development  

  



* Communication skills: Creation of trust through active listening, influencing with leadership and not authority, negotiation skills.
* Long\-Term Strategic Thinking: Capable of explaining and transmitting the targets \& strategy to customers, peers and management.
* Senior relationship management: Capable and confident while speaking to senior and C\-level customers.
* Project management capabilities: Manage complexity of system selling across multiple geographies, functions and customers.

**What’s In It for You**
------------------------


Accelerate your career as a strategic commercial leader with this high\-impact opportunity. In this role, you will transition from transactional selling to managing multi\-million dollar national portfolios, serving as the primary negotiator for massive domestic and international accounts. You will significantly sharpen your commercial acumen by mastering our advanced Large \& Complex Sales Management Process (SMP), structuring high\-value pricing frameworks, and introducing cutting\-edge engineering innovations that redefine client standards. Beyond driving enterprise revenue, you will act as a central orchestrator—mobilizing cross\-functional resources, championing internal business initiatives, and building an elite professional network across all executive levels. Backed by world\-class digital tools like Salesforce, this position offers the ultimate platform to build authoritative industry expertise and directly influence major, large\-scale construction projects.  

  



**Why Hilti**
-------------


Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.  

  



**Commitment to Inclusion**
---------------------------


At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

jobs.title: Software Manager (Public Sector Project)
jobs.description:
Overview
  
  

The Software Manager is responsible for leading and governing all software engineering activities within an ICT public sector project in Singapore. This role ensures that software solutions are designed, developed, tested, and maintained in compliance with Singapore Government standards and aligned with international ISO framework.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Software Strategy, Architecture \& Governance
  
  

* Define the software engineering approach and delivery framework aligned with government guidelines and policies, and ISO standards.
* Provide leadership over the project's core technology stack, including Microsoft SQL Server databases, C\# programming environments, and native Azure cloud services.
* Establish and enforce robust processes for software design, implementation, testing, and configuration management aligned with ISO/IEC 12207 and ISO 9001\.


Software Design, Integration \& Validation

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (Aftermarket Applications)
jobs.description:
**Your role**
-------------

We are looking for a passionate and committed Senior Backend .NET Developer.


You will be part of our internal software development team working in the Aftermarket domain. This surrounds applications for providing technical support, processing warranty, tools for our Field Service Engineer, our back office (planning and order processing), spare part list applications and Serialized Information Management.


As such you will be responsible for technical application ownership and developments. Next to this you will be involved in the full redesign of our existing applications and creation of new applications as business needs arise in our Customer Centers.


You will have the opportunity to work with a highly motivated international business and software developer team in a challenging and very dynamic environment.


You build the back\-end behind our operational applications, not the screens in front of it. Your initial focus is the system that links as\-built documentation, bills of material and product definitions to serialized equipment and the installed base which is used by internal teams, by Customer Centers and by dealers, with a growing number of applications depending on its APIs. From there you work across the rest of our backend landscape: warranty automation and order evaluation, engineering change bulletins, maintenance engines and the shared services the whole portfolio runs on.


Your working level is domain models, APIs, events and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team with developers, architects and a product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.


The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on C\# and .NET (8 or later) on Azure: Function Apps and App Services for compute, Kafka and Azure Service Bus for the event streams that feed us, and a deliberately mixed data layer SQL for the queryable subset, a graph store for the relationships between equipment, components and product definitions. Services run behind private endpoints with managed identity and RBAC, ship through Azure DevOps pipelines with infrastructure as code, and are instrumented with Application Insights.


**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

You have built back\-end systems that other teams and other applications depend on, ideally in an operational or business\-critical context where downtime is measured in stopped work rather than a slow page. You think in trade\-offs rather than absolutes, and you keep digging until you know why something failed, not just that it did. You work comfortably in an agile team, have the confidence to say in refinement that something cannot be built the way it is specified, and use AI tooling with the judgement to verify what it produces. This is a senior role: we expect you to own a domain end to end and make decisions the rest of the team builds on.


You will not have every item on the list below. Cover most of the must\-haves and be genuinely curious about the rest.


**Must\-have**

* **C\# / .NET (8 or later, moving to .NET 10\):** recent, hands\-on experience building production\-grade applications, not prototypes, at a level where you own a service end to end.
* **Azure:** practical experience with several of: Function Apps, App Services, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, Key Vault, API Management, Application Insights.
* **REST API design and implementation:** designing and consuming well\-structured, versioned APIs, and thinking about the contract before the code.
* **SQL databases:** data modelling, query performance, and integrating relational data into cloud applications.
* **Testing as part of development:** unit and integration testing as a habit, not a separate phase handed to someone else.
* **Experience migrating .NET Framework systems to modern .NET and retiring what they replaced.**

**Strong plus**

* **Apache Kafka:** consuming event streams from systems you do not control, and living with what they send you.
* **Graph databases:** Neo4j or equivalent, and the modelling instinct for when a relationship belongs in a graph rather than a join table.
* **Secure\-by\-default cloud development:** managed identity, private endpoints, RBAC and secret management as normal practice.
* **Observability:** structured logging, tracing, alerting, and being on the hook for a system you built.
* **Domain\-driven design:** bounded contexts and aggregates applied to a real domain rather than a textbook one.
* **Microservice architecture:** service boundaries, inter\-service contracts, and the operational cost of getting them wrong.
* **Event\-driven and message\-based architecture:** queues, topics, event streams, and the practical problems that come with them: ordering, idempotency, at\-least\-once delivery, replay, poison messages.
* **CI/CD with Azure DevOps:** YAML pipelines, release management, and infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or ARM).

**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well\-being, and we provide a flexible work\-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.


You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.


**Job location**
----------------

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on\-site at Airpower in Antwerp, Belgium (BE).


  
Company: Atlas Copco Group
  

Location: Belgium
  

City: Antwerp
  

Date of Posting: September 14, 2026
  

Apply for this position

jobs.title: Senior Netwerk Engineer
jobs.description:
**Tabaknatie is een logistieke dienstverlener in de Antwerpse haven, gespecialiseerd in de opslag en behandeling van goederen voor internationale klanten. Zowel op rechter\- als op linkeroever beschikken wij over gespecialiseerde magazijnen met een totale oppervlakte van meer dan 1\.000\.000m². Als Senior Netwerk Engineer maak je deel uit van ons IT\-departement en ga je aan de slag op ons hoofdkantoor in het centrum van Antwerpen.****WAT GA JE DOEN?**
===================


* Je bent binnen het team het aanspreekpunt voor het netwerk: van de core\-en access\-switchen in de kantoren en magazijnen tot de firewalls, WiFi\-dekking en de connectiviteit tussen onze sites.
* Je beheert, bewaakt en optimaliseert deze omgeving, en je werkt mee aan projecten zoals vernieuwingen, uitbreidingen en migraties.
* Operationeel beheer van de netwerkinfrastructuur: switching, routing, firewalling, WiFi en VPN.
* Opvolgen van incidenten en changes, inclusief root cause\-analyse en structurele oplossingen.
* Bewaken van documentatie, configuratiestandaarden en netwerkbeveiliging.
* Uitvoeren en begeleiden van projecten: van voorbereiding en planning tot implementatie en oplevering.
* Coachen van een junior collega: je neemt hem of haar stap voor stap mee in de netwerkmaterie en maakt van kennisoverdracht een vaste gewoonte.
* In het kader van NIS2, het mee bewaken van de netwerkbeveiliging: segmentatie, firewallbeleid, toegangsbeheer en hardening.

Je takenpakket stopt niet aan de grens van het netwerk. Je volgt actief de markt op voor nieuwe trends om mee te helpen bouwen van de roadmap. Afhankelijk van de noden van de organisatie schuif je mee aan bij bredere ondersteuning van de operationele teams op de werkvloer. Omdat onze operatie ook buiten de klassieke kantooruren doorloopt, ben je bereid om occasioneel onderhoud, upgrades en interventies vroeg ‘s ochtends, ‘s avonds of in het weekend uit te voeren. Ingrepen worden vooraf gepland en in overleg met het team afgesproken.
**WIE ZOEKEN WE?**
==================


Je hebt ruime ervaring als netwerk engineer en je weet waarover je praat. Je bouwt je advies op ervaring, onderzoek en overleg met je collega’s, niet op aannames. Daarnaast geef je graag je kennis door en hebt het geduld om een junior collega te laten groeien in plaats van het werk zelf over te nemen.
**Je beschikt ook over:**
=========================


* Ervaring met Cisco\-netwerkapparatuur is een must, net als aantoonbare ervaring in operationeel netwerkbeheer. Ervaring met Palo Alto\-firewalls is een plus.
* Kennis van of ervaring met informatieveiligheidsnormen zoals ISO 27001 of regelgeving zoals NIS2 is een plus.
* Een gestructureerde werking: je documenteert, plant je werk en houdt overzicht, ook wanneer er meerdere zaken tegelijk lopen.
* Een pragmatische en rustige houding. Bij een storing verlies je je kalmte niet en ga je methodisch te werk.
* Een professionele en heldere communicatiestijl, ook richting hoger management: je vertaalt techniek naar begrijpelijke taal, impact en opties. Dit in het Nederlands, maar ook Engels is een must.
* Een flexibele ingesteldheid en pakt daardoor aan wat nodig is, ook als het buiten je strikte specialisatie valt.
* Kennis van of ervaring in een magazijn\-, transport– of logistieke omgeving is een plus.
* Een rijbewijs B, om je te kunnen verplaatsen naar de verschillende sites en hoofdkantoren verspreid in de Haven van Antwerpen.

**Waarom voor Tabaknatie werken?**
==================================


Bij Tabaknatie zal je deel uitmaken van een hechte familie van getalenteerde professionals die elkaar ondersteunen en aanmoedigen om gezamenlijk grenzen te verleggen. We geloven in het creëren van een omgeving waarin iedereen zich gewaardeerd voelt en waar individuele groei en ontwikkeling worden gestimuleerd. Als wereldleider zijn we voortdurend in beweging, en dat houdt ons werk boeiend en uitdagend. Geen dag is hetzelfde bij Tabaknatie, en dat maakt ons uniek in onze branche. We omarmen verandering en innovatie, waardoor onze medewerkers de kans krijgen om hun vaardigheden te ontwikkelen en nieuwe mogelijkheden te ontdekken. Kiezen voor een carrière bij Tabaknatie betekent kiezen voor een werkplek waar je je gewaardeerd voelt, waar je kunt groeien en waar je deel uitmaakt van een familie die zich inzet voor succes. Sluit je aan bij ons team en ervaar zelf waarom onze medewerkers zo trots zijn om bij Tabaknatie te werken.

jobs.title: Teamlead software development Horizon
jobs.description:
.text\-block p { margin\-top: 0px; }
Voor ons ontwikkelingsteam achter Horizon, onze customer success portal die fungeert als dé centrale toegangspoort tot de diensten van Cegeka en klanten ondersteuning, inzichten en transparantie biedt, én als onze Employee Experience Portal, waarmee Cegeka\-medewerkers digitaal hun timesheets, afwezigheden en onkosten beheren, zijn we op zoek naar een getalenteerde en gedreven Teamlead. In deze rol bevind je je op het kruispunt van people leadership, procesoptimalisatie en product\- en technische expertise. Samen met je team bouw je mee aan digitale oplossingen die dagelijks een positieve impact hebben op zowel onze klanten als onze medewerkers.
Je leidt en coacht ons Horizon\-developmentteam, een team van ongeveer 10 getalenteerde collega's verspreid over een internationale omgeving (België, Roemenië, Moldavië en Griekenland).
Je combineert hands\-on leiderschap met een grondige kennis van Agile\-principes en helpt het team kwalitatief hoogstaand werk af te leveren, terwijl je zowel de individuele als de collectieve groei stimuleert.
Je creëert een cultuur van eigenaarschap, samenwerking en continue verbetering, over verschillende locaties en tijdszones heen.
Je faciliteert Scrum\-ceremonies zoals sprintplanningen, daily stand\-ups, reviews en retrospectives en zorgt ervoor dat Agile\-principes op een doeltreffende en pragmatische manier worden toegepast, zonder ze louter "by the book" te volgen.
Je bent eigenaar van de Jira\-werkwijze binnen het team en beheert de backlogstructuur, sprintboards, rapportering en proceshygiëne.
Je fungeert als brug tussen het developmentteam, product owners en stakeholders, waarbij je prioriteiten vertaalt naar duidelijke, concrete en uitvoerbare opdrachten.
Je identificeert en neemt zowel technische als organisatorische obstakels weg die het team kunnen vertragen.
Je ondersteunt de sprint\- en releaseplanning en bewaakt hierbij de juiste balans tussen scope, kwaliteit en oplevertermijnen.
Afhankelijk van je achtergrond draag je actief bij aan technische of productgerelateerde discussies, bijvoorbeeld door architectuurbeslissingen mee te beoordelen of productvereisten verder te verfijnen.
Je volgt de prestaties en deliverables van het team op aan de hand van relevante metrics en gebruikt deze inzichten om continue verbetering te stimuleren, niet als een loutere compliance\-oefening.
Wat breng jij mee?
Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen, begeleiden en coachen van een internationaal, verspreid team.
Je werkt graag samen met collega's uit verschillende landen, tijdzones en culturen.
Je hebt ruime ervaring in Agile omgevingen en hebt teams succesvol geleid, gecoacht of gefaciliteerd als Scrum Master, teamlead of in een vergelijkbare rol.
Je hebt een achtergrond in softwareontwikkeling of product ownership, waardoor je een geloofwaardige sparringpartner bent voor het team en vlot kunt deelnemen aan prioriteringsdiscussies.
Je hebt een gedegen kennis van Jira en voelt je comfortabel bij het configureren van boards, het beheren van backlogs en het vergroten van de transparantie binnen teams.
Je beschikt over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en weet technische details moeiteloos te vertalen naar businessprioriteiten en omgekeerd.
Je beheerst het Engels vloeiend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, aangezien dit de voertaal is binnen het team. Kennis van het Nederlands is een pluspunt.
Je bent bereid om af en toe te reizen om teamleden of stakeholders in andere landen te ontmoeten.
Je hebt een pragmatische mindset gericht op continue verbetering en ziet Agile als een middel om samenwerking en waardecreatie te stimuleren, niet als een doel op zich.
Ervaring met het Horizon\-platform of een gelijkaardig product/domein is een troef.
Relevante certificeringen zoals PSM, CSM, PSPO, SAFe of gelijkwaardig zijn een pluspunt, net als ervaring met Confluence of andere documentatietools.
Je werkt minstens twee dagen per week vanuit ons kantoor in Hasselt (Corda Campus), aangevuld met tijd in een ander Cegeka\-kantoor (bij voorkeur Leuven) en thuiswerk.
Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?
We vragen heel wat (talenten) van jou. Gelukkig krijg je er ook heel wat voor terug! Competenties en karakter zijn voor ons essentieel, naast ervaring en ambities. Cegeka investeert voortdurend in talent management opdat alle medewerkers hun potentieel kunnen realiseren.
Je start bij een Top Employer.
Een marktconform dagtarief en tal van voordelen.
Cegeka bewijst jaar na jaar in het Whitelane Research dat we een betrouwbare en toonaangevende partner zijn op vlak van IT\-dienstverlening, met een eerste plaats in 2026 voor Security Services (vierde jaar op rij), een gedeelde tweede plaats voor Cloud \& Infrastructure Services en Network \& Connectivity.
Flexibele werkuren én een mooie work/life balans.
Een top team: waarin nieuwe frisse ideeën en initiatieven steeds welkom zijn! Team\-events, happy hours en een steeds legendarisch bedrijfsfeest horen daar ook bij.
Begeleiding op maat: doorheen jouw carrière word je begeleid door onze people managers. Zo heb je een aanspreekpunt, een persoonlijke coach én een sparringpartner.
Continu bijleren: door innovation centers, leesgroepen, knowledge sharing meetings, hackatons, deelname aan conferenties en externe opleidingen zetten we kennisdeling en bijleren centraal.
Mogelijkheid tot groei: afhankelijk van je eigen interesses en initiatieven, biedt Cegeka verschillende horizontale en verticale carrièrepaden.
Hybride werken: je werkt vanuit een Cegeka kantoor in jouw buurt (Hasselt, Leuven, Antwerpen, Gent, Diegem), maar ook bij onze klanten, gecombineerd met thuiswerk.
We hechten waarde aan duurzaamheid door CO2\-neutraliteit na te streven met de elektrificatie van ons wagenpark en een milieuvriendelijk datacenter. We ontwikkelen innovatieve oplossingen met een positieve impact op milieu, mens en maatschappij, en streven naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen gewaardeerd en gehoord wordt.

Devoteam is a leading consulting firm focused on digital transformation. We help ourclients leverage technology to achieve their business goals. services.

 **Job Description** **About the Team**

Our multidisciplinary teams work on high\-impact projects for top\-tier clients across industries — from intelligent automation to large\-scale platform modernizations. We foster a culture of curiosity, continuous learning, and creative problem\-solving.

As a Senior Java Developer at Devoteam Creative Tech, you will take on a prominent role in designing, building, and maintaining high\-performance enterprise applications and modern back\-end services, with foundational capabilities in any front\-end frameworks (e.g., Angular, React, Vue.js). This is an AI Augmented position: you are expected to actively integrate AI tools and techniques into your daily workflow to accelerate development, drive code quality, and build intelligent application features.

**Front\-End \& Web**

 **Additional Information** **What We Offer**

* A challenging and varied role within Devoteam Creative Tech, Belgium's leading tech consultancy.
* Work on cutting\-edge projects combining modern software development with AI innovation.
* A competitive salary package including company car, net allowances, meal vouchers, and group insurance.

* Experience with cloud orchestration.
* Experience with generative AI.
* A track record of taking machine learning models or AI products into production for customers.
* Strong communication skills and experience working with stakeholders on ambiguous data science problems.

jobs.title: Tender Engineer
jobs.description:
**Analytical. Structured. Service\-minded.**  

  

*As a Tender Engineer at Sarens, you prepare technical\-commercial proposals for heavy lifting and specialized transport projects worldwide. You analyse client requests, coordinate input from engineering and support departments, and translate all this into clear, competitive offers. You work closely with Sales and Project teams to find the best balance between safety, budget, scope and timing. In this role, you help our clients and our organisation rise to every challenge in line with our motto: Nothing Too Heavy, Nothing Too High.*  

  

**Join the force behind \#NOTHING TOO HEAVY, NOTHING TOO HIGH**


Due to a large number of opportunities, we are looking for a driven Sales Coordinator / Tender Specialist to strengthen the Sarens Projects team. In this role, you aim to  

provide clients with a structured, solution\-oriented, and clear proposal within the  

agreed timeline. In collaboration with the Key Account Manager, you clarify the proposal and respondto the client's questions.  

Your future responsibilities as a Tender Specialist include:  

  

**Your future responsibilities in a nutshell:**  

* You analyse and summarise client requests and tender documents, identifying technical, commercial and planning requirements.
* You develop technical\-commercial proposals for heavy lifting and engineered transport projects together with the responsible Key Account Manager or Sales Manager.
* You coordinate input from internal stakeholders (Engineering, Logistics, HR, SHEQ, Finance, etc.) and guard deadlines to submit complete, structured and high\-quality offers.
* You prepare cost calculations, support pricing decisions and review them together with the Sales Support Manager and/or management.
* You ensure that all proposals are submitted on time, in line with internal approvals, and you follow up questions or clarifications with the client in coordination with Sales.
* You act as a proud Sarens ambassador, providing professional support to our global Sales and Projects organisation.
* You report to the **Sales Support Manager** and work from **Sarens HQ, Wolvertem**, in close collaboration with the wider Sales Support and Project teams.


\-
**ABOUT YOU**


We are looking for a **stress\-resistant multitasker** with a **hands\-on mentality**, s**trong writing skills, and a solution\-focused, positive attitude.** You have a strong interest in the world of specialized transport and heavy lifting. You possess good reading and listening skills, enabling you to detect and anticipate customer needs. You think outside the box in search of the best solution. You are a sociable team player with a strong sense of responsibility. You work in a structured and precise manner, with attention to detail.  

**Customer focus, drive, and proactivity are key to success in this role.**  

  

**What you bring to Team Blue:**  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a **technical field** (e.g. engineering, electromechanics, construction) or equivalent through experience.
* Interest in or experience with **sales support, technical inside sales or tender engineering** (experience in a project or industrial environment is a plus).
* Technical affinity with **heavy lifting and/or exceptional transport**, or a strong eagerness to learn and build this knowledge quickly.
* Strong communication skills in **Dutch or French**, with a good working knowledge of **English** so you can interact with colleagues and clients in our international context.
* Solid computer skills, including **MS Office** (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint).
* A structured and precise way of working, with great attention to detail and documentation quality.
* A **proactive, positive and solution\-focused attitude**, with the courage to ask questions and challenge assumptions when needed.
* A genuine interest in **working safely** and contributing to reliable, high\-quality project execution for our clients worldwide.

**\-**
**YOU GIVE SOME, YOU GET SOME**


As a Tender Engineer, you’ll take on an exciting and varied role where you can apply both your technical insight and commercial flair. You are a crucial link in the success of Sarens Projects—thanks to you, new projects will be won! In other words, you are part of the very beginning of every fascinating project, and later you'll see them come to life through the work of your fantastic colleagues!

 **What we offer you:**  

* A **competitive salary**, including a company car, meal vouchers, DKV hospitalisation insurance, group insurance and a net expense allowance.
* A **permanent, full\-time contract** (40 hours/week) with flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home part of the time.
* Legal holidays and public holidays, plus **12 additional ADV days** (reduction of working hours) for a healthy work\-life balance.
* An **informal, supportive atmosphere** with helpful colleagues in our Sarens HQ in Wolvertem – you are part of Team Blue from day one.
* A front\-row seat at the start of **iconic heavy lifting projects worldwide.** You see the projects you helped win come to life on site.
* Room to grow technical and commercial learning opportunities, international exposure and the chance to shape your career within a global group active in more than 65 countries.

  

Sarens is an **equal opportunity employer**. We welcome talent regardless of gender, background, religion, orientation or age. What counts for us is your safety mindset, your skills and your motivation to help us deliver brilliant solutions to our clients.  

  

**Ready to join Team Blue as our Tender Engineer in Wolvertem and help us prove that there is Nothing Too Heavy, Nothing Too High?**

jobs.title: Senior .NET-Entwickler – Lagerlogistik & mobile Anwendungen (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Leobersdorf / As of now / Full\-time employee
  
  

Worum geht es
  
  

**Wir modernisieren unsere Lagerverwaltung:** Ziel sind digitale Echtzeit\-Prozesse von der Umbuchung über die Entnahme bis zur automatisierten Pickliste für die Produktion. Technisch setzen wir auf .NET\-Microservices (AWS), eine Blazor\-Webanwendung und eine .NET MAUI App für Android\-Handhelds. Das Herzstück bildet SAP Business One, an das wir über den Service Layer andocken. Wir suchen keinen reinen Framework\-Spezialisten, sondern einen systematischen Kopf, der bestehende Prozesse durchdringt, Schwachstellen identifiziert und proaktiv bessere Wege aufzeigt.
  
  

Ihre Aufgaben
  
  

**Entwicklung und Betrieb von .NET\-Microservices auf AWS:** Fokus auf Buchungsservices, Lagerstandsabfragen und automatisierte Labelgenerierung.
  
  

**Anbindung an SAP Business One:** Integration über den Service Layer mit sauberer Kapselung der Schnittstellenlogik.
  
  

**Blazor\- \& .NET MAUI\-Anwendungen:** Entwicklung effizienter Lösungen für den Desktop\-Arbeitsplatz und mobile Android\-Handhelds, um Lagerprozesse direkt vor Ort intuitiv und schnell abzubilden.
  
  

**Optimierung der Barcode\- und QR\-Erfassung:** Gestaltung digitaler Workflows, die im Lageralltag für messbare Geschwindigkeitsvorteile sorgen.
  
  

**Aktive Mitgestaltung:** Einflussnahme auf die Architektur und die Auswahl des passenden Technologie\-Stacks.
  
**Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachabteilungen:** Analyse bestehender Lagerprozesse und proaktive Erarbeitung effizienterer Lösungswege.
  
  

**Sicherstellung der Nachvollziehbarkeit:** Aufbau von Systemen, die Fehlbuchungen transparent machen, erklärbar und korrigierbar halten.
  
  

Ihr Profil
  
Mehrjährige Erfahrung in C\# / .NET auf Senior\-Niveau inkl. Systemverantwortung
  
Systematisches, analytisches Denken mit starkem Fokus auf Prozessabläufe
  
Erfahrung mit Cloud\-Infrastruktur, idealerweise AWS

Wir bieten
  
**Arbeitszeit:** 38,5 Stunden / Woche in Gleitzeit, Home\-Office\-Option nach der Einschulung

Echte Mitgestaltung bei Architektur und Technologiewahl
  
KI\-gestützte Entwicklungsumgebung als Standard
  
Konzern\-Skalierung (Cimpress\-Netzwerk) kombiniert mit direkter Nähe zur Produktion in Leobersdorf
  
  

Mehr Einkommen
  
  

Mehr Urlaub
  
  

Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  
  

Firmenparkplatz
  
  

Firmenevents
  
  

Überzahlung
  
  

Gesundheits\-
  
förderung
  
  

verlässlicher Arbeitgeber
  
  

Mitarbeiter\-
  
rabatte
  
  

Bikeleasing
  
  

Über uns
  
  

Als persönliche und schnelle Onlinedruckerei in Österreich verknüpfen wir erstklassigen Kundenservice mit bester
  
Produktions\-Qualität. Seit 2001 garantieren wir an unserem Standort in Leobersdorf/NÖ mit über 250
  
**Mitarbeiter:** innen die rasche Bearbeitung von mehr als 200\.000 Produkten im Digital\-, Offset\- und Großformatdruck.
  
Diese können bei uns rund um die Uhr ganz einfach online bestellt werden.
  
**Für Entwickler:** innen ist der zweite Teil der Geschichte der interessantere: Wir gehören zum Cimpress\-Konzern –

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer Container - Post Business Solutions GmbH
jobs.description:
**Das sind wir**

  



Erlebe das Beste aus zwei Welten: Unser Geschäftsfeld Post Business Solutions agiert als starker B2B Digital Services Provider im sicheren Konzernumfeld der Österreichischen Post AG. Als führende Anbieterin von B2B\-Lösungen in den Bereichen Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und Outsourcing von Geschäftsprozessen gestalten wir moderne Informations\- und Dokumentenprozesse für unsere Kund\*innen.

Für diese Position wirst du Teil eines kleinen, pragmatischen Teams, das ein zentrales System betreibt, über das geschäftskritische Daten aus Produktionsabläufen gesammelt, verarbeitet und für Verrechnung, Versand sowie weitere Geschäftsprozesse bereitgestellt werden. Unsere Systemlandschaft ist über viele Jahre gewachsen und befindet sich aktuell in einer intensiven Modernisierungsphase. Dabei treiben wir die Containerisierung unserer Anwendungen, den Abbau technischer Schulden sowie die Automatisierung von Betriebsprozessen voran.

Wenn du Freude daran hast, moderne Plattformen mitzugestalten, nachhaltige technische Lösungen zu entwickeln und gemeinsam im Team Dinge voranzubringen, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.  



**Was bei dir ankommt**

  



* **Finanzielle Vorteile \& Zusatzleistungen:** 400,\- EUR Essensbons jährlich, gratis bank99‑Konto, jährliche Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg sowie bis zu 3\.000,\- EUR Ersparnis pro Jahr mit „goodie – die Post Bonuswelt“ (Rabatte für Reisen, Shopping, Sport \& Gesundheit sowie Events \& Kultur)
* **Urlaub \& Erholung:** Vergünstigte Urlaubsangebote in über 40 postsozial‑Ferienhäusern und Partnerhotels
* **Mitarbeiter\*innenvorteile:** Attraktive Handy‑ und Internettarife der Post‑Eigenmarke „Yelllow“, auch für Family \& Friends
* **Gesundheit \& Arbeitsumfeld:** Ganzheitliche Gesundheitsförderung mit vielfältigen Maßnahmen sowie ein kollegiales und krisensicheres Arbeitsumfeld

  



**Worauf es in diesem Job ankommt**

  



* Du entwickelst und betreibst gemeinsam mit dem Team eine stabile, sichere und skalierbare Container\-Plattform.
* Du automatisierst Infrastruktur\- und Betriebsprozesse mithilfe von Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD\-Pipelines und Skripting.
* Du analysierst wiederkehrende Incidents und Betriebsprobleme und sorgst für nachhaltige Lösungen statt kurzfristiger Workarounds.
* Du identifizierst Automatisierungs\- und Optimierungspotenziale und reduzierst manuelle Tätigkeiten.
* Du arbeitest an modernen Deployment\- und Betriebsstrategien für bestehende und neue Anwendungen.
* Du unterstützt die Modernisierung unserer gewachsenen Systemlandschaft und bringst dein Know\-how im Bereich Plattform\-Engineering ein.
* Du dokumentierst Lösungen, teilst dein Wissen im Team und bringst neue Ideen ein.

  



**Worauf es uns ankommt**

  



* Du bringst Erfahrung mit Containern und Container\-Plattformen mit.
* Du verfügst über gute Linux\-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit automatisierten Deployment\- und Betriebsprozessen.
* Du hast bereits mit Infrastructure as Code gearbeitet oder möchtest dein Know\-how in diesem Bereich gezielt ausbauen.
* Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung in C\#, Blazor und oder CI/CD\-Plattformen
* Du interessierst dich für Cloud\-native\-Technologien, moderne Plattformarchitekturen und komplexe Systemlandschaften.
* Du analysierst gerne Ursachen, denkst lösungsorientiert und arbeitest erfolgreich im Team.
* Kenntnisse in Azure sowie Tools wie Terraform, Ansible, Bicep sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss

  



Bezahlung je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation, jedoch mindestens 57\.000,\- Euro brutto jährlich (All\-in, inklusive MbO\-Zielvereinbarung).

  





Wir haben dein Interesse geweckt? Dann bewirb dich jetzt bei uns!
Ich freu mich über deine Bewerbung.
Deine Recruiterin Starrina  


  

**Wir sind gelb, grün und bunt. Weil auf Nachhaltigkeit, Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit kommt's an, wie's ankommt.**  

  

Informationen zum Datenschutz für Bewerber\*innen der Österreichischen Post AG findest du hier.

jobs.title: Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
SS\&C is a leading provider of mission\-critical, AI\-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid\-market firms, rely on SS\&C for expertise, scale, and technology.  



  

**Job Description**

  

Job Title: **Integration Engineer**

Location: **Madrid, Spain \| Hybrid 6 days a month**

**SS\&C Algorithmics**

The SS\&C Algorithmics (part of SS\&C Technologies Inc.) financial risk, regulatory and performance platform serves banking, insurance, asset management and hedge fund institutions. We partner with clients around the world to respond proactively and transparently to regulatory requirements and solve the most complex challenges in financial risk management and performance measurement.


**The Opportunity**

As an Integration Engineer, you will work across a broad technical stack including Linux, databases, scripting, interfaces, middleware, cloud and automation. Rather than focusing on a single technology, you will learn how complex enterprise systems are designed, integrated, deployed, tested and operated in real\-world environments.


This role is a great opportunity for a technically minded engineer who wants to combine hands\-on technology with real client exposure and ownership of complex implementation projects, and who enjoys understanding how systems work end\-to\-end, solving difficult technical problems and working with people as much as with technology.


You will work closely with some of the largest financial institutions in Europe, collaborating directly with client technology teams, project managers, financial engineers and SS\&C product specialists. From an early stage, you will be encouraged to take ownership of technical problems, contribute to solution design and become a trusted technical advisor to clients.


**What You Will Get To Do:**

* Define and specify the technical architecture and design of the SS\&C Algorithmics solution to be implemented.
* Define and scope the technical configuration, interfacing and enhancement work in conjunction with project managers, senior engineers and financial engineers.
* Provide technical consultancy to clients based on solid understanding of the Algo product suite and implementation requirements.
* Set up and configure Algorithmics and third\-party products (database, middleware, reporting solutions) at client sites.
* Design and implement interfaces between clients’ source systems and SS\&C Algorithmics products. This will largely involve the Algorithmics’ data mapping tool and definition of data required from the clients’ systems.
* Design, develop and implement customised modules using a range of development tools (typically shell, Perl or Python).
* Conduct troubleshooting, testing (functional and volume) for original installation and system upgrades, and support clients’ integration testing and acceptance testing activities.
* Where appropriate, deliver training through formal courses and workshop sessions for clients and internal teams.
* Produce technical documentation for clients describing the system and its customisations.

**What You Will Bring:**

* Bachelor's Degree in a technical degree (e.g., Computer science, telecom engineering, or a related technical field.
* English \& Spanish: Fluent
* High degree of initiative, resourcefulness, resilience, and self\-sufficiency in implementing and configuring complex software products and using technology to solve business problems.
* Hands\-on command of Unix / Linux, including shell scripting and file system navigation.
* Basic programming experience in at least one language (e.g., Java, Python, C\#, C\+\+, Kotlin, Rust
* AI \& Productivity Tools: Experience using AI agents \& tools.
* Capacity to estimate work, manage own deliverables and keep within project plans.
* Ability to work with competing demands in small multi\-disciplinary teams.
* Sound documentation and communication skills in a client\-facing environment.

**Desired:**

* Experience with middleware and business intelligence (reporting) software.
* Understanding of database essentials (including SQL, installation, sizing, performance). Specific DBA skills are not essential, but familiarity with at least one RDBMS is required.
* Client\-facing culture
* Familiarity with DevOps \& Cloud
* Understanding of the financial marketplace (market data, fixed income products, derivatives) in terms of the underlying data.

Familiarity with risk management (market risk/credit risk in a commercial or treasury environment), financial analytics and market data  

  



**Why You Will Love It Here!**

* **Flexibility** : Hybrid Work Model
* **Your Future:** Professional Development Reimbursement including access to SS\&C University
* **Work/Life Balance:** Competitive holiday scheme
* **Your Wellbeing:** Competitive benefits designed to support the wellbeing of our staff
* **Diversity \& Inclusion:** Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving on Diversity
* **Training:** Hands\-On, Team\-Customised throughout your career

*We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds to enable us to bring diverse perspectives to our thinking and conversation. It's important to us that we strive to have a workforce that is diverse in the widest sense.*

Thank you for your interest in SS\&C! If applicable, to further explore this opportunity, please apply directly with us through our Careers page on our corporate website @ www.ssctech.com/careers .

Join a team that’s making a tangible difference. Our work in intelligent buildings, energy efficiency, and digital integration is directly contributing to a more sustainable and resilient future for communities in Spain and beyond.


**The Opportunity**


This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects, including commercial, industrial, healthcare, data centres, and educational sectors.


As a Building Controls Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, integrating, and optimizing control systems to enhance building performance and contribute to our innovation building automation initiatives.


You will also have the opportunity to drive innovation in building automation, IoT integration, and energy\-efficient control strategies, shaping the future of intelligent building systems at Arup.


**As a Junior Building Controls Engineer at Arup, you will:**


* Design BMS/building controls systems to optimize building performance and streamline building management, including applications in commercial, industrial, and Data Centre environments.
* Work closely with disciplines like Mechanical, Electrical, ICT, Smart Buildings, and Digital to ensure fully integrated control solutions.
* Ensure seamless integration of BMS, EPMS, and HVAC control systems into overall building design, with consideration for Data Centres where required..
* Conduct design studies and produce conceptual design reports.
* Prepare contract documentation, specifications, and drawings ensuring compliance.
* Conduct surveys and site inspections.
* Witness control system commissioning, ensuring proper execution and alignment with design, including Data Centre BMS and EPMS where applicable.

**Does this role inspire you?**


We are looking for someone who is passionate about smart building automation and energy\-efficient control systems. We also value:


* A bachelor's degree in Controls, Mechatronics, Building Services, Mechanical, or Electrical Services Engineering.
* 3\-4 years' experience designing building control systems (BMS, BAS, or HVAC Controls).
* Actively working towards or interested in achieving Chartered Engineer status
* Experience in Data Centre projects.
* Experience with PLC (programmable Logic Controllers) and DDC (Direct Digital Control) systems, particularly in complex building environments, including Data Centre.
* Familiarity with the latest standards and regulations relevant to building control systems, with knowledge of Data Centre\-specific standards (ASHRAE, Uptime Institute, ISO 50001\).
* Proficiency in software tools commonly used in the building controls sector.

**Why Arup?**


At Arup, we offer a rewarding career with a global company committed to a better future. Our unique trust ownership structure allows us to prioritize meaningful work and invest in our people. We also offer a unique profit share program, allowing our members to share in the results of our collective efforts.


**Benefits that work for you:**


* **Professional Growth \& Development:** Benefit from continuous learning opportunities, training programs, and mentorship to enhance your skills and advance your career at Arup.
* **Global Opportunities**: Collaborate with colleagues worldwide and explore potential short\-term or long\-term assignments at other Arup offices and project locations.
* **Financial Well\-being \& Ownership**: Receive a competitive salary and benefits package and share in Arup's success through our global profit\-sharing programme.
* **Work\-Life Balance:** We offer a hybrid working model and flexible working arrangements to support work\-life balance.
* **Well\-being and Culture:** Access to a range of well\-being programs, including sports subsidies, social activities, and initiatives promoting a healthy work\-life balance. We foster a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued.

Arup is recognized as one of the best companies to work for in Spain in 2026 by Actualidad Económica and Forbes magazine, thanks to our flexibility policies. We also adhere to the Code of Principles of Generational Diversity, committing to equal opportunities regardless of age.


At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective where individuality is encouraged. Our strength comes from how we respect, share, and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. You’ll have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning—to Arup, to your career, and to the clients and communities we serve.


We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of the world around us. We actively promote a culture of inclusion where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued.


We welcome applications from talented individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible. We’re here to support you.


**Do you want to join us in shaping a better world?**
