new_jobs.title: Senior .NET & Azure Developer | DevOps Engineering
new_jobs.description:
**This is what we offer you**
-----------------------------

* **Salary:** Gross monthly salary between EUR 4,105 and EUR 5,862 (scale 08\) for a 36\-hour work week.
* **Extras:** a thirteenth month, 8% holiday allowance, and a 10% Employee Benefit Budget.
* **Development budget:** EUR 1,400 development budget per year for your growth and development.
* **Hybrid working:** a balance between home and office work (possible for most roles).
* **Pension:** decide for yourself the amount of your personal contribution.


Or view all our benefits.

**Senior .NET \& Azure Developer \| DevOps Engineering**


Do you want to improve how engineers develop and deploy software through Azure DevOps, .NET and Microsoft Azure?

**Summary**
-----------


As a Senior .NET \& Azure Developer at Rabobank, you will work within Tech4Dev on technology that enables efficient DevOps and work\-item management. You will use C\#, .NET Core, Microsoft Azure and Azure DevOps to automate and standardise services for Rabobank engineers.


Tech4Dev supports more than 400 squads that build Rabobank’s modern digital experience. Your work helps engineers onboard, design solutions, manage tasks, develop software and deploy changes efficiently, while meeting high standards for quality, performance and security.


At a glance:

* Develop reliable and scalable backend services with C\#, .NET Core and Microsoft Azure.
* Customise and extend Azure DevOps services using APIs, pipelines and automation.
* Improve the development experience for engineers across more than 400 squads.

**What will you do as a Senior .NET \& Azure Developer?**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain backend solutions in C\# and .NET Core that support DevOps and work\-item management for Rabobank engineers.
* Customise and extend Azure DevOps services through platform administration, Azure DevOps Pipelines, APIs and the Microsoft Graph REST API.
* Automate development and deployment processes to help engineers onboard, build features and release software efficiently.
* Build reliable and scalable services with Microsoft Azure components such as Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Service, Azure Storage Accounts and Azure SQL.
* Collaborate with squad members, the product owner, scrum master and solution architect to balance technical quality, security and business priorities.

**Skills, tools and areas of expertise**
----------------------------------------


In this role, you will work with or develop knowledge of:

* C\#, .NET and .NET Core.
* Microsoft Azure, including Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Service, Azure Storage Accounts and Azure SQL.
* Azure DevOps, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Azure DevOps administration and Azure DevOps APIs.
* API design, API development and the Microsoft Graph REST API.
* Continuous integration and continuous delivery, DevOps methods and the software development lifecycle.
* Git, source control and branching strategies.
* Infrastructure as Code with Bicep and Terraform.
* MSSQL and Azure SQL.
* Bash, PowerShell or Python scripting.
* AI\-enabled development tools.
* Process automation, reporting and analytics integrations.

**Together we achieve more than alone**
---------------------------------------


We believe in the power of differences. By combining people's differences, we become an even better bank. We are curious about what you will bring to our team Tech4Dev.


Within Tribe Tech4Engineering, the Tech4Dev squads develop tools and supporting processes for more than 400 squads. You will work with your squad members, the product owner, scrum master and solution architect to provide reliable and easy\-to\-use services for Rabobank engineers.

**Work on yourself \& the world around you**
--------------------------------------------


For us, your development and that of society go hand in hand. That is why we want to invest in you and work together to create a better world. We summarise this in one sentence: at Rabobank, you work on yourself and the world around you at the same time.

**Why everyone is welcome at Rabobank**
---------------------------------------


At Rabobank, we are working towards a culture where everyone feels welcome. We value our differences and use them to collaborate more effectively and make better decisions. By being open to different perspectives, we create an environment where colleagues feel heard.

**What do you bring?**
----------------------


Must\-haves:

* Senior\-level experience in .NET development, including backend programming with C\# and .NET Core.
* Strong knowledge and practical experience of Microsoft Azure cloud services, including Azure Storage Accounts, Azure Container Apps, Azure Functions, Azure App Service and Azure SQL.
* Experience in API design and development.
* Experience with Azure DevOps setup and administration, Azure DevOps Pipelines and the Microsoft Graph REST API.
* Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous delivery, DevOps methods and the software development lifecycle.
* Experience using AI\-enabled development tools to improve productivity, code quality and solution outcomes.
* Knowledge of Git, source control and branching strategies.
* Experience with MSSQL.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, particularly Bicep, and familiarity with Terraform.
* Scripting skills in Bash, PowerShell or Python.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field.
* A critical and analytical approach to identifying the root cause of problems.
* The ability to communicate with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* A proactive and practical approach, with ownership of problems and outcomes.
* The legal right to work in the Netherlands.

**Nice\-to\-haves:**
--------------------

* Deep knowledge of Azure DevOps APIs and services.
* Experience developing Azure DevOps extensions.
* Experience building APIs and data services for reporting, analytics and integration platforms such as Backstage and Kong.
* Experience developing Power BI semantic models.
* Experience developing Power BI reports.
* AZ\-400: DevOps Engineer Expert certification.
* AZ\-204: Azure Developer Associate certification.
* DP\-900: Azure Data Fundamentals certification.
* Experience supporting teams with onboarding or migration to new technologies.
* Experience with large\-scale rollouts in complex enterprise environments.
* Leadership skills and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively.

**Frequently asked questions**
------------------------------

**Is this role suitable for my experience level?**


This is a senior\-level .NET and Microsoft Azure development role. You need senior\-level .NET experience and practical knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, APIs and DevOps engineering.

**What will I do each day as a Senior .NET \& Azure Developer?**


You will develop backend services, customise Azure DevOps, automate development processes and improve tools used by Rabobank engineers. You will work with your squad, product owner, scrum master and solution architect.

**Which skills, tools or technologies will I use?**


You will use C\#, .NET Core, Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure DevOps Pipelines, APIs, Git, Bicep and scripting languages such as Bash, PowerShell or Python.

**Which team will I join and who will I work with?**


You will join Tech4Dev within Tribe Tech4Engineering. You will work with squad members, the product owner, scrum master and solution architect to improve services for Rabobank engineers.

**What does the application process look like?**


Your CV and answers to 3 application questions will be used in the first assessment round. Interviews will take place by video call, and a screening and an assignment are part of the process.

**Apply**
---------


To ensure that we assess all candidates equally for suitability for this position, we do not require a cover letter. Instead, we ask all candidates the same three questions to see how your profile matches the position. Pay sufficient attention to answering these questions and explaining your answers; this, together with your CV, is the only information we will use to evaluate you in this round. If this is missing from your application, your application will not be considered. You can draw on your work, volunteer work, education, private life, and so on. Use a maximum of 200 words per question and provide no more than two examples. Below are the questions:

* How should an enterprise\-wide DevOps platform be set up to make sure the process is secure and developers can work efficiently?
* What do you think about having standard rules versus being flexible when setting up DevOps processes in an enterprise?
* If you use Azure DevOps, what automation opportunities do you see?

**You and the application process**
-----------------------------------


Apply for the Senior .NET \& Azure Developer vacancy at Rabobank.

* Questions about working at Rabobank or the process? Contact Niels Diks IT Recruiter, via Niels.Diks@rabobank.nl.
* Interviews will take place via video call.
* If you are invited for an interview, Bo, our virtual assistant, will contact you by SMS and email to schedule the interview.
* A reliability assessment is part of the procedure.
* An assessment can be part of the application process.
* You can find answers to frequently asked questions here: Rabobank application FAQs.
* We respect your privacy: Rabobank privacy information.


You must be based in the Netherlands or elsewhere in the European Union and have the legal right to work in the Netherlands. Rabobank cannot consider applicants who require relocation from another country.

new_jobs.title: Manager Product Engineering Energiesystemen (HVAC & Energy Systems)
new_jobs.description:
Wil jij bouwen aan de energievoorziening van broederijen over de hele wereld? Heb je een duidelijke visie op duurzame energiesystemen en krijg je energie van het ontwikkelen van slimme, schaalbare producten? Dan is deze rol als Manager Product Engineering Energiesystemen bij HatchTech iets voor jou.

  

In deze fulltime functie (intern noemen we deze rol Product Group Owner Energy), ben je verantwoordelijk voor de complete productgroep Energy. Je ontwikkelt samen met jouw team van 5 personen en groeiend, modulaire oplossingen voor verwarmen, koelen, ventileren, perslucht, elektriciteit en andere energievoorzieningen rondom onze incubators. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar vandaag, maar ook naar de broederij van de toekomst: Energiezuinig, modulair en schaalbaar pushed to the max.


Je combineert technische diepgang met ondernemerschap, productontwikkeling en teamleiderschap. Daarbij krijg je veel ruimte om richting te geven aan de strategie, roadmap en innovatie van de productgroep.

 **In deze baan**


Als Manager Product Engineering Energiesystemen stuur je de ontwikkeling van de complete productgroep aan. Je vertaalt complexe energiesystemen naar slimme, modulaire bouwblokken. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

* Ontwikkelen van een visie en roadmap voor de productgroep Energy.
* Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van energie\-efficiënte producten en systemen.
* Integreren van koel\-, verwarmings\- en energiesystemen binnen onze totaaloplossingen.
* Opzetten, uitbreiden en begeleiden van een team van engineers.
* Initiëren en leiden van ontwikkelprojecten binnen de bestaande projectstructuur.
* Beoordelen van klantfeedback en vertalen naar verbeteringen.
* Samenwerken met Product Group Owners van Incubators en Software \& Control.
* Ontwikkelen van tools waarmee Sales eenvoudig de juiste configuraties kan samenstellen.
* Presenteren (en prioriteren) van nieuwe concepten, innovaties en investeringsvoorstellen aan het management.


Je werkt vanuit het principe van modulariteit en standaardisatie: producten moeten wereldwijd inzetbaar, schaalbaar en eenvoudig toepasbaar zijn. Een beetje zoals IKEA, maar dan voor industriële energiesystemen.

 **Wie zoeken we?**


Je bent een ervaren specialist die techniek, visie en leiderschap combineert. Je vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken terug te brengen naar slimme en praktische oplossingen.


Je brengt mee:

* WO\-werk\- en denkniveau.
* Bijvoorbeeld een achtergrond in Energietechniek, Duurzame Energiesystemen, Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechanical Engineering, Sustainable Energy Technology of vergelijkbaar.
* Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring op gebied van energiesystemen.
* Ervaring met bijvoorbeeld industriële energiesystemen, luchtbehandeling, warmtepompen, chillers, HVAC of vergelijkbare technieken.
* Ervaring met productontwikkeling en technische innovatie.
* Wat ervaring met het aansturen van engineers of technische teams (hoeft geen 10 jaar te zijn).
* Je woont in de buurt van Veenendaal (max 30 min), want we vinden het fijn als je een niet al te lange reistijd hebt.


Mooi meegenomen:

* Ervaring met internationale projecten.
* Ervaring binnen machinebouw, industriële installaties of duurzame energie.
* Kennis van de agrarische sector.


Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

* Je hebt een eigen visie en durft keuzes te maken.
* Je durft te denken voorbij de status\-quo (onorthodoxe creatieve ideeën mogen de ruimte krijgen).
* Je scheid hoofd\- en bijzaken snel van elkaar.
* Je bent ondernemend en neemt eigenaarschap.
* Je kunt technische complexiteit eenvoudig maken.
* Je bent een teamspeler die mensen weet te verbinden.

 **Wat je van ons kunt verwachten**


Bij HatchTech krijg je de kans om een belangrijke rol te spelen in de toekomst van onze producten én die van onze klanten. We voeden de wereld van morgen. Daarbij hebben we uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden te bieden:

* Een fulltime baan die de komende 10 jaar niet verveelt.
* We belonen je met een salaris tussen de € 6\.000,00 en € 7\.500,00 bruto per maand, op basis van 40 uur per week;
* Je krijgt 26 vakantiedagen en als dat niet genoeg is voor je reisavonturen kun je kiezen voor nog 13 ADV\-dagen extra (beide o.b.v. fulltime).
* Vanzelfsprekend hebben we 8% vakantiegeld.
* Reiskosten van € 0,25 per kilometer met een maximum van 25 km enkele reis.
* Je pensioen is goed geregeld: wij betalen ruim de helft
* Je kunt aandeelhouder worden en meeliften op het succes van HatchTech. We geloven in ‘delen is vermenigvuldigen’.
* We werken schouder aan schouder, 100% vanaf kantoor in een jaloersmakend mooi en groen pand, langs de A12 en dicht bij station Veenendaal\-de Klomp.

  

Hiernaast kun je rekenen op:

* Een sleutelpositie binnen een innovatieve internationale organisatie.
* Veel vrijheid om richting te geven aan jouw productgroep.
* Directe invloed op productstrategie en innovatie.
* Een team van betrokken engineers in Nederland en Oekraïne.
* Werken aan duurzame oplossingen met wereldwijde impact.
* Ruimte voor initiatief, ondernemerschap en persoonlijke groei.

 **Ben jij onze Manager Product Engineering Energiesystemen?**


Wil jij jouw kennis van duurzame energiesystemen inzetten om een nieuwe productgroep verder vorm te geven? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.


Je kunt ons bellen of een bericht sturen. Vragen over de functie beantwoordt Hendrik Kemp (leidinggevende) met liefde en plezier. Het nummer is \+31 318 512 511\. Wij kunnen je alles vertellen over onze mensen en de mogelijkheden en zijn benieuwd naar jouw wensen en ambities.


Ben je al helemaal overtuigd? Gebruik dan de sollicitatiebutton. We zien je sollicitatie graag tegemoet!

 *Wij werven zelf en verzoeken bureaus vriendelijk om geen contact op te nemen.*

### **Over HatchTech**


Bij HatchTech Group zijn we net even anders; A Different Breed. Niet om anders te zijn, maar om elke innovatie die we bedenken de volgende dag weer te overtreffen. Voor het beter voeden van de wereld, tot aan de service die we bieden voor onze klanten en het streven om dierwelzijn te bevorderen. Bewandel niet de gebaande paden, leg nieuwe aan. Loop voorop, en je krijgt er veel “energie” ;) voor terug.

  

Meer weten? Kijk ook eens op www.werkenbijhatchtech.com

new_jobs.title: Data Engineer (m/w/d) – Datenmanagement
new_jobs.description:
Die **Sparkassen Rating und Risikosysteme (SR)** ist der zentrale Dienstleister für Verfahren des Risikomanagements in der Sparkassen\-Finanzgruppe. Wir unterstützen die Institute mit Standardlösungen in den Bereichen der Risikomessung und \-steuerung, der regulatorischen Banksteuerung sowie im Vertrieb mit Data\-Analytics\-Lösungen. Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern bieten wir den Instituten, von der Konzeption der Verfahren, über deren Weiterentwicklung, IT\-Umsetzung und Umsetzungsunterstützung, zentrale und standardisierte Lösungen an.

#### **Wir bieten Dir:**

* Eine unbefristete Tätigkeit in einem hoch versierten Arbeitsumfeld mit anspruchsvollen Aufgaben und einem **attraktiven Vergütungspaket**
* **30 Tage Urlaub** \+ 2 Bankfeiertage und zusätzlichen Sonderurlaub für besondere Anlässe
* **Betriebliche Altersvorsorge** und vermögenswirksame Leistungen
* **Individuelle interne \| externe Weiterbildung** über unsere Akademie
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Gleitzeit und Option zum mobilen Arbeiten für eine echte **Work\-Life\-Balance**
* **Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement**
* Zuzahlung zum **Jobticket** und **Essensgutscheine**
* **Dienstrad\-Leasing (JobRad)** als zusätzliches Mobilitätsangebot
* **Kostenfreie** Girokontoführung inkl. Visa Card Gold bei der Berliner Sparkasse
* **Interne Veranstaltungen:** Meet\-Ups, Afterworks, Sommer\- und Weihnachtsfeste
* Zentraler und **moderner Arbeitsplatz** im Herzen und über den Dächern von Berlin

#### **Das erwartet Dich:**


Du liebst Daten, tüftelst gerne an technischen Lösungen und möchtest aktiv an der Datenlandschaft der SR, einer der anspruchsvollsten in der Sparkassen\-Finanzgruppe, mitarbeiten? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams! Wir suchen Data Engineers, die mit Neugier, Know\-how und Teamgeist unsere Datenprozesse voranbringen.



Deine Aufgaben:


* Technischer Import und Bereitstellung von Daten
* Entwicklung, Wartung und Optimierung von Datenprozesse
* Unterstützung bei der Qualitätssicherung und Automatisierung
* Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und externen Datenlieferanten

#### **Das bringst Du mit:**

* Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium beispielsweise Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Ingenieurswesen, BWL oder eine vergleichbare Berufsausbildung
* Erfahrung im Umgang mit Datenbanken und ETL\-Prozessen
* Kenntnisse in C\#, SQL, MS SQL Server, Python oder vergleichbaren Tools
* Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

#### **Kontakt**


Wir freuen uns auf Deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen


**Bei Fragen:**  

**Herr Emanuel Reitzenstein** per E\-Mail an bewerbung@s\-rating\-risikosysteme.de



Bitte beachten Sie, dass die S Rating und Risikosysteme GmbH keine unaufgefordert durch Personalvermittlungen zugesandten Profile akzeptiert. Kommt es zur Berücksichtigung oder Einstellung von Kandidat:innen, deren Profile durch Personalvermittlungen mit denen kein Vertragsverhältnis besteht, übersandt wurde, besteht daher kein Vergütungsanspruch.

new_jobs.company: DKV EURO SERVICE GmbH + Co. KG
new_jobs.title: Head of Digital Product Platform (gn) full-time/ part-time
new_jobs.description:
Your job at DKV Mobility? As part of a leading European B2B platform for on\-the\-road payment solutions, you will work in an exciting environment. Our tasks are defined by our Purpose: To drive the transition towards an efficient and sustainable future of mobility. We offer you numerous opportunities to help shape the mobility of tomorrow in a dynamic and agile environment. Our approximately 2,700 employees throughout Europe are united by a common passion: to give their best every day for our customers in more than 50 countries. True to our claim: You drive, we care. Become part of our diverse, dedicated and unique team!


What you can expect
* You define the vision, strategy, and priorities for the digital product platform and align them with customer, business, and technology goals.
* You identify shared needs across product teams, user groups, and customer journeys and translate them into scalable platform capabilities.
* You drive reuse and accelerate the development of better products through common platform solutions.
* You lead, coach, and develop Product Managers, fostering both their professional and personal growth.
* You establish a culture centered on customer centricity, ownership, and outcome\-driven thinking.
* You build strong Product Trio teams together with Engineering and Design and promote effective collaboration between platform and product teams.
* You manage platform investments based on user value, strategic relevance, scalability, and business impact.

You define success metrics for adoption, effectiveness, and business value and ensure that platform investments deliver measurable results.  
* 
What makes you stand out
* You bring 7\+ years of Product Management experience in a SaaS, platform, or digital business environment, including leadership responsibility.
* You have a proven track record of delivering measurable customer and business outcomes and developing successful product or platform strategies.
* You are highly experienced in Continuous Discovery, Experimentation, Product Analytics, and data\-driven product decision\-making.
* You have built and coached empowered Product Teams and helped Product Managers grow and succeed.
* You foster strong Product Leadership capabilities and create an environment where teams can perform at their best.
* You combine strategic thinking with strong business acumen to balance customer value, business impact, and long\-term platform investments.
* You excel at communication and stakeholder management and can align teams and leaders around a shared vision.
* You are fluent in English; German language skills are an advantage.
We are looking forward to your application and to applicants who enrich our diverse culture! Regardless of age, gender, origin and sexual identity and orientation. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if equally qualified. This position can be full\-time or part\-time (min. 30h/week). DKV Mobility is looking for the best talents and knows that these are not always available on a full\-time basis. Many of our employees work part\-time or in flexible working models. Please talk to us about the flexibility you need during the application process.


**Why DKV Mobility? Here are five good reasons...**
---------------------------------------------------


At DKV Mobility, we are team players \- because we are only successful together! **\#teamofteams**
  

You should feel welcome with us from the very beginning!


### **We've been growing for about 90 years**


How we do it? We keep adapting our products and business model to meet changing customer needs. That's how we stay mobile and master every challenge the future holds.


There are also many other good reasons to work at DKV Mobility. For example, we offer you comprehensive company health management, parent\-child offices (from 2023\) and support you in leasing your eBike through our partner Jobrad!


### **We attach great importance to work\-life balance.**


We stand for the compatibility of family and career! That's why we offer flexible working hours and family\-friendly working time models. In addition, we rely on a balanced mix of on\-site meetings and home office.


### **We support you in your development**


We offer you optimal conditions to familiarize yourself so that you can quickly find your way around and become a part of the team! To further your personal development, we offer you access to a modern learning environment \- independent of time and location. This way you can also face the challenges of tomorrow!


### **We are committed to a net\-zero future**


After reaching our Green Pledge climate target in 2023 by reducing carbon emissions in our own business operations by 50\.4% compared to the base year 2019, we set ourselves ambitious net\-zero climate targets. The targets have been validated by the Science Based Targets initiative. By 2050, DKV Mobility commits to reach net\-zero greenhouse gas emissions across the value chain from a 2022 base year. You want to take climate action? Follow us on our road to net\-zero.


### **We are a certified employer**


Our employees trust us. As an employer, we regularly receive awards from independent institutes, e.g. as Top Employer Germany and as Great Place to Work!


Did you know that we have received several awards as an employer in recent years?

  

Have we made you curious? Then we are looking forward to your application! If you still have open questions then please contact **Sarah Issiakou** via sarah.issiakou@dkv\-mobility.com.

new_jobs.title: Senior System Architect PEGA (all genders)
new_jobs.description:
#### **Über ]init\[**


Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init\[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1\.200 ]init\[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.

#### **Deine Mission bei ]init\[**


Als **Senior System Architect Pega** (all genders) realisierst du zukunftsweisende und komplexe Lösungen in Digitalisierungsprojekten auf Basis von PEGA. Gemeinsam mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Business\- und Systemarchitekten (all genders) entwickelst du Anforderungen und Lösungskonzepte und setzt diese in moderne und benutzerfreundliche Softwarelösungen um. Gerne auch in Teilzeit.

#### **Das gibt es zu tun**

* Du bist hauptverantwortlich für die Umsetzung agiler Digitalisierungsprojekte im Public und Private Sector auf Basis von Pega.
* Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwirfst und verantwortest du effiziente und wieder verwendbare Pega\-Lösungen in unseren Projekten und Presales\-Aktivitäten.
* Du stehst mit Business Architects und der Projektleitung jederzeit in engem Kontakt und analysierst sowie optimierst bestehende Prozesse.
* Du beurteilst fachliche und technische Anforderungen und übernimmst die Abbildung von User Stories und Epics.
* Du beteiligst dich an der Konzeption von effektiven IT\-Strategien und Zielarchitekturen.
* Du entwickelst die Pega Practice bei ]init\[ aktiv mit und sorgst so dafür, dass unsere Entwickler und Projekte immer technisch auf dem aktuellen Stand sind.

#### **Das bringst du mit**

* Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
* Du kannst mehrjährige Erfahrung in Pega\-Implementierungsprojekten vorweisen und hast fundierte Erfahrung im IT\-Sektor.
* Du hast bereits Erfahrung als Lead Developer in Projekten gesammelt.
* Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung modellbasierter Geschäftslösungen und –anwendungen.
* Du hast eine aktuelle Zertifizierung als Pega Senior System Architect (PCSSA) oder bevorzugt als Lead System Architect (PCLSA).
* Du bringst Expertise in Web\-Entwicklung mit, bspw. basierend auf Java oder .net.
* Du bist Teamplayer mit guten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Zusammenarbeit in cross\-funktionalen Teams bereitet dir Freude.
* Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit

#### **Das bieten wir dir**

* **Because we care:** 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
* **Work with us:** Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
* **Learn with us:** Mit der ]init\[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
* **Grow with us:** Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
* **Ride with us:** JobRad, ÖPNV\-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
* **Start with us:** Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.
#### **Werde Teil des Teams**


Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.  

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.  

Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.  

  

*Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.*

#### **Recruiter**


Marina Makridina

#### **Über uns**


Worauf wartest du? Entfalte jetzt in einem spannenden Arbeitsumfeld dein Potenzial! Besuche uns für weitere Einblicke auf www.init.de und sprich mit unseren Recruiter:innen, die für all deine Fragen da sind.

new_jobs.title: Software Test Engineer REMOTE (m/f/d)
new_jobs.description:
#### **Your mission**

* Work closely with test engineers, product managers and fellow developers to test and continuously enhance our applications
* Collaborate enthusiastically within our remote team
* Provide and receive constructive feedback, e.g. in personal conversations, through reviews etc.
* Challenge the status quo and proactively identify areas for improvement
* Write and execute (manual) test cases with a passion for continuous learning
* Update and write testing code for automated e2e tests, e.g. via playwright
* Write documentation, e.g. software specification
* Continuously improve engineering standards, tools, and processes

#### **Your profile**

* Residence and work permit in Germany or Poland
* English proficiency (C1\+), strong communication skills

new_jobs.title: Process Engineer (m/w/d)
new_jobs.description:
**About the Position**
======================

**Ihre Aufgaben**

Sie entwickeln, analysieren und optimieren bestehende Produktionsprozesse und Prozessketten durch den Einsatz verfahrenstechnischer Methoden und Werkzeuge \- unter Anderem durch Erfassung und Auswertung von Prozessdaten, die Durchführung von Prozessanalysen sowie die Identifikation und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Effizienz, Qualität, Anlagenverfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. Sie planen, koordinieren und führen Versuche im Labor\-, Technikums\- und Produktionsmaßstab durch, werten die Ergebnisse aus und leiten daraus technische Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Darüber hinaus bearbeiten Sie verfahrenstechnische Projekte selbstständig von der Konzeptphase bis zur Umsetzung und kommunizieren Ihre Ergebnisse in Form von technischen Berichten, Präsentationen sowie Stoff\- und Energiebilanzen an interne und externe Stakeholder.


Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt Ihrer Tätigkeit liegt in der Unterstützung von Investitions\- und Optimierungsprojekten. Hier wirken Sie bei der Entwicklung technischer Konzepte, der Auswahl geeigneter Apparate und Anlagenkomponenten, der Durchführung von Tests sowie bei Inbetriebnahmen mit. Zudem unterstützen Sie die Nachhaltigkeitsorganisation durch die Erhebung, Aufbereitung und Validierung von prozessbezogenen Daten für Life\-Cycle\-Assessments (LCA). Der Fokus liegt dabei auf der Bereitstellung belastbarer Prozess\-, Energie\-, Rohstoff\- und Emissionsdaten (CO2 Bilanzierung). Darüber hinaus identifizieren Sie kontinuierlich Verbesserungspotenziale in den Bereichen Energieeffizienz, Ressourcennutzung und Prozessperformance und tragen aktiv zum Ausbau des technologischen Know\-hows im Unternehmen bei.


**Ihr Profil**

Sie haben ein Studium der Verfahrenstechnik oder des Chemieingenieurwesens erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Ebenfalls bringen Sie gute Kenntnisse von verfahrenstechnischen oder analytischen Prozessen, z.B. Sprühtrocknung, Mahlen oder Partikelmesstechnik sowie gute Kenntnisse der spezifischen Prozessketten mit. Sie haben Erfahrung mit dem Thema CO2 Bilanzierung \& Nachhaltigkeit und sind vertraut im Umgang mit MS\-Office, Minitab , ERP\-Systemen (idealerweise M3\) und haben erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Life Cycle Analysis. Gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2\) runden Ihr fachliches Profil ab.


Persönlich überzeugen Sie durch Zuverlässigkeit in Bezug auf Terminplanung und Arbeitsergebnisse sowie eine effektive und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. Sie sind offen in der Kommunikation und bringen sich proaktiv in die Aufgaben des Teams ein. Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen setzen wir voraus.


**Working at Höganäs**
----------------------

We aim to offer a great and meaningful place to work where you can fulfill your potential and ambitions. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We have a clear management philosophy, and just like us you believe that through collaboration and openness we develop as individuals and as a company. We see all employees, regardless of position, as leaders when we approach the challenges that the world \- and we \- face. Höganäs ambition is to lead the transformation to better meet the needs of tomorrow and become the preferred supplier of sustainable metal powder on a global scale – join us in our journey of sustainable change and towards net\-zero climate emissions.


**More about Höganäs**
----------------------

  

Founded in 1797, Höganäs is the world leader in the market for powders, with an annual capacity of 500,000 tonnes. Höganäs’ vision is to drive positive change through material innovation, with the ambition of becoming the globally preferred partner for sustainable powder materials.


The company’s strength lies in its diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences, and Höganäs is committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. Höganäs collaborates with customers across multiple industries to develop innovative solutions, including applications in automotive components, electric motors, brazing, surface coating, welding consumables and additive manufacturing. Operating 15 production centers worldwide and employing 2,200 people, Höganäs’ turnover for 2025 was 11,045 MSEK. Höganäs is owned by Lindéngruppen and FAM. www.hoganas.com  

  



**Interested? Apply today!**

new_jobs.title: (Senior) Full Stack .NET Entwickler (m/w/d)
new_jobs.description:
**Spannend, aufstrebend und verdammt schnell – wir sind flaschenpost!**
Wir liefern den Wocheneinkauf innerhalb von 120 Minuten zu unseren Kund:innen.
Gemeinsam mit über 20\.000 Kolleg:innen schaffen wir es, eine komplette Branche neu zu erfinden. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2016 sind wir mittlerweile als Sofortlieferdienst für Getränke und Lebensmittel in nahezu allen Metropolregionen Deutschlands vertreten.
Seit 2020 ist die flaschenpost Teil der Oetker\-Gruppe.### **(Senior) Full Stack .NET Entwickler (m/w/d)**

Um unsere Mission zu erfüllen, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen **(Senior) Full Stack .NET Entwickler (m/w/d)**. Du bist Teil unseres agilen, motivierten Teams. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst du interne Systeme und digitale Services weiter, die unsere Kund:innen unterstützen und zentrale Geschäftsprozesse optimieren.

### **Dein Liefergebiet:**

* Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst du interne Inhouse\-Systeme und digitale Services von der ersten Idee über die Architektur bis zum Go\-Live weiter
* Du entwickelst neue Features für komplexe digitale Anwendungen und gestaltest ganzheitliche Nutzerprozesse – von Registrierung und Produkterlebnis bis hin zu Self\-Service\-Funktionalitäten
* Du arbeitest eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen, um fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare technische Lösungen zu übersetzen
* Du übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Entscheidungen, sorgst für eine saubere Architektur und treibst technische Exzellenz im Team voran
* Du entwickelst und integrierst serviceorientierte Schnittstellen und unterstützt bei der Anbindung externer Systeme
* Du sicherst die Codequalität durch automatisierte Tests, Code\-Reviews, Clean Code und die konsequente Einhaltung von Best Practices und Coding Standards
* Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team und den Fachbereichen zusammen und unterstützt deine Kolleg:innen beispielsweise beim Pair Programming sowie bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse und Teamstandards

### **Das hast du im Sortiment:**

* Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und bringst mehrjährige, fundierte Erfahrung in der Full\-Stack\-Softwareentwicklung mit C\# und .NET mit
* Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in Entity Framework Core und relationalen Datenbanken, idealerweise Microsoft SQL Server
* Du bist vertraut mit Frontend\-Frameworks und hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Blazor und Radzen Components oder möchtest dich in diese Technologien einarbeiten
* Du bringst Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Anbindung von REST APIs sowie in der Integration unterschiedlicher Systeme mit; Azure, Docker, Kubernetes und DevOps\-/CI/CD\-Workflows sind dir ein Begriff und idealerweise bereits Teil deines Alltags
* Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Softwarearchitektur, Clean Code, automatisierte Tests sowie die Entwicklung wartbarer und skalierbarer Systeme
* Du arbeitest gerne cross\-funktional in einem agilen Umfeld (Scrum/Kanban) und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Teamkultur ein
* Du bist eine teamorientierte Persönlichkeit, kommunizierst klar und wertschätzend mit technischen und nicht\-technischen Ansprechpartner:innen und verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse sowie verhandlungssicheres Englisch in Wort und Schrift

### **Die Top\-Angebote der flaschenpost:**

* **Work\-Life Balance** – Gestalte deinen Arbeitstag flexibel nach deinen Vorstellungen und genieße die Freiheit des mobilen Arbeitens
* **Job\-Ticket \& Business\-Bike** – Damit nicht nur die Arbeitszeit flexibel ist
* **Start\-Up\-Features** – Genieße Freigetränke und die ein oder andere Partie Kicker oder Tischtennis als Ausgleich zur Arbeit
* **flaschenpost Learning** – Erstelle deine persönliche Learning Journey und erweitere dein Know\-how durch vielfältige und innovative Trainings
* **Buddy Programm** – Dein flaschenpost\-Buddy steht dir während der Einarbeitung mit Rat und Tat zur Seite
* **Modernste Technik** – Wir legen großen Wert auf Fortschritt und Innovation
* **Team\- und Networking\-Events** – Halte dich fit und lerne deine Kolleg:innen beim Betriebssport, Spieleabend und Stammtisch besser kennen
* **Corporate Benefits** – Profitiere von Rabatten und Angeboten in Online\-Shops und Fitnessstudios
* **Social Responsiveness** – Blutspenden während der Arbeitszeit und damit Leben retten

  



Wir haben dich überzeugt und du möchtest unseren Erfolg aktiv mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über unser Onlineformular.

new_jobs.description:
* Materna Information \& Communications SE
* Berlin

* Erlangen
* Frankfurt am Main
* Hamburg

Wir schreiben seit über 45 Jahren IT\-Geschichte. Kundinnen und Kunden aus öffentlicher Verwaltung und Privatwirtschaft verlassen sich auf unsere nachhaltigen und individuell entwickelten IT\-Lösungen. Hast du Lust, moderne und souveräne Datenplattformen, Data Fabrics und Data Meshes zu gestalten? Fragen dich deine Kolleg:innen regelmäßig, wie man komplexe Big\-Data\-Architekturen skalierbar und resilient umsetzt und aus der Welt der Daten skalierbare Produkte mit Business Impact generiert? Und reizt es dich, moderne Data Governance Technologien gezielt dort einzusetzen, wo sie echten Mehrwert für die Gesellschaft stiftet?


Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft und komm als **Principal Data Platforms Enigneer (m/w/d)** ins \#TeamMaterna!


**Als Principal Data Platforms Engineer**
-----------------------------------------


* unterstützt du unsere Kunden mit Hinblick auf Brown Field und Green Field Integrationsentscheidungen über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus inkl. Presales\-Phase, Kostenschätzung und bist das Bindeglied zwischen Architektur und Entwicklungsteam.
* bist du Teil des Architekturteams und beteiligst dich aktiv an der Beratung zur Architekturentwicklung.
* designst du skalierbare, resiliente und sichere Daten\-zentrierte Lösungen für verschiedene Kundenanforderungen auf Private und Public Cloud Plattformen auf Basis von Kubernetes.
* setzt du dein Fachwissen bei Ausschreibungen ein und wirkst bei der Erstellung komplexer Leistungsbeschreibungen mit.
* gestaltest du unsere Standards, insbesondere im Bereich Big Data, Cloud, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code und DevSecOps inkl. Dokumentation und stellst deren Umsetzung in Projekten sicher.
* übernimmst du die Mentorenrolle, um Kolleg:innen und Entwicklungsteams bei Architekturentscheidungen sowie der Implementierung zu unterstützen.
* stellst du die Qualität der Lösungen durch Code\-Reviews sowie etablierte Standards sicher und trägst so zur Entstehung zukunftsfähiger Plattformen bei.
**Dein Profil**
---------------


**Das bringst du mit**


* Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts\-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit relevanter Berufserfahrung
* Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Umsetzung von Software\- sowie IT\-Architekturen im Big Data und Cloud Umfeld
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Software\-Entwicklung als Lead Developer:in mit Java, C\# oder Python
* Erfahrung im Big Data Umfeld mit Architekturmustern, Technologien und der Entwicklung datengetriebener Systeme
* Expertise im Umgang mit Technologien wie API\-Management, Microservices und gängigen Security\-Verfahren
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Anbindung von NoSQL\-Technologien (z. B. Apache Cassandra) und relationalen Datenbanken (z. B. MySQL, Oracle)
* Kenntnisse in Container\-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und in der Umsetzung von IaC und CI/CD, ergänzt durch Erfahrung im Design skalierbarer Cloud\-Infrastrukturen (z. B. AWS, Azure, GCP, OVH, IONOS, Stackit)
* Praxis im Umgang mit Event\-Streaming\- und modernen Datainfrastruktur\-Technologien wie Apache Kafka, Apache Hadoop, Apache Iceberg und Apache Spark
* Kenntnisse in Data Governance, insbesondere in Bezug auf Datenqualität, Sicherheit, Compliance und Nachvollziehbarkeit
* Erfahrung im Umgang mit Architekturstandards und Best Practices wie Architektur\- und Design\-Patterns sowie in der Dokumentation von Softwarearchitekturen, z. B. mit arc42
* Sehr gute Deutsch\- (C1\) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B1\) in Wort und Schrift

**Das zeichnet dich persönlich aus**


* Du arbeitest kooperativ im Projektteam, kannst unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf gemeinsame Ziele ausrichten und teilst dein Wissen gerne in Communities oder im Sparring mit Kolleg:innen.
* In neuen oder komplexen Situationen behältst du die Ruhe, nimmst Anforderungen strukturiert auf, baust daraus tragfähige Architekturen und vertrittst Entscheidungen souverän gegenüber Kunden.
* Du bringst echtes Interesse an unseren Themen mit, entwickelst gemeinsam mit Kunden umsetzbare Lösungen und behältst auch bei anspruchsvollen Aufgaben einen pragmatischen Blick.
**Deine Vorteile**
------------------


* **Fach\- und Führungskarriere:** Das Materna Laufbahnmodell unterstützt dich systematisch und zielgerichtet in deiner persönlichen Entwicklung und zeigt dir mögliche Karrierepfade auf.
* **Flexibles Arbeiten:** Halte Arbeits\- und Privatleben in Balance – mit unserem flexiblen Arbeitszeitsystem und 40% mobilem Arbeiten.
* **Job Rad:** Neues Bike gefällig? Mit Job\-Rad unterstützen wir dich dabei dein Wunsch\-Fahrrad zu leasen.
* **Wissensaustausch:** Du möchtest über den Tellerrand hinausschauen? In unseren Brown\-Bag\-Sessions, Developer\-Summits und Communities hast du die Gelegenheit dazu!
* **Sport@Materna:** Nutze das vielfältige und flexible Sport\- und Wellnessangebot unseres Partners Urban Sports Club in ganz Deutschland, Österreich und mehreren europäischen Ländern.
**Interessiert? Werde Teil der Materna\-Story!**
------------------------------------------------


Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Unser Auswahlprozess besteht aus zwei Gesprächsrunden. Bei erfolgreicher Bewerbung wirst du zunächst zu einem virtuellen Interview eingeladen.

new_jobs.title: POS Test Engineer
new_jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Quality Assurance holds a vital place in River Island Engineering Strategy and is an integral part of the development team. It is indeed an exciting time for RI Tech as we are transitioning to microservices architecture and embracing a DevOps culture. We strive to continuously improve our development and testing processes to shorten feedback loops and maximise value.
  

We are looking for an experienced test engineer to champion QA in one of our cross\-functional teams. With a thorough working knowledge of agile methodologies, you will engage proactively with the team to understand business requirements, elaborate user stories and define acceptance criteria. You will plan, define and execute testing of all project deliveries; triage issues found and report on progress. As a champion of quality assurance, you will help align testing strategy to enable us to be better and faster. You will champion and drive improvements in quality assurance in your team using test automation.  

**Key Responsibilities*** Review and ensure requirements/user stories/acceptance criteria stated are correct, unambiguous, and verifiable.
* Work as an embedded tester in the context of a scrum team, evaluating the complexity of user stories, contributing to estimates during sprint planning, developing and performing tests.
* Champion a shift\-left approach to in\-sprint testing.
* Conduct appropriate levels and types of testing of user stories.
* Collaborate with developers on architecture and design, evaluate and improve processes to enhance software quality
* Identify and inform the team of any impediments or risks to product quality or project delivery
* Automate tests where cost\-effective to ensure software delivered is fit for purpose and meets business needs
* Ensure defects are documented in sufficient detail to be reproducible
* Proactively share knowledge and information with others
* Assist and support business users during user acceptance testing

**Description**  



  

At Xe, we live currencies. We provide a comprehensive range of currency services and products, including our Currency Converter, Market Analysis, Currency Data API and quick, easy, secure Money Transfers for individuals and businesses. We leverage technology to deliver these services through our website, mobile app and by phone. Last year, we helped over 300 million people access information about the currencies that matter to them and over 225,000 people used us to send money overseas.  

  

**ABOUT THIS ROLE**  

We're hiring a senior back\-end engineer who owns real problems end\-to\-end and shapes how the team builds, from API design and data modeling through to service implementation, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.


You'll write code that moves money in production, design and modernize the backend services the platform runs on, and lead delivery of new capability as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small team with direct access to product, compliance, and operations, own architecture in your domain, lead design reviews, mentor mid\-level engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross\-domain decisions.

 **OUR PRINCIPLES*** **AMBITION** \- We dream big, try things out and always ask “why not?” and “what if?” We’re ambitious in our thinking and our delivery
* **RESPONSIBILITY** \- We get involved, bring our perspective, and are always open to new ideas. We take personal responsibility
* **COMMUNITY** \- We value a sense of belonging, trusting each other and encouraging authenticity. We contribute to our community

  

  

**ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES*** Design and own backend services that move money and manage multi\-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.
* Lead cross\-functional delivery with product, compliance, and operations from problem framing through launch.
* Lead the build of the partner integrations and settlement infrastructure your domain depends on.
* Own production health for your domain, including reliability, observability, on\-call, and incident response.
* Lead design reviews, set technical direction for your domain, and mentor mid\-level engineers.
* Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across the SDLC, and lead modernization from legacy services into the modern stack alongside architects and team leads in your domain.

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

* 6 to 10\+ years building production backend services, end\-to\-end.
* Strong backend proficiency in C\# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).
* SQL and relational database fundamentals.
* Writing and maintaining tests.
* Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
* Production experience with AWS, including hands\-on deployment, CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices, and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.
* Strong system design and architecture experience, including service\-oriented or microservices and event\-driven patterns.
* Payments, FX, or regulated\-industry experience.
* Track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, and making architecture decisions in your domain.
* Strong written and verbal communication.

**Nice\-to\-have**

* Experience with ledgers, double\-entry accounting, or other financial\-data systems.
* Experience hiring, interviewing, or onboarding engineers.
* Experience leading modernization or platform migrations.
* Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis.
* Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence.
* Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.
* Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).

### **PERKS \& BENEFITS**

* Competitive Salary \& Discretionary Bonus
* 23 days annual leave increasing with service (capped at 28 days)
* Paid day off for your Birthday
* 4% employer pension contribution
* Discounted Euronet ESPP
* Life Cover, Income Protection \& Critical Illness cover

* Plumm Mental Health and Wellbeing

We want Xe to be a great place to work and to ensure that our communities are represented across our workforce. A vital part of this is ensuring we are a truly inclusive organization that encourages diversity in all respects.  

  

At Xe we are committed to making our recruitment practices barrier\-free and as accessible as possible for everyone. This includes making adjustments or changes for disabled people, neurodiverse people or people with long\-term health conditions. If you would like us to do anything differently during the application, interview or assessment process, including providing information in an alternative format, please contact us on recruitment@xe.com

new_jobs.description:

Tech \& Digital

  


**About the Role**


Technology is advancing rapidly—every organization is digitizing, adopting AI, and rethinking how work is done. That shift is exactly what our Product \& Technology Office exists to shape. We're building the platform that will power the future of workforce solutions: world\-leading STEM talent services, managed services, and a growing suite of AI\-enabled products.


As an Enterprise Architect, you'll be responsible for ensuring the coherence of our technology portfolio. Not just one domain, but all of them—business, data, applications, integration, infrastructure, and security—across our proprietary products, third\-party platforms, and enterprise systems. You won't manage people to achieve this; instead, you'll lead through the strength of your architectural standards, your design authority, and your ability to bring engineering, product, and technology teams together toward a shared target state.


Three things will define your first year: scaling our platform for growth, ensuring our products work seamlessly across regions and brands, and designing how AI is safely integrated into what we offer our clients. All of it built with security in mind from day one.


**What You'll Do**


* Define and maintain the target\-state architecture across business, data, application, integration, infrastructure, and security domains—and then keep it up to date as the system evolves.
* Define the architectural principles, standards, and reusable patterns that engineering and product teams actually adopt.
* Maintain a single, integrated technology roadmap that sequences changes, eliminates duplication, and reduces technical debt—while aligning with the domain roadmaps driven by domain leaders.
* Architect for scalability: multi\-tenancy, entity separation, shared services, and the non\-functional standards that allow us to onboard new brands without having to rebuild the platform each time.
* Design how our products function across regions—data residency, localization, currency, regulation—using configurable patterns rather than forked codebases.
* Partner with the VP of Data \& AI to develop reference architectures for AI and agentic capabilities in client\-facing services, covering model access, orchestration, evaluation, and human oversight.
* Embed security, privacy, and resilience into every design from the very beginning, working closely with the Director of Information Security \& Privacy.
* Lead a design authority focused on the decisions that matter—cross\-domain decisions, major programs, exceptions—rather than routine approval.
* Mentor architects and engineers throughout the company, raising the bar for design thinking without needing a direct reporting relationship to do so.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the CTPO and senior leadership, and represent our architecture to clients, partners, and auditors in situations where it is contractually relevant.

**Nice to have**


* Experience in HR tech, staffing, or a comparable regulated, multi\-entity service business.
* Familiarity with recognized assurance and control frameworks used in supplier or client audits.
* Experience leading or contributing to a formal architecture design authority or governance board.

**Why Join Us**


You'll help build the technical backbone of a truly international, rapidly scaling HR tech company—not from the sidelines, but as the person responsible for ensuring everything fits together. If you're looking for architecture work with real commercial impact and the autonomy to drive it through expertise rather than hierarchy, this is the role for you.

  

#### **Here's what we offer you**


Salary that matches your experience
  

You will receive a salary range that matches your knowledge and experience. We reward you fairly for your commitment and development.
Vacation pay and days off
  

You will receive 8\.33% vacation pay and are entitled to 27 vacation days per year based on full\-time employment. This gives you plenty of time to recharge your batteries.
Hybrid working
  

We support hybrid working and apply a 60/40 split, whereby full\-time employees spend three days at the office and two days working from home.
Premium\-freepension
  

We pay your entire pension premium. This means you accrue pension without having to contribute to it yourself. As a result, you are left with a higher net salary.
Performancebonus
  

Depending on your performance and that of HeadFirst Group, you may receive an annual bonus of one or two months' salary.
Monthly extras
  

You will receive a monthly allowance for internet, a vitality budget, a contribution towards lunch, and support in setting up your home office.
#### **What we expect from you**


**What You'll Bring**


* Proven experience as an Enterprise Architect (or in an equivalent senior architecture role) across the domains of business, data, applications, integration, infrastructure, and security—not just a single area of expertise.
* A track record of leading through influence and technical expertise rather than formal management—and getting engineering and product teams genuinely aligned with a target state.
* Experience in designing multi\-region, multi\-brand, or multi\-tenant products, including practical patterns for localization and regulatory variations.
* A hands\-on understanding of how to responsibly integrate AI and agentic capabilities into products—including data governance, evaluation, and human oversight, not just the technology itself.
* A "security\-by\-design" mindset, comfortable working alongside information security and privacy functions rather than treating them as a final gate.
* Strong communication skills — able to clearly explain architectural trade\-offs to both engineers and executives.

new_jobs.description:

Research Software Engineer
  
**Requisition ID:** 29757
  
  

**Location:**  

Newcastle, GB
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }

**Working Pattern:** Full Time

**.buttontext5b73eb8ce7144827 a{ border:** 1px solid transparent; } .buttontext5b73eb8ce7144827 a: focus{ border: 1px dashed \#16726d !important; outline: none !important; }
  
  

**Salary:** £36,636 \- £37,694 per annum
  
  

Newcastle University is a great place to work, with excellent benefits. We have a generous holiday package; plus the opportunity to buy more, great pension schemes and a number of health and wellbeing initiatives to support you.
  
  

**Closing Date:** 27 September 2026
  
  

The Role
  
  

We are delighted to be seeking a motivated individual to join the School of Computing at Newcastle University. The postholder will work on an EPSRC\-funded project, providing specialist software\-development and systems\-integration expertise to develop and deploy a decision\-grade Digital Product Passport (DPP) platform for buildings.
  
  

The project will integrate Newcastle University’s Digital Product Passport infrastructure with Cardiff University’s digital\-twin and energy\-analytics work, using real project data and partner workflows to support better retrofit and net\-zero decisions. The DPP platform will provide trusted and reusable information about building materials and components, including their provenance, condition and reuse potential, and make this information available to digital\-twin and analytics systems.
  
  

You will implement, integrate, test and deploy the DPP platform and its supporting technical infrastructure. This will include developing data structures and semantic models, provenance and data\-quality mechanisms, APIs and integration interfaces, and supporting secure deployment, testing and technical validation.
  
  

The successful applicant will possess excellent technical, communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to develop reliable software systems and solve complex systems\-integration problems. They should be self\-motivated, capable of managing their own technical activities, and able to work effectively with academic researchers, public\-sector stakeholders and industry partners.
  
  

This post is available from 1 October 2026 on a full\-time, fixed\-term basis for 12 months. Some travel to partner sites and project meetings in Wales will be required.
  
  

For all informal enquiries, please contact Dr Ellis Solaiman (ellis.solaiman@ncl.ac.uk).
  
  

Key Accountabilities
  
  

Implement and deploy the Digital Product Passport prototype and supporting technical infrastructure for the project
  
Develop and maintain data structures and semantic models that support consistent interpretation of material and building information across organisations and systems
  
Implement provenance, data\-quality and trust mechanisms so that evidence can be traced, checked and relied upon across project handovers
  
Develop and maintain APIs, data contracts and other integration interfaces so that the DPP can exchange information reliably with digital\-twin and analytics systems
  
Support secure deployment, configuration, testing, debugging and operation of the demonstrator, including cloud\-based components where appropriate
  
Populate and technically validate Digital Product Passports using real partner data, including project records, BIM and supply\-chain information
  
Work with academic, industrial and public\-sector partners to translate agreed technical requirements into working software and integration solutions
  
Support technical evaluation of data quality, interoperability, provenance robustness, integration performance and deployment readiness
  
Produce clear technical documentation, reference architecture material, deployment guidance and reusable software and tooling to support replication and wider adoption
  
Contribute to project demonstrations, technical workshops and delivery milestones as required
  
  

The Person (Essential)
  
  

Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
  

Strong practical software\-development experience, with the ability to design, implement, test and maintain reliable software systems
  
Experience developing data\-centric, distributed or integrated software systems
  
Experience with data modelling, interoperability, metadata, semantic technologies, knowledge graphs or closely related approaches
  
Experience implementing system interfaces such as APIs and working with structured data exchanged between different software systems
  
Understanding of data provenance, data quality, security, auditability or trusted\-data mechanisms
  
Good programming skills in one or more relevant programming languages
  
Attention to detail and ability to work at high levels of accuracy
  
Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the initiative and creativity to resolve technical challenges effectively.
  
Ability to present complex technical information effectively to a range of audiences
  
Ability to work with colleagues and external partners and to translate technical requirements into implemented solutions.
  
  

Desirable
  
  

Experience with Digital Product Passports, digital twins, BIM, construction data, circular\-economy systems or supply\-chain data
  
Experience with ontology\-based or semantic\-web technologies and machine\-readable data standards
  
Experience with auditable provenance technologies, including blockchain or distributed\-ledger approaches
  
Experience with secure cloud deployment, distributed systems or production\-style research software infrastructure
  
Experience integrating software with external analytics, decision\-support or energy\-performance systems
  
  

Attributes and Behaviour
  
  

Commitment to working positively as a member of a multi\-skilled project team
  
Ability to negotiate and prioritise multiple, competing responsibilities and to work to deadlines
  
A practical and solution\-focused approach to software development and systems integration
  
Commitment to producing reliable and maintainable software and technical documentation
  
Ability to work constructively with academic, industry and public\-sector partners
  
Commitment to continued professional development
  
Support the University’s core values and demonstrate the ability to implement these within your role or department
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience
  
  

Newcastle University is a global University where everyone is treated with dignity and respect. As a University of Sanctuary, we aim to provide a welcoming place of safety for all, offering opportunities to people fleeing violence and persecution.
  
  

We are committed to being a fully inclusive university which actively recruits, supports and retains colleagues from all sectors of society. We value diversity as well as celebrate, support and thrive on the contributions of all of our employees and the communities they represent. We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from individuals who can complement our existing teams, we believe that success is built on having teams whose backgrounds and experiences reflect the diversity of our university and student population.
  
  

At Newcastle University we hold a Gold Athena Swan award in recognition of our good employment practices for the advancement of gender equality. We also hold a Race Equality Charter Bronze award in recognition of our work towards tackling race inequality in higher education REC. We are a Disability Confident employer and will offer an interview to disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role as part of the offer and interview scheme.
  
  

In addition, we are a member of the Euraxess initiative supporting researchers in Europe.
  
  

**Requisition ID:** 29757

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Our priority is to match the right person to the right role, and we never want salary to be a barrier to applying. Regardless of your current pay, we’ll ask about your salary expectations during the application process, and our Talent Team will have an open, honest conversation during the talent call to understand your skills and explore our salary options. If you have questions around salary, please feel free to ask us!

 **Location**: Chiswick, London \- Hybrid

**Sponsorship:** We are unable to offer sponsorship for this role

### **The Role**

  

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and maintenance of our data infrastructure, ensuring efficient and scalable data pipelines.


You will be responsible for hands\-on implementation and optimization of data systems on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP), contributing to critical projects while mentoring junior Engineers.


This role focuses on delivering technical solutions, applying best practices, and driving innovation within the data engineering team.

### **Why So Energy?**


So Energy was created in 2015 because we knew energy suppliers could be **better**. Since then, we’ve grown rapidly but sustainably, with 300,000 customers and over 450 Energists (what we call our people). But we’re not done! We’re on the road to a net\-zero future, and thanks to our partnership with ESB, we’re well on the way. We’re customer\-centric, tech\-led, and passionate about sustainability.


We’re driven to do our best for our customers, for each other, and for our planet. That’s why we’ve built a workplace culture that’s supportive, empowering, inclusive, and full of opportunities to grow and make an impact.


At So Energy, we take pride in our values\-driven culture. We live and breathe by our **six core** **values** that guide everything we do:

* **Clear**
* **Honest**
* **Ambitious**
* **Inquisitive**
* **Caring**
* **Sustainable**

### **What you’ll be getting up to in this role:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using modern data engineering tools and technologies on our GCP stack.
* Build and optimize our lake house on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Implement data ingestion, transformation, and loading processes for various data sources (e.g., databases, APIs, cloud storage).
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and security throughout the data pipeline.
* Leverage GCP services (e.g., Dataflow, Dataproc, BigQuery, Cloud Storage) to build and maintain cloud\-native data solutions.
* Implement infrastructure as code (IaC) principles using Terraform to automate provisioning and configuration.
* Manage and optimize cloud resources to ensure cost\-efficiency and performance.
* Design and implement efficient data models following a star schema approach to support analytical and operational workloads.
* Collaborate with data analysts to develop advanced analytics solutions.
* Conduct data quality analysis to drive better data management on outputs in our Curated Layer.
* Mentor junior data engineers and provide technical guidance.
* Contribute to the development of data engineering best practices and standards.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver complex data projects.

### **You’re a great match if:**

**Technical Skills**

* You're an expert in GCP services including BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage, and Cloud Functions. GCP Professional Data Engineer Certification is highly favourable.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL for complex data transformation and query optimization.
* Proven experience in Python for scalable data pipeline development and orchestration following best practices.
* Experience implementing Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to automate GCP resource management.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices.
* Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience building and optimizing batch and streaming data pipelines.
* Understanding of data governance principles, GCP security (IAM, VPC), and compliance requirements.

**Soft Skills**

* Demonstrates a growth mindset by actively seeking to learn from peers and stakeholders, fostering a culture of open communication and shared knowledge.
* Works effectively across teams, including Data Science, Engineering, and Analytics, to understand their needs and deliver impactful data solutions.
* Actively participates in design discussions, brainstorming sessions, and cross\-functional projects, always striving for continuous improvement and innovation.
* Builds strong relationships across the organization, using empathy and active listening to ensure alignment on goals and deliverables.
* Approaches challenges with a growth mindset, viewing obstacles as opportunities to innovate and improve processes.
* Applies a structured and analytical approach to solving complex problems, balancing immediate needs with long\-term scalability and efficiency.
* Demonstrates resilience under pressure, maintaining a positive and solution\-focused attitude when faced with tight deadlines or ambiguity.
* Actively seeks feedback and lessons learned from past projects to continuously refine problem\-solving strategies and improve outcomes.
* Shares expertise generously, guiding team members in adopting best practices and helping them overcome technical challenges.
* Leads by example, demonstrating how to approach complex problems pragmatically while promoting curiosity and a willingness to explore new tools and technologies.

new_jobs.title: Senior Identity and Full-Stack Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**

At Aberdeen, our ambition is to be the UK’s leading Wealth \& Investments group.


Strengthening talent and culture is one of our strategic priorities. We strive to make Aberdeen a great place to work so that we can attract and retain the industry’s best talent.


Our people put our stakeholders at the heart of everything they do by helping us to make a positive difference to the lives of our clients, customers, colleagues, shareholders, and society.


We are focused on growing our direct and advised wealth platforms and repositioning our specialist asset management business to meet client demand. We are committed to providing excellent client service, supported by leading technology and talent.


Aberdeen comprises three businesses, interactive investor (ii), Investments, and Adviser, each of which focuses on meeting and adapting to our clients’ evolving needs:

* interactive investor, the UK’s second largest direct\-to\-consumer investment platform, enables individuals in the UK to plan, save, and invest in the way that works for them.
* Our Adviser business provides financial planning solutions and technology for UK financial advisers, enabling them to create value for their customers.
* Our Investments business is a specialist asset manager that focuses on areas where we have both strength and scale to capitalise on the key themes shaping the market, through either public markets or alternative asset classes.
**About the Department**


Digital Engineering delivers the platforms, applications and services that power customer and colleague experiences across Aberdeen. Working closely with product, security and business teams, the department modernises technology, strengthens resilience and supports innovation. The team promotes collaboration, continuous improvement and engineering excellence, helping enable our clients to be better investors.

**About the Role**


We are looking for a Senior Identity \& Full\-Stack Engineer to take technical ownership of our customer\-facing identity platform while contributing to application, API and cloud engineering initiatives. Based in Edinburgh, this permanent opportunity combines identity platform leadership with hands\-on software engineering across Microsoft Azure and modern digital technologies. You will play a key role in improving security, reliability, automation and user experience across our digital estate. This is an opportunity to shape critical services, influence engineering standards and continue developing your expertise in a collaborative environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and evolve Aberdeen’s customer\-facing Identity Provider (IDP) and IDaaS platform, ensuring reliability, security and continuous improvement.
* Design and implement authentication, SSO, federation, user lifecycle and access governance solutions using OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML and SCIM.
* Build and support cloud\-native applications, APIs and integrations on Microsoft Azure, taking solutions from design through to production support.
* Drive automation and engineering excellence through Terraform, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines and scripting tools.
* Troubleshoot complex incidents, perform root\-cause analysis and strengthen operational resilience across digital services.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership, standards and best practices across Digital Engineering.
**About the Candidate**

**Essential skills and experience:**

* Experience operating and supporting Identity Provider or Identity\-as\-a\-Service platforms, ideally Okta but other Identity platforms will be considered.
* Strong knowledge of OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, SSO, MFA and identity security controls.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure, identity integration and cloud\-native services.
* Strong software engineering capability across C\# .NET APIs, backend services and secure integrations.
* Experience with Terraform, GitHub, CI/CD automation and scripting tools.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to collaborate, mentor and support colleagues.
**Desirable:** Okta administration, SCIM provisioning, access governance, GraphQL, Playwright, TypeScript, Terraform\-based infrastructure provisioning, AI\-assisted engineering tools and regulated financial services experience.


We are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you have a disability and would like to apply to one of our UK roles under the Disability Confident Scheme, please notify us by completing the relevant section in our candidate questionnaire. One of our team will reach out to support you through your application process.

**Our benefits**


There's more to working life than coming home with a good salary. We have an environment where you can learn, get involved and be supported.


When you join us, your reward will be one of the best around. This includes 40 days’ annual leave, a 16% employer pension contribution, a discretionary performance\-based bonus (where applicable), private healthcare and a range of flexible benefits – including gym discounts, season ticket loans and access to an employee discount portal. You can read more about our benefits here.

**Our business**


Enabling our clients to be better investors drives everything we do. Our business is structured around three distinct areas – our vectors of growth – focused on our clients’ changing needs. You can find out more about what we do here.

**An inclusive way of working**


Whatever way you like to work, if you have the talent and commitment to join our team, we’d like to hear from you.


At Aberdeen we’ve adopted a ‘blended working’ approach. This approach combines the benefits of face\-to\-face collaboration, coaching and connecting in our offices with the flexibility of working from home. It enables colleagues to find a balance that works for their roles, their teams, our clients and our business.


An inclusive culture, where diverse perspectives drive our actions, is at the core of who we are and what we do. If you need assistance with your application, or a reasonable adjustment to your interview arrangements – for example, because you are neurodivergent, or have a physical, sensory, cognitive, mental, visible or invisible disability – please let us know and we’ll be happy to help.

**We’re committed to providing an inclusive workplace where all forms of difference are valued and which is free from any form of unfair or unlawful treatment. We define diversity in its broadest sense – this includes but is not limited to our diversity of educational and professional backgrounds, experience, cognitive and neurodiversity, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion or belief and ethnicity and geographical provenance. We support a culture that values meritocracy, fairness and transparency and welcomes enquiries from everyone.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**If you need assistance or an adjustment due to a disability please let us know as part of your application and we will assist.**
